category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: Example Corp provides a personalized video generation service that millions of enterprise customers use. Customers generate marketing videos by submitting prompts to the company’s proprietary generative AI (GenAI) model. To improve output relevance and personalization, Example Corp wants to enhance the prompts by using customer-specific context such as product preferences, customer attributes, and business history. The customers have strict data governance requirements. The customers must retain full ownership and control over their own data. The customers do not require real-time access. However, semantic accuracy must be high and retrieval latency must remain low to support customer experience use cases. Example Corp wants to minimize architectural complexity in its integration pattern. Example Corp does not want to deploy and manage services in each customer’s environment unless necessary. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Ensure that each customer sets up an Amazon Q Business index that includes the customer’s internal data. Ensure that each customer designates Example Corp as a data accessor to allow Example Corp to retrieve relevant content by using a secure API to enrich prompts at runtime.
choices.textZh: 确保每个客户都设置一个包含客户内部数据的 Amazon Q Business 索引。确保每个客户指定Example Corp作为数据访问者，以允许Example Corp通过使用安全API检索相关内容以丰富运行时的提示。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use federated search with Model Context Protocol (MCP) by deploying real-time MCP servers for each customer. Retrieve data in real time during prompt generation.
choices.textZh: 通过为每个客户部署实时 MCP 服务器，将联合搜索与模型上下文协议 (MCP) 结合使用。在提示生成期间实时检索数据。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Ensure that each customer configures an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. Allow cross-account querying so Example Corp can retrieve structured data for prompt augmentation.
choices.textZh: 确保每个客户都配置一个 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。允许跨账户查询，以便示例公司可以检索结构化数据以进行快速扩充。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure Amazon Kendra to crawl customer data sources. Share the resulting indexes across accounts so Example Corp can query each customer’s Amazon Kendra index to retrieve augmentation data.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Kendra 以抓取客户数据源。跨账户共享生成的索引，以便 Example Corp 可以查询每个客户的 Amazon Kendra 索引以检索增强数据。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: Example Corp 提供数百万企业客户使用的个性化视频生成服务。客户通过向公司专有的生成人工智能 (GenAI) 模型提交提示来生成营销视频。为了提高输出相关性和个性化，Example Corp 希望通过使用特定于客户的上下文（例如产品偏好、客户属性和业务历史记录）来增强提示。客户对数据治理有严格的要求。客户必须保留对其自身数据的完全所有权和控制权。客户不需要实时访问。然而，语义准确性必须很高，并且检索延迟必须保持较低，才能支持客户体验用例。示例公司希望最大限度地减少其集成模式中的架构复杂性。除非必要，示例公司不想在每个客户的环境中部署和管理服务。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is creating a workflow to review customer-facing communications before the company sends the communications. The company uses a pre-defined message template to generate the communications and stores the communications in an Amazon S3 bucket. The workflow needs to capture a specific portion from the template and send it to an Amazon Bedrock model. The workflow must store model responses back to the original S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a flow in Amazon Bedrock Flows. Configure S3 action nodes at the beginning and end of the flow to retrieve and store the communications and the model responses. In the middle of the flow, configure an expression to parse each communication. Configure an agent step to send the parsed input to the model for review.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock Flows 中创建流。在流程的开头和结尾配置 S3 操作节点以检索和存储通信和模型响应。在流程的中间，配置一个表达式来解析每个通信。配置代理步骤以将解析后的输入发送到模型以供审核。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an AWS Step Functions Express workflow state machine. Use an Amazon S3 integration GetObject step to retrieve the original communications. Use an intrinsic function Pass step to parse the communications and to pass the results to an Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel step. Configure an Amazon S3 integration PutObject step to store the model responses back to the S3 bucket.
choices.textZh: 创建 AWS Step Functions Express 工作流程状态机。使用 Amazon S3 集成 GetObject 步骤检索原始通信。使用内部函数 Pass 步骤来解析通信并将结果传递给 Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel 步骤。配置 Amazon S3 集成 PutObject 步骤以将模型响应存储回 S3 存储桶。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock agent that has an action group. Configure instructions to define how the agent should parse the communications. Configure the action group to retrieve the communications from the S3 bucket, invoke the Amazon Bedrock model, and store the model responses back to the S3 bucket.
choices.textZh: 创建一个具有操作组的 Amazon Bedrock 代理。配置指令以定义代理应如何解析通信。配置操作组以从 S3 存储桶检索通信、调用 Amazon Bedrock 模型并将模型响应存储回 S3 存储桶。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock agent that has a single action group. Configure three AWS Lambda functions in the action group. Configure the functions to retrieve the communications from the S3 bucket, parse the communications and invoke the Amazon Bedrock model, and store the model responses back to the S3 bucket.
choices.textZh: 创建具有单个操作组的 Amazon Bedrock 代理。在操作组中配置三个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置函数以从 S3 存储桶检索通信、解析通信并调用 Amazon Bedrock 模型，并将模型响应存储回 S3 存储桶。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在创建一个工作流程，以便在公司发送通信之前审查面向客户的通信。该公司使用预定义的消息模板来生成通信并将通信存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该工作流程需要从模板中捕获特定部分并将其发送到 Amazon Bedrock 模型。工作流程必须将模型响应存储回原始 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company is creating a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application that uses Amazon Bedrock to generate summaries of market activities. The application relies on a vector database that stores a small proprietary dataset with a low index count. The application must perform similarity searches. The Amazon Bedrock model’s responses must maximize accuracy and maintain high performance. The company needs to configure the vector database and integrate it with the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Launch an Amazon MemoryDB cluster and configure the index by using the Flat algorithm. Configure a horizontal scaling policy based on performance metrics.
choices.textZh: 启动 Amazon MemoryDB 集群并使用 Flat 算法配置索引。根据性能指标配置水平扩展策略。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Launch an Amazon MemoryDB cluster and configure the index by using the Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) algorithm. Configure a vertical scaling policy based on performance metrics.
choices.textZh: 启动 Amazon MemoryDB 集群并使用分层可导航小世界 (HNSW) 算法配置索引。根据性能指标配置垂直扩展策略。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Launch an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL cluster and configure the index by using the Inverted File with Flat Compression (IVFFlat) algorithm. Configure the instance class to scale to a larger size when the load increases.
choices.textZh: 启动 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 集群并使用平面压缩倒排文件 (IVFFlat) 算法配置索引。配置实例类以在负载增加时扩展到更大的大小。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Launch an Amazon DocumentDB cluster that has an IVFFlat index and a high probe value. Configure connections to the cluster as a replica set. Distribute reads to replica instances.
choices.textZh: 启动具有 IVFFlat 索引和高探测值的 Amazon DocumentDB 集群。将与集群的连接配置为副本集。将读取分发到副本实例。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在创建一个检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 生成市场活动摘要。该应用程序依赖于矢量数据库，该数据库存储索引计数较低的小型专有数据集。应用程序必须执行相似性搜索。 Amazon Bedrock 模型的响应必须最大限度地提高准确性并保持高性能。该公司需要配置矢量数据库并将其与应用程序集成。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A healthcare company uses Amazon Bedrock to deploy an application that generates summaries of clinical documents. The application experiences inconsistent response quality with occasional factual hallucinations. Monthly costs exceed the company’s projections by 40%. A GenAI developer must implement a near real- time monitoring solution to detect hallucinations, identify abnormal token consumption, and provide early warnings of cost anomalies. The solution must require minimal custom development work and maintenance overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor InputTokenCount and OutputTokenCount metrics to detect anomalies. Store model invocation logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to identify potential hallucinations.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以监控 InputTokenCount 和 OutputTokenCount 指标以检测异常。将模型调用日志存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 AWS Glue 和 Amazon Athena 识别潜在的幻觉。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Run Amazon Bedrock evaluation jobs that use LLM-based judgments to detect hallucinations. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to track token usage. Create an AWS Lambda function to process CloudWatch metrics. Configure the Lambda function to send usage pattern notifications.
choices.textZh: 运行 Amazon Bedrock 评估作业，使用基于 LLM 的判断来检测幻觉。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 以跟踪令牌使用情况。创建 AWS Lambda 函数来处理 CloudWatch 指标。配置 Lambda 函数以发送使用模式通知。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock to store model invocation logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable text output logging. Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to run contextual grounding checks to detect hallucinations. Create Amazon CloudWatch anomaly detection alarms for token usage metrics.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 以将模型调用日志存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。启用文本输出日志记录。配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以运行上下文接地检查以检测幻觉。为令牌使用指标创建 Amazon CloudWatch 异常检测警报。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use AWS CloudTrail to log all Amazon Bedrock API calls. Create a custom dashboard in Amazon QuickSight to visualize token usage patterns. Use Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to detect quality drift in generated summaries.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录所有 Amazon Bedrock API 调用。在 Amazon QuickSight 中创建自定义控制面板以可视化令牌使用模式。使用 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor 检测生成的摘要中的质量偏差。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 部署一个生成临床文档摘要的应用程序。该应用程序的响应质量不一致，偶尔会出现事实幻觉。每月成本超出公司预计 40%。 GenAI 开发人员必须实施近乎实时的监控解决方案来检测幻觉、识别异常代币消耗并提供成本异常的早期预警。该解决方案必须需要最少的定制开发工作和维护开销。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A financial services company uses multiple foundation models (FMs) through Amazon Bedrock for its generative AI (GenAI) applications. To comply with a new regulation for GenAI use with sensitive financial data, the company needs a token management solution. The token management solution must proactively alert when applications approach model-specific token limits. The solution must also process more than 5,000 requests each minute and maintain token usage metrics to allocate costs across business units. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Develop model-specific tokenizers in an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to estimate token usage before sending requests to Amazon Bedrock. Configure the Lambda function to publish metrics to Amazon CloudWatch and trigger alarms when requests approach thresholds. Store detailed token usage in Amazon DynamoDB to report costs.
choices.textZh: 在 AWS Lambda 函数中开发特定于模型的分词器。配置 Lambda 函数以在向 Amazon Bedrock 发送请求之前估计令牌使用情况。配置 Lambda 函数以将指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch 并在请求接近阈值时触发警报。将详细的令牌使用情况存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中以报告成本。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement Amazon Bedrock Guardrails with token quota policies. Capture metrics on rejected requests. Configure Amazon EventBridge rules to trigger notifications based on Amazon Bedrock Guardrails metrics. Use Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize token usage trends across models.
choices.textZh: 使用令牌配额策略实施 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails。捕获被拒绝请求的指标。配置 Amazon EventBridge 规则以根据 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 指标触发通知。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 仪表板可视化跨模型的令牌使用趋势。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy an Amazon SQS dead-letter queue for failed requests. Configure an AWS Lambda function to analyze token-related failures. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to generate reports on token usage patterns based on error logs from Amazon Bedrock API responses.
choices.textZh: 为失败的请求部署 Amazon SQS 死信队列。配置 AWS Lambda 函数来分析与令牌相关的故障。使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 根据 Amazon Bedrock API 响应的错误日志生成有关令牌使用模式的报告。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon API Gateway to create a proxy for all Amazon Bedrock API calls. Configure request throttling based on custom usage plans with predefined token quotas. Configure API Gateway to reject requests that will exceed token limits.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 为所有 Amazon Bedrock API 调用创建代理。根据具有预定义令牌配额的自定义使用计划配置请求限制。配置 API Gateway 以拒绝超出令牌限制的请求。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司通过 Amazon Bedrock 将多个基础模型 (FM) 用于其生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序。为了遵守 GenAI 使用敏感财务数据的新规定，该公司需要一个代币管理解决方案。当应用程序接近特定于模型的令牌限制时，令牌管理解决方案必须主动发出警报。该解决方案还必须每分钟处理超过 5,000 个请求，并维护令牌使用指标以在各个业务部门之间分配成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company uses Amazon Bedrock to build a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system. The RAG system uses an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases that is based on an Amazon S3 bucket as the data source for emergency news video content. The system retrieves transcripts, archived reports, and related documents from the S3 bucket. The RAG system uses state-of-the-art embedding models and a high-performing retrieval setup. However, users report slow responses and irrelevant results, which cause decreased user satisfaction. The company notices that vector searches are evaluating too many documents across too many content types and over long periods of time. The company determines that the underlying models will not benefit from additional fine-tuning. The company must improve retrieval accuracy by applying smarter constraints and wants a solution that requires minimal changes to the existing architecture. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enhance embeddings by using a domain-adapted model that is specifically trained on emergency news content for improved vector similarity.
choices.textZh: 通过使用专门针对紧急新闻内容进行训练的领域适应模型来增强嵌入，以提高矢量相似性。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Migrate to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use vector fields and metadata filters to define the scope of results retrieval.
choices.textZh: 迁移到 Amazon OpenSearch Service。使用向量字段和元数据过滤器来定义结果检索的范围。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Enable metadata-aware filtering within the Amazon Bedrock knowledge base by indexing S3 object metadata.
choices.textZh: 通过对 S3 对象元数据建立索引，在 Amazon Bedrock 知识库中启用元数据感知过滤。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Migrate to an Amazon Q Business index to perform structured metadata filtering and document categorization during retrieval.
choices.textZh: 迁移到 Amazon Q Business 索引以在检索期间执行结构化元数据过滤和文档分类。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建检索增强生成 (RAG) 系统。 RAG 系统使用基于 Amazon S3 存储桶的 Amazon Bedrock 知识库作为紧急新闻视频内容的数据源。系统从 S3 存储桶中检索文字记录、存档报告和相关文档。 RAG 系统使用最先进的嵌入模型和高性能检索设置。然而，用户反映响应缓慢且结果不相关，导致用户满意度下降。该公司注意到，矢量搜索正在评估太多内容类型和长时间的文档。该公司确定基础模型不会从额外的微调中受益。该公司必须通过应用更智能的约束来提高检索准确性，并希望找到一种需要对现有架构进行最少更改的解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A publishing company is developing a chat assistant that uses a containerized large language model (LLM) that runs on Amazon SageMaker AI. The architecture consists of an Amazon API Gateway REST API that routes user requests to an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function invokes a SageMaker AI real-time endpoint that hosts the LLM. Users report uneven response times. Analytics show that a high number of chats are abandoned after 2 seconds of waiting for the first token. The company wants a solution to ensure that p95 latency is under 800 ms for interactive requests to the chat assistant. Which combination of solutions will meet this requirement? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enable model preload upon container startup. Implement dynamic batching to process multiple user requests together in a single inference pass.
choices.textZh: 在容器启动时启用模型预加载。实现动态批处理以在单个推理过程中一起处理多个用户请求。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Select a larger GPU instance type for the SageMaker AI endpoint. Set the minimum number of instances to 0. Continue to perform per-request processing. Lazily load model weights on the first request.
choices.textZh: 为 SageMaker AI 终端节点选择更大的 GPU 实例类型。将最小实例数设置为0。继续执行每个请求的处理。在第一个请求时延迟加载模型权重。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Switch to a multi-model endpoint. Use lazy loading without request batching.
choices.textZh: 切换到多模型端点。使用延迟加载而不进行请求批处理。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Set the minimum number of instances to greater than 0. Enable response streaming.
choices.textZh: 将最小实例数设置为大于 0。启用响应流式传输。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Switch to Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference for all requests. Store requests in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set the minimum number of instances to 0.
choices.textZh: 将所有请求切换到 Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference。将请求存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。将最小实例数设置为 0。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家出版公司正在开发一款聊天助手，该助手使用在 Amazon SageMaker AI 上运行的容器化大型语言模型 (LLM)。该架构由 Amazon API Gateway REST API 组成，该 API 将用户请求路由到 AWS Lambda 函数。 Lambda 函数调用托管 LLM 的 SageMaker AI 实时端点。用户报告响应时间不均匀。分析显示，在等待第一个令牌 2 秒后，大量聊天被放弃。该公司希望有一个解决方案能够确保向聊天助手发出交互式请求时 p95 延迟低于 800 毫秒。哪种解决方案组合可以满足此要求？ （选择两项。）

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company is building a customer support application that retrieves relevant financial regulation documents from a database based on semantic similarity to user queries. The application must integrate with Amazon Bedrock to generate responses. The application must search documents in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. The application must filter documents by metadata such as publication date, regulatory agency, and document type. The database stores approximately 10 million document embeddings. To minimize operational overhead, the company wants a solution that minimizes management and maintenance effort while providing low-latency responses for real-time customer interactions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Serverless to provide vector search capabilities and metadata filtering. Integrate with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to enable Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) using an Anthropic Claude foundation model.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless 提供矢量搜索功能和元数据过滤。与 Amazon Bedrock 知识库集成，以使用 Anthropic Claude 基础模型启用检索增强生成 (RAG)。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database with the pgvector extension. Store embeddings and metadata in tables. Use SQL queries for similarity search and send results to Amazon Bedrock for response generation.
choices.textZh: 使用 pgvector 扩展部署 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库。将嵌入和元数据存储在表中。使用 SQL 查询进行相似性搜索，并将结果发送到 Amazon Bedrock 以生成响应。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon S3 Vectors to configure a vector index and non-filterable metadata fields. Integrate S3 Vectors with Amazon Bedrock for RAG.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon S3 Vectors 配置向量索引和不可过滤的元数据字段。将 S3 矢量与 RAG 的 Amazon Bedrock 集成。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Set up an Amazon Neptune Analytics database with a vector index. Use graph-based retrieval and Amazon Bedrock for response generation.
choices.textZh: 设置具有矢量索引的 Amazon Neptune Analytics 数据库。使用基于图形的检索和 Amazon Bedrock 来生成响应。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在构建一个客户支持应用程序，该应用程序根据与用户查询的语义相似性从数据库中检索相关的金融监管文档。该应用程序必须与 Amazon Bedrock 集成才能生成响应。申请必须搜索英语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语的文档。应用程序必须按元数据（例如发布日期、监管机构和文档类型）过滤文档。该数据库存储了大约 1000 万个文档嵌入。为了最大限度地减少运营开销，该公司希望有一种解决方案能够最大限度地减少管理和维护工作，同时为实时客户交互提供低延迟响应。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A healthcare company is developing a document management system that stores medical research papers in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs a comprehensive metadata framework to improve search precision for a GenAI application. The metadata must include document timestamps, author information, and research domain classifications. The solution must maintain a consistent metadata structure across all uploaded documents and allow foundation models (FMs) to understand document context without accessing full content. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Store document timestamps in Amazon S3 system metadata. Use S3 object tags for domain classification. Implement custom user-defined metadata to store author information.
choices.textZh: 将文档时间戳存储在 Amazon S3 系统元数据中。使用 S3 对象标签进行域分类。实现自定义用户定义的元数据来存储作者信息。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Set up S3 Object Lock with legal holds to track document timestamps. Use S3 object tags for author information. Implement S3 access points for domain classification.
choices.textZh: 设置具有合法保留的 S3 对象锁来跟踪文档时间戳。使用 S3 对象标签获取作者信息。实施 S3 访问点进行域分类。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use S3 Inventory reports to track timestamps. Create S3 access points for domain classification. Store author information in S3 Storage Lens dashboards.
choices.textZh: 使用 S3 清单报告来跟踪时间戳。创建用于域分类的 S3 访问点。将作者信息存储在 S3 Storage Lens 仪表板中。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use custom user-defined metadata to store author information. Use S3 Object Lock retention periods for timestamps. Use S3 Event Notifications for domain classification.
choices.textZh: 使用自定义的用户定义元数据来存储作者信息。使用 S3 对象锁定时间戳保留期。使用 S3 事件通知进行域分类。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司正在开发一种文档管理系统，该系统将医学研究论文存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该公司需要一个全面的元数据框架来提高 GenAI 应用程序的搜索精度。元数据必须包括文档时间戳、作者信息和研究领域分类。该解决方案必须在所有上传的文档中保持一致的元数据结构，并允许基础模型 (FM) 在不访问完整内容的情况下了解文档上下文。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is building a real-time voice assistant system to assist customer service representatives during customer calls. The system must convert audio calls to text with end-to-end latency of less than 500 ms. The system must use generative AI (GenAI) to produce response suggestions. Human supervisors must be able to rate the system's suggestions during a live customer call. The company must store all customer interactions to comply with auditing policies. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use the Amazon Transcribe streaming API with standard settings to convert speech to text. Use Amazon Bedrock batch processing to perform inference. Store call recordings and metadata in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to manage the storage.
choices.textZh: 使用具有标准设置的 Amazon Transcribe 流 API 将语音转换为文本。使用 Amazon Bedrock 批处理来执行推理。将通话录音和元数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 S3 生命周期策略来管理存储。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use the Amazon Transcribe streaming API with 100-ms audio chunks to optimize latency for the voice assistant. Call the Amazon Bedrock InvokeModelWithResponseStream operation to process client inquiries in real time. Store supervisor ratings in an Amazon DynamoDB table.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 流 API 和 100 毫秒音频块来优化语音助手的延迟。调用 Amazon Bedrock InvokeModelWithResponseStream 操作来实时处理客户端查询。将主管评级存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Transcribe batch processing to perform post-call analysis. Configure AWS Lambda functions to generate responses by using the Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel operation. Use Amazon CloudWatch to log supervisor feedback.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 批处理执行调用后分析。配置 AWS Lambda 函数以使用 Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel 操作生成响应。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 记录主管反馈。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon Transcribe to convert speech to text and to perform real-time analytics. Use Amazon Comprehend to perform sentiment analysis. Use Amazon SQS to queue processing tasks. Run the Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel operation to generate responses.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 将语音转换为文本并执行实时分析。使用 Amazon Comprehend 执行情绪分析。使用 Amazon SQS 对处理任务进行排队。运行 Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel 操作以生成响应。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在构建实时语音助理系统，以在客户呼叫期间为客户服务代表提供帮助。系统必须将音频呼叫转换为文本，端到端延迟小于 500 毫秒。系统必须使用生成式人工智能（GenAI）来产生响应建议。人类主管必须能够在实时客户通话期间对系统的建议进行评分。公司必须存储所有客户交互以遵守审核政策。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company wants to develop an Amazon Bedrock application that gives analysts the ability to query quarterly earnings reports and financial statements. The financial documents are typically 5–100 pages long and contain both tabular data and text. The application must provide contextually accurate responses that preserve the relationship between financial metrics and their explanatory text. To support accurate and scalable retrieval, the application must incorporate document segmentation and context management strategies. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use a direct model invocation approach that uses Anthropic Claude to process each financial document as a single input. Use fine-tuned prompts that instruct the model to parse tables and text separately.
choices.textZh: 使用直接模型调用方法，该方法使用 Anthropic Claude 将每个财务文档作为单个输入进行处理。使用微调的提示指示模型分别解析表格和文本。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to create a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application that retrieves relevant information from contextually chunked sections of financial documents. Segment documents based on their structural layout. Include citations that reference the original source materials.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库创建检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用程序，该应用程序从财务文档的上下文分块部分检索相关信息。根据文档的结构布局对文档进行分段。包括引用原始资料的引文。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy an Amazon Bedrock agent that has an action group that calls custom AWS Lambda functions to analyze financial documents. Configure the Lambda functions to perform fixed-size chunking when a user submits a query about financial metrics.
choices.textZh: 部署一个 Amazon Bedrock 代理，该代理具有一个调用自定义 AWS Lambda 函数来分析财务文档的操作组。配置 Lambda 函数以在用户提交有关财务指标的查询时执行固定大小的分块。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create one specialized Amazon Bedrock application that is optimized for structured data. Create a second application that is optimized for unstructured data. Configure each application to use a tailored chunking strategy that is suited to the application's content type. Implement logic to link queries to the appropriate sources.
choices.textZh: 创建一款专门针对结构化数据进行优化的 Amazon Bedrock 应用程序。创建针对非结构化数据优化的第二个应用程序。配置每个应用程序以使用适合应用程序内容类型的定制分块策略。实现逻辑以将查询链接到适当的源。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司希望开发一款 Amazon Bedrock 应用程序，使分析师能够查询季度收益报告和财务报表。财务文件通常有 5-100 页长，包含表格数据和文本。应用程序必须提供上下文准确的响应，以保留财务指标与其解释文本之间的关系。为了支持准确且可扩展的检索，应用程序必须结合文档分段和上下文管理策略。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: An ecommerce company operates a global product recommendation system that needs to switch between multiple foundation models (FM) in Amazon Bedrock based on regulations, cost optimization, and performance requirements. The company must apply custom controls based on proprietary business logic, including dynamic cost thresholds, AWS Region-specific compliance rules, and real-time A/B testing across multiple FMs. The system must be able to switch between FMs without deploying new code. The system must route user requests based on complex rules including user tier, transaction value, regulatory zone, and real-time cost metrics that change hourly and require immediate propagation across thousands of concurrent requests. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy an AWS Lambda function that uses environment variables to store routing rules and Amazon Bedrock FM IDs. Use the Lambda console to update the environment variables when business requirements change. Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to read request parameters to make routing decisions.
choices.textZh: 部署一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数使用环境变量来存储路由规则和 Amazon Bedrock FM ID。当业务需求发生变化时，使用 Lambda 控制台更新环境变量。配置 Amazon API Gateway REST API 以读取请求参数以做出路由决策。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy Amazon API Gateway REST API request transformation templates to implement routing logic based on request attributes. Store Amazon Bedrock FM endpoints as REST API stage variables. Update the variables when the system switches between models.
choices.textZh: 部署 Amazon API Gateway REST API 请求转换模板以实现基于请求属性的路由逻辑。将 Amazon Bedrock FM 终端节点存储为 REST API 阶段变量。当系统在模型之间切换时更新变量。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure an AWS Lambda function to fetch routing configurations from the AWS AppConfig Agent for each user request. Run business logic in the Lambda function to select the appropriate FM for each request. Expose the FM through a single Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoint.
choices.textZh: 配置 AWS Lambda 函数以针对每个用户请求从 AWS AppConfig 代理获取路由配置。在 Lambda 函数中运行业务逻辑，为每个请求选择适当的 FM。通过单个 Amazon API Gateway REST API 终端节点公开 FM。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda authorizers for an Amazon API Gateway REST API to evaluate routing rules that are stored in AWS AppConfig. Return authorization contexts based on business logic. Route requests to model-specific Lambda functions for each Amazon Bedrock FM.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway REST API 的 AWS Lambda 授权方来评估存储在 AWS AppConfig 中的路由规则。根据业务逻辑返回授权上下文。将请求路由到每个 Amazon Bedrock FM 的特定于模型的 Lambda 函数。
