categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家电子商务公司运营着一个全球产品推荐系统，该系统需要根据法规、成本优化和性能要求在 Amazon Bedrock 中的多个基础模型 (FM) 之间切换。公司必须应用基于专有业务逻辑的自定义控制，包括动态成本阈值、AWS 区域特定的合规性规则以及跨多个 FM 的实时 A/B 测试。系统必须能够在 FM 之间切换，而无需部署新代码。系统必须根据复杂的规则来路由用户请求，这些规则包括用户层、交易价值、监管区域和每小时变化的实时成本指标，并且需要在数千个并发请求中立即传播。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company upgraded its Amazon Bedrock–powered foundation model (FM) that supports a multilingual customer service assistant. After the upgrade, the assistant exhibited inconsistent behavior across languages. The assistant began generating different responses in some languages when presented with identical questions. The company needs a solution to detect and address similar problems for future updates. The evaluation must be completed within 45 minutes for all supported languages. The evaluation must process at least 15,000 test conversations in parallel. The evaluation process must be fully automated and integrated into the CI/CD pipeline. The solution must block deployment if quality thresholds are not met. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a distributed traffic simulation framework that sends translation-heavy workloads to the assistant in multiple languages simultaneously. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor latency, concurrency, and throughput. Run simulations before production releases to identify infrastructure bottlenecks.
choices.textZh: 创建一个分布式交通模拟框架，以多种语言同时向助手发送翻译繁重的工作负载。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标监控延迟、 并发性和吞吐量。在生产发布之前运行模拟以识别基础设施瓶颈。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy the assistant in multiple AWS Regions with Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing and AWS Global Accelerator to improve global performance. Store multilingual conversation logs in Amazon S3. Perform weekly post-deployment audits to review consistency.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由和 AWS Global Accelerator 在多个 AWS 区域部署助手，以提高全局性能。将多语言对话日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。每周执行部署后审核以审查一致性。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create a pre-processing pipeline that normalizes all incoming messages into a consistent format before sending the messages to the assistant. Apply rule-based checks to flag potential hallucinations in the outputs. Focus evaluation on normalized text to simplify testing across languages.
choices.textZh: 创建一个预处理管道，在将消息发送给助手之前将所有传入消息标准化为一致的格式。应用基于规则的检查来标记输出中潜在的幻觉。将评估重点放在规范化文本上，以简化跨语言测试。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Set up standardized multilingual test conversations with identical meaning. Run the test conversations in parallel by using Amazon Bedrock model evaluation jobs. Apply similarity and hallucination thresholds. Integrate the process into the CI/CD pipeline to block releases that fail.
choices.textZh: 设置具有相同含义的标准化多语言测试对话。使用 Amazon Bedrock 模型评估作业并行运行测试对话。应用相似性和幻觉阈值。将流程集成到 CI/CD 管道中以阻止失败的发布。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家公司升级了其由 Amazon Bedrock 驱动的基础模型 (FM)，该模型支持多语言客户服务助理。升级后，助手在不同语言之间表现出不一致的行为。当提出相同的问题时，助理开始用某些语言做出不同的回答。该公司需要一个解决方案来检测和解决类似问题，以便将来进行更新。对于所有支持的语言，评估必须在 45 分钟内完成。评估必须并行处理至少 15,000 个测试对话。评估过程必须完全自动化并集成到 CI/CD 管道中。如果未达到质量阈值，解决方案必须阻止部署。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A financial technology company is using Amazon Bedrock to build an assessment system for the company’s customer service AI assistant. The AI assistant must provide financial recommendations that are factually accurate, compliant with financial regulations, and conversationally appropriate. The company needs to combine automated quality evaluations at scale with targeted human reviews of critical interactions. What solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure a pipeline in which financial experts manually score all responses for accuracy, compliance, and conversational quality. Use Amazon SageMaker notebooks to analyze results to identify improvement areas.
choices.textZh: 配置一个管道，让财务专家手动对所有回复的准确性、合规性和对话质量进行评分。使用 Amazon SageMaker 笔记本分析结果以确定需要改进的地方。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock evaluations that use Anthropic Claude Sonnet as a judge model to assess response accuracy and appropriateness. Configure custom Amazon Bedrock guardrails to check responses for compliance with financial policies. Add Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) human reviews for flagged critical interactions.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 评估，使用 Anthropic Claude Sonnet 作为判断模型来评估响应的准确性和适当性。配置自定义 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以检查响应是否符合财务政策。添加 Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) 人工评论以标记关键交互。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an Amazon Lex bot to manage customer service interactions. Configure AWS Lambda functions to check responses against a static compliance database. Configure intents that call the Lambda functions. Add an additional intent to collect end-user reviews.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon Lex 自动程序来管理客户服务交互。配置 AWS Lambda 函数以根据静态合规性数据库检查响应。配置调用 Lambda 函数的意图。添加额外的意图来收集最终用户评论。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure Amazon CloudWatch to monitor response patterns from the AI assistant. Configure CloudWatch alerts for potential compliance violations. Establish a team of human evaluators to review flagged interactions.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch 以监控 AI 助手的响应模式。配置 CloudWatch 警报以发现潜在的合规性违规行为。建立一个人类评估员团队来审查标记的交互。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家金融科技公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 为公司的客户服务 AI 助理构建评估系统。人工智能助手必须提供真实准确、符合金融法规且适合对话的财务建议。该公司需要将大规模的自动化质量评估与对关键交互的有针对性的人工审查结合起来。什么解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A specialty coffee company has a mobile app that generates personalized coffee roast profiles by using Amazon Bedrock with a three-stage prompt chain. The prompt chain converts user inputs into structured metadata, retrieves relevant logs for coffee roasts, and generates a personalized roast recommendation for each customer. Users in multiple AWS Regions report inconsistent roast recommendations for identical inputs, slow inference during the retrieval step, and unsafe recommendations such as brewing at excessively high temperatures. The company must improve the stability of outputs for repeated inputs. The company must also improve app performance and the safety of the app's outputs. The updated solution must ensure 99.5% output consistency for identical inputs and achieve inference latency of less than 1 second. The solution must also block unsafe or hallucinated recommendations by using validated safety controls. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy Amazon Bedrock with provisioned throughput to stabilize inference latency. Apply Amazon Bedrock guardrails that have semantic denial rules to block unsafe outputs. Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to manage prompts by using approval workflows.
choices.textZh: 使用预配置吞吐量部署 Amazon Bedrock 以稳定推理延迟。应用具有语义拒绝规则的 Amazon Bedrock 护栏来阻止不安全的输出。使用 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 通过审批工作流程来管理提示。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Agents to manage chaining. Log model inputs and outputs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use logs from Amazon CloudWatch to perform A/B testing for prompt versions.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 代理来管理链接。将模型输入和输出记录到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 中的日志对提示版本执行 A/B 测试。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Cache prompt results in Amazon ElastiCache. Use AWS Lambda functions to pre-process metadata and to trace end-to-end latency. Use AWS X-Ray to identify and remediate performance bottlenecks.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon ElastiCache 中缓存提示结果。使用 AWS Lambda 函数预处理元数据并跟踪端到端延迟。使用 AWS X-Ray 识别并修复性能瓶颈。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon Kendra to improve roast log retrieval accuracy. Store normalized prompt metadata within Amazon DynamoDB. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate multi-step prompts.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Kendra 提高烘焙日志检索准确性。在 Amazon DynamoDB 中存储标准化提示元数据。使用 AWS Step Functions 编排多步骤提示。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家精品咖啡公司拥有一款移动应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 和三阶段提示链生成个性化的咖啡烘焙配置文件。提示链将用户输入转换为结构化元数据，检索咖啡烘焙的相关日志，并为每个客户生成个性化的烘焙推荐。多个 AWS 区域的用户报告了相同输入的烘焙建议不一致、检索步骤期间推理缓慢以及不安全的建议（例如在过高的温度下冲泡）。公司必须提高重复投入产出的稳定性。公司还必须提高应用程序性能和应用程序输出的安全性。更新后的解决方案必须确保相同输入的输出一致性达到 99.5%，并实现推理延迟小于 1 秒。该解决方案还必须通过使用经过验证的安全控制来阻止不安全或幻觉的建议。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A GenAI developer is building a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)-based customer support application that uses Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs). The application needs to process 50 GB of historical customer conversations that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket as JSON files. The application must use the processed data as its retrieval corpus. The application’s data processing workflow must extract relevant data from customer support documents, remove customer personally identifiable information (PII), and generate embeddings for vector storage. The processing workflow must be cost-effective and must finish within 4 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda and Amazon Comprehend to process files in parallel, remove PII, and call Amazon Bedrock APIs to generate vectors. Configure Lambda concurrency limits and memory settings to optimize throughput.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 和 Amazon Comprehend 并行处理文件、删除 PII 并调用 Amazon Bedrock API 生成向量。配置 Lambda 并发限制和内存设置以优化吞吐量。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an AWS Glue ETL job to run PII detection scripts on the data. Use Amazon SageMaker Processing to run the HuggingFaceProcessor to generate embeddings by using a pre-trained model. Store the embeddings in Amazon OpenSearch Service.
choices.textZh: 创建 AWS Glue ETL 作业以对数据运行 PII 检测脚本。使用 Amazon SageMaker Processing 运行 HuggingFaceProcessor 以通过预训练模型生成嵌入。将嵌入存储在 Amazon OpenSearch Service 中。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy an Amazon EMR cluster that runs Apache Spark with user-defined functions (UDFs) that call Amazon Comprehend to detect PII. Use Amazon Bedrock APIs to generate vectors. Store outputs in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension.
choices.textZh: 部署一个运行 Apache Spark 的 Amazon EMR 集群，该集群具有调用 Amazon Comprehend 来检测 PII 的用户定义函数 (UDF)。使用 Amazon Bedrock API 生成矢量。使用 pgvector 扩展将输出存储在 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 中。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Implement a data processing pipeline that uses AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a workload that uses Amazon Comprehend to detect PII and Amazon Bedrock to generate embeddings. Directly integrate the workflow with Amazon OpenSearch Serverless to store vectors and provide similarity search capabilities.
choices.textZh: 实施一个数据处理管道，该管道使用 AWS Step Functions 来编排工作负载，该工作负载使用 Amazon Comprehend 检测 PII 并使用 Amazon Bedrock 生成嵌入。直接将工作流程与 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless 集成以存储向量并提供相似性搜索功能。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: GenAI 开发人员正在构建一个基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的客户支持应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM)。该应用程序需要处理 50 GB 的历史客户对话，这些对话以 JSON 文件形式存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。应用程序必须使用处理后的数据作为其检索语料库。应用程序的数据处理工作流程必须从客户支持文档中提取相关数据，删除客户个人身份信息 (PII)，并生成用于向量存储的嵌入。处理工作流程必须具有成本效益，并且必须在 4 小时内完成。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is building a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses Amazon Bedrock APIs to process complex customer inquiries. During peak usage periods, the application experiences intermittent API timeouts that cause issues such as broken response chunks and delayed data delivery. The application struggles to ensure that prompts remain within token limits when handling complex customer inquiries of varying lengths. Users have reported truncated inputs and incomplete responses. The company has also observed foundation model (FM) invocation failures. The company needs a retry strategy that automatically handles transient service errors and prevents overwhelming Amazon Bedrock during peak usage periods. The strategy must also adapt to changing service availability and support response streaming and token-aware request handling. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Implement a standard retry strategy that uses a 1-second fixed delay between attempts and a 3-retry maximum for all errors. Handle streaming response timeouts by restarting streams. Cap token usage for each session.
choices.textZh: 实施标准重试策略，该策略在尝试之间使用 1 秒固定延迟，并对所有错误最多重试 3 次。通过重新启动流来处理流响应超时。每个会话的令牌使用上限。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement an adaptive retry strategy that uses exponential backoff with jitter and a circuit breaker pattern that temporarily disables retries when error rates exceed a predefined threshold. Implement a streaming response handler that monitors for chunk delivery timeouts. Configure the handler to buffer successfully received chunks and intelligently resume streaming from the last received chunk when connections are re-established.
choices.textZh: 实施自适应重试策略，该策略使用带有抖动的指数退避和断路器模式，当错误率超过预定义阈值时，该断路器模式会暂时禁用重试。实施 流响应处理程序，用于监视块传送超时。配置处理程序以缓冲成功接收的块，并在重新建立连接时智能地从上次接收的块恢复流式传输。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use the AWS SDK to configure a retry strategy in standard mode. Wrap Amazon Bedrock API calls in try-catch blocks that handle timeout exceptions. Return cached completions for failed streaming requests. Enforce a global token limit for all users. Add jitter-based retry logic and lightweight token trimming for each request. Resume broken streams by requesting only missing chunks from the point of failure. Maintain a small in-memory buffer of the most recent chunks.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS 开发工具包在标准模式下配置重试策略。将 Amazon Bedrock API 调用包装在处理超时异常的 try-catch 块中。返回失败的流请求的缓存完成结果。对所有用户实施全局令牌限制。为每个请求添加基于抖动的重试逻辑和轻量级令牌修剪。通过仅请求从故障点丢失的块来恢复损坏的流。维护最新块的小型内存缓冲区。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Set Amazon Bedrock client request timeouts to 30 seconds. Implement client-side load shedding. Buffer partial results and stop new requests when application performance degrades. Set static token usage caps for all requests. Configure exponential backoff retries, dynamic chunk sizing, and context- aware token limits.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock 客户端请求超时设置为 30 秒。实施客户端减载。当应用程序性能下降时，缓冲部分结果并停止新请求。为所有请求设置静态令牌使用上限。配置指数退避重试、动态块大小调整和上下文感知令牌限制。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在构建生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock API 来处理复杂的客户查询。在高峰使用期间，应用程序会遇到间歇性 API 超时，从而导致响应块损坏和数据传输延迟等问题。在处理不同长度的复杂客户查询时，应用程序很难确保提示保持在令牌限制内。用户报告了输入被截断和响应不完整。该公司还观察到基础模型 (FM) 调用失败。该公司需要一种重试策略，能够自动处理暂时性服务错误并防止 Amazon Bedrock 在高峰使用期间不堪重负。该策略还必须适应不断变化的服务可用性，并支持响应流和令牌感知请求处理。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A healthcare company wants to develop a proof-of-concept application that uses Amazon Bedrock to automatically summarize medical documents. The company has 3 weeks to validate the application's accuracy. The application must comply with the company’s data privacy policies. The application must include metrics to evaluate summarization accuracy and processing time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a dataset that includes 50-100 anonymized patient records. Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with a secure knowledge base. Use a judge model to evaluate accuracy metrics across three foundation models (FMs).
choices.textZh: 创建一个包含 50-100 条匿名患者记录的数据集。使用安全的知识库实施检索增强生成 (RAG)。使用判断模型评估三个基础模型 (FM) 的准确性指标。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Fine-tune a single foundation model (FM) on patient records. Deploy the FM on Amazon Bedrock. Use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to configure the FM as an agent. Conduct user testing on 500 company staff members.
choices.textZh: 微调患者记录上的单一基础模型 (FM)。在 Amazon Bedrock 上部署 FM。使用 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 将 FM 配置为代理。对 500 名公司员工进行用户测试。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Select the most powerful available AWS foundation model (FM). Create a chat interface by using Converse APIs. Test the application on 50-100 actual patient records by using only qualitative feedback from stakeholders. Use a custom web interface to gather real-world performance metrics.
choices.textZh: 选择最强大的可用 AWS 基础模型 (FM)。使用 Converse API 创建聊天界面。仅使用利益相关者的定性反馈，在 50-100 个实际患者记录上测试应用程序。使用自定义 Web 界面来收集实际性能指标。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use the Strands SDK to deploy multiple agents that connect to multiple knowledge bases that contain specialized medical documents. Compare the responses of the agents. Evaluate the integration of the agents with the company's existing systems.
choices.textZh: 使用 Strands SDK 部署多个代理，这些代理连接到包含专门医疗文档的多个知识库。比较代理的响应。评估代理与公司现有系统的集成。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司想要开发一款概念验证应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 自动汇总医疗文档。该公司有 3 周的时间来验证该应用程序的准确性。该应用程序必须遵守公司的数据隐私政策。应用程序必须包含评估摘要准确性和处理时间的指标。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is planning to deploy multiple generative AI (GenAI) applications to five independent business units that operate in multiple countries in Europe and the Americas. Each application uses Amazon Bedrock Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns with business unit-specific knowledge bases that store terabytes of unstructured data. The company must establish well-architected, standardized components for security controls, observability practices, and deployment patterns across all the GenAI applications. The components must be reusable, versioned, and governed consistently. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoints for the GenAI applications. Deploy common security, observability, and RAG patterns based on the AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens in standardized AWS CloudFormation templates. Use CloudFormation Guard after deployment to validate policy compliance in each business unit.
choices.textZh: 为 GenAI 应用程序配置 Amazon API Gateway REST API 终端节点。基于标准化 AWS CloudFormation 模板中的 AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens 部署常见的安全性、可观察性和 RAG 模式。部署后使用 CloudFormation Guard 验证每个业务部门的策略合规性。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create standardized AWS CloudFormation templates to implement security, observability, and RAG patterns based on the AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens. Establish a centralized repository for version control. Integrate a CI/CD pipeline with CloudFormation Guard to enforce consistent and repeatable deployments across business units.
choices.textZh: 创建标准化 AWS CloudFormation 模板，以基于 AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens 实施安全性、可观察性和 RAG 模式。建立集中的版本控制存储库。将 CI/CD 管道与 CloudFormation Guard 集成，以在各个业务部门实施一致且可重复的部署。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use AWS Service Catalog to define standardized portfolios and versioned products for each business unit. Use the portfolios to enforce security, observability, and RAG patterns based on the AWS Well- Architected Generative AI Lens. Require business units to use the Service Catalog console to deploy resources.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Service Catalog 为每个业务部门定义标准化产品组合和版本化产品。使用该组合基于 AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens 来实施安全性、可观察性和 RAG 模式。要求业务部门使用Service Catalog控制台来部署资源。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Document security controls, observability requirements, and RAG patterns based on the AWS Well- Architected Generative AI Lens in a shared design document. Use Amazon Macie to enforce deployment. Delegate implementation responsibility to each business unit.
choices.textZh: 在共享设计文档中记录基于 AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens 的安全控制、可观测性要求和 RAG 模式。使用 Amazon Macie 强制部署。将实施责任委托给各业务部门。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司计划向在欧洲和美洲多个国家/地区运营的五个独立业务部门部署多个生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序。每个应用程序都使用 Amazon Bedrock 检索增强生成 (RAG) 模式以及存储 TB 级非结构化数据的特定于业务部门的知识库。公司必须为所有 GenAI 应用程序的安全控制、可观察性实践和部署模式建立架构良好的标准化组件。组件必须是可重用的、版本化的并且受到一致的管理。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is designing a canary deployment strategy for a payment processing API. The system must support automated gradual traffic shifting between multiple Amazon Bedrock models based on real-time inference metrics, historical traffic patterns, and service health. The solution must be able to gradually increase traffic to new model versions. The system must increase traffic if metrics remain healthy and decrease traffic if the performance degrades below acceptable thresholds. The company needs to comprehensively monitor inference latency and error rates during the deployment phase. The company must also be able to halt deployments and revert to a previous model version without any manual intervention. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock with provisioned throughput to host model versions. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Step Functions workflow when a new model version is released. Configure the workflow to shift traffic in stages, wait for a specified time period, and invoke an AWS Lambda function to check Amazon CloudWatch performance metrics. Configure the workflow to increase traffic if metrics meet thresholds and to trigger a traffic rollback if performance metrics fall below thresholds.
choices.textZh: 使用具有预配置吞吐量的 Amazon Bedrock 来托管模型版本。配置 Amazon EventBridge 规则以在发布新模型版本时调用 AWS Step Functions 工作流程。配置工作流程以分阶段转移流量、等待指定时间段并调用 AWS Lambda 函数来检查 Amazon CloudWatch 性能指标。配置工作流以在指标满足阈值时增加流量，并在性能指标低于阈值时触发流量回滚。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda functions to invoke various Amazon Bedrock model versions. Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with stage variables and weighted routing to shift traffic gradually. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance. Use external logic to adjust traffic and roll back if performance falls below thresholds.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数调用各种 Amazon Bedrock 模型版本。使用具有阶段变量和加权路由的 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 来逐渐转移流量。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控性能。使用外部逻辑来调整流量并在性能低于阈值时回滚。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint variants to represent multiple Amazon Bedrock model versions. Use variant weights to shift traffic. Use Amazon CloudWatch and SageMaker Model Monitor to trigger rollbacks. Use EventBridge to roll back deployments if an anomaly is detected.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 终端节点变体来表示多个 Amazon Bedrock 模型版本。使用变量权重来转移流量。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 和 SageMaker Model Monitor 触发回滚。如果检测到异常，请使用 EventBridge 回滚部署。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to track inference logs. Configure OpenSearch Service to invoke an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to update Amazon Bedrock model endpoints to shift traffic based on inference logs.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 跟踪推理日志。配置 OpenSearch Service 以调用 AWS Systems Manager Automation Runbook 来更新 Amazon Bedrock 模型终端节点，从而根据推理日志转移流量。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在为支付处理 API 设计金丝雀部署策略。该系统必须支持基于实时推理指标、历史流量模式和服务运行状况在多个 Amazon Bedrock 模型之间自动逐步进行流量转移。该解决方案必须能够逐渐增加新车型版本的流量。如果指标保持健康，系统必须增加流量；如果性能下降到可接受的阈值以下，系统必须减少流量。公司需要在部署阶段全面监控推理延迟和错误率。该公司还必须能够停止部署并恢复到以前的模型版本，而无需任何手动干预。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is designing a solution that uses foundation models (FMs) to support multiple AI workloads. Some FMs must be invoked on demand and in real time. Other FMs require consistent high-throughput access for batch processing. The solution must support hybrid deployment patterns and run workloads across cloud infrastructure and on- premises infrastructure to comply with data residency and compliance requirements. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda to orchestrate low-latency FM inference by invoking FMs hosted on Amazon SageMaker AI asynchronous endpoints.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 通过调用 Amazon SageMaker AI 异步终端节点上托管的 FM 来协调低延迟 FM 推理。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure provisioned throughput in Amazon Bedrock to ensure consistent performance for high- volume workloads.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 中配置预置吞吐量，以确保大容量工作负载的一致性能。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy FMs to Amazon SageMaker AI endpoints with support for edge deployment by using Amazon SageMaker Neo. Orchestrate the FMs by using AWS Lambda to support hybrid deployment.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Neo 将 FM 部署到 Amazon SageMaker AI 终端节点，并支持边缘部署。使用 AWS Lambda 编排 FM 以支持混合部署。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock with auto-scaling to handle unpredictable traffic surges.
choices.textZh: 使用支持自动扩展的 Amazon Bedrock 来处理不可预测的流量激增。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to host and invoke the FMs.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker JumpStart 来托管和调用 FMs。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在设计一种使用基础模型 (FM) 来支持多种 AI 工作负载的解决方案。某些 FM 必须按需实时调用。其他 FM 需要一致的高吞吐量访问来进行批处理。该解决方案必须支持混合部署模式，并跨云基础设施和本地基础设施运行工作负载，以符合数据驻留和合规性要求。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

prompt: A company has set up Amazon Q Developer Pro licenses for all developers at the company. The company maintains a list of approved resources that developers must use when developing applications. The approved resources include internal libraries, proprietary algorithmic techniques, and sample code with approved styling. A new team of developers is using Amazon Q Developer to develop a new Java-based application. The company must ensure that the new developer team uses the company’s approved resources. The company does not want to make project-level modifications. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a Git repository that contains all of the approved internal libraries, algorithms, and code samples. Include this Git repository in the application project locally as part of the workspace. Ensure that the developers use the workspace context to retrieve suggestions from the Git repository.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 Git 存储库，其中包含所有批准的内部库、算法和代码示例。将此 Git 存储库作为工作区的一部分包含在本地应用程序项目中。确保开发人员使用工作区上下文从 Git 存储库检索建议。

choices.label: B
choices.text: In the project root folder, create a folder named amazonq/rules. Add the approved internal libraries, algorithms, and code samples to the folder.
choices.textZh: 在项目根文件夹中，创建一个名为 amazonq/rules 的文件夹。将批准的内部库、算法和代码示例添加到该文件夹​​。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create a folder in the application project named rules. Store the guidelines and code in the folder for Amazon Q Developer to reference for code suggestions.
choices.textZh: 在应用程序项目中创建一个名为rules 的文件夹。将指南和代码存储在文件夹中，供 Amazon Q Developer 参考代码建议。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an Amazon Q Developer customization that includes the approved data sources. Ensure that the developers use the customization to develop the application.
choices.textZh: 创建包含批准的数据源的 Amazon Q Developer 自定义。确保开发人员使用定制来开发应用程序。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司已为该公司的所有开发人员设置了 Amazon Q Developer Pro 许可证。该公司保留了开发人员在开发应用程序时必须使用的批准资源列表。批准的资源包括内部库、专有算法技术以及具有批准样式的示例代码。一个新的开发团队正在使用 Amazon Q Developer 开发一个新的基于 Java 的应用程序。公司必须确保新的开发团队使用公司批准的资源。该公司不想进行项目级别的修改。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company wants to select a new FM for its AI assistant. A GenAI developer needs to generate evaluation reports to help a data scientist assess the quality and safety of various foundation models FMs. The data scientist provides the GenAI developer with sample prompts for evaluation. The GenAI developer wants to use Amazon Bedrock to automate report generation and evaluation. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Combine the sample prompts into a single JSON document. Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base with the document. Write a prompt that asks the FM to generate a response to each sample prompt. Use the RetrieveAndGenerate API to generate a report for each model.
choices.textZh: 将示例提示合并到单个 JSON 文档中。使用该文档创建 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。编写一个提示，要求 FM 生成对每个示例提示的响应。使用 RetrieveAndGenerate API 为每个模型生成报告。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Combine the sample prompts into a single JSONL document. Store the document in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon Bedrock evaluation job that uses a judge model. Specify the S3 location as input and a different S3 location as output. Run an evaluation job for each FM and select the FM as the generator.
choices.textZh: 将示例提示合并到单个 JSONL 文档中。将文档存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。创建使用判断模型的 Amazon Bedrock 评估作业。将 S3 位置指定为输入，并将不同的 S3 位置指定为输出。为每个 FM 运行评估作业并选择 FM 作为生成器。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Combine the sample prompts into a single JSONL document. Store the document in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon Bedrock evaluation job that uses a judge model. Specify the S3 location as input and Amazon QuickSight as output. Run an evaluation job for each FM and select the FM as the evaluator.
choices.textZh: 将示例提示合并到单个 JSONL 文档中。将文档存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。创建使用判断模型的 Amazon Bedrock 评估作业。指定 S3 位置作为输入，指定 Amazon QuickSight 作为输出。为每个 FM 运行评估作业并选择 FM 作为评估者。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Combine the sample prompts into a single JSON document. Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base from the document. Create an Amazon Bedrock evaluation job that uses the retrieval and response generation evaluation type. Specify an Amazon S3 bucket as the output. Run an evaluation job for each FM.
choices.textZh: 将示例提示合并到单个 JSON 文档中。根据文档创建 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。创建使用检索和响应生成评估类型的 Amazon Bedrock 评估作业。指定 Amazon S3 存储桶作为输出。为每个 FM 运行评估作业。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家公司想要为其 AI 助手选择一个新的 FM。 GenAI 开发人员需要生成评估报告，以帮助数据科学家评估各种基础模型 FM 的质量和安全性。数据科学家为 GenAI 开发人员提供评估示例提示。 GenAI 开发人员希望使用 Amazon Bedrock 自动生成和评估报告。哪种解决方案可以满足这个要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company runs a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application that uses Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to perform regulatory compliance queries. The application uses the RetrieveAndGenerateStream API. The application retrieves relevant documents from a knowledge base that contains more than 50,000 regulatory documents, legal precedents, and policy updates. The RAG application is producing suboptimal responses because the initial retrieval often returns semantically similar but contextually irrelevant documents. The poor responses are causing model hallucinations and incorrect regulatory guidance. The company needs to improve the performance of the RAG application so it returns more relevant documents. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy an Amazon SageMaker endpoint to run a fine-tuned ranking model. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API to route requests. Configure the application to make requests through the REST API to rerank the results.
choices.textZh: 部署 Amazon SageMaker 终端节点以运行微调的排名模型。使用 Amazon API Gateway REST API 路由请求。配置应用程序以通过 REST API 发出请求以对结果进行重新排名。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Comprehend to classify documents and apply relevance scores. Integrate the RAG application’s reranking process with Amazon Textract to run document analysis. Use Amazon Neptune to perform graph-based relevance calculations.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 对文档进行分类并应用相关性分数。将 RAG 应用程序的重新排名流程与 Amazon Textract 集成以运行文档分析。使用 Amazon Neptune 执行基于图形的相关性计算。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Implement a retrieval pipeline that uses the Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases Retrieve API to perform initial document retrieval. Call the Amazon Bedrock Rerank API to rerank the results. Invoke the InvokeModelWithResponseStream operation to generate responses.
choices.textZh: 实施一个检索管道，该管道使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库检索 API 来执行初始文档检索。调用 Amazon Bedrock Rerank API 对结果进行重新排名。调用 InvokeModelWithResponseStream 操作生成响应。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use the latest Amazon reranker model through the reranking configuration within Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Use the model to improve document relevance scoring and to reorder results based on contextual assessments.
choices.textZh: 通过 Amazon Bedrock 知识库中的重新排名配置使用最新的 Amazon 重新排名模型。使用该模型改进文档相关性评分并根据上下文评估对结果重新排序。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司运行检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库来执行法规合规性查询。该应用程序使用 RetrieveAndGenerateStream API。该应用程序从包含 50,000 多个监管文件、法律先例和政策更新的知识库中检索相关文档。 RAG 应用程序产生次优响应，因为初始检索通常返回语义相似但上下文不相关的文档。糟糕的反应导致了模型幻觉和不正确的监管指导。该公司需要提高 RAG 应用程序的性能，以便返回更多相关文档。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这一要求？

prompt: A healthcare company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop a real-time patient care AI assistant to respond to queries for separate departments that handle clinical inquiries, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and insurance claims. The company wants to use a multi-agent architecture. The company must ensure that the AI assistant is scalable and can onboard new features for patients. The AI assistant must be able to handle thousands of parallel patient interactions. The company must ensure that patients receive appropriate domain-specific responses to queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Isolate data for each agent by using separate knowledge bases. Use IAM filtering to control access to each knowledge base. Deploy a supervisor agent to perform natural language intent classification on patient inquiries. Configure the supervisor agent to route queries to specialized collaborator agents to respond to department-specific queries. Configure each specialized collaborator agent to use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with the agent's department-specific knowledge base.
choices.textZh: 使用单独的知识库隔离每个代理的数据。使用 IAM 过滤来控制对每个知识库的访问。部署主管代理对患者询问进行自然语言意图分类。配置主管代理将查询路由到专门的协作代理以响应部门特定的查询。配置每个专业协作者代理以将检索增强生成 (RAG) 与代理的部门特定知识库结合使用。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create a separate supervisor agent for each department. Configure individual collaborator agents to perform natural language intent classification for each specialty domain within each department. Integrate each collaborator agent with department-specific knowledge bases only. Implement manual handoff processes between the supervisor agents.
choices.textZh: 为每个部门创建一个单独的主管代理。配置单独的协作代理以对每个部门内的每个专业领域执行自然语言意图分类。仅将每个协作代理与特定于部门的知识库集成。在主管代理之间实施手动切换流程。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Isolate data for each department in separate knowledge bases. Use IAM filtering to control access to each knowledge base. Deploy a single general-purpose agent. Configure multiple action groups within the general-purpose agent to perform specific department functions. Implement rule-based routing logic in the general-purpose agent instructions.
choices.textZh: 将每个部门的数据隔离在单独的知识库中。使用 IAM 过滤来控制对每个知识库的访问。部署单个通用代理。在通用代理内配置多个操作组以执行特定的部门功能。在通用代理指令中实现基于规则的路由逻辑。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Implement multiple independent supervisor agents that run in parallel to respond to patient inquiries for each department. Configure multiple collaborator agents for each supervisor agent. Integrate all agents with the same knowledge base. Use external routing logic to merge responses from multiple supervisor agents.
choices.textZh: 实施多个独立的主管代理，这些代理并行运行以响应每个部门的患者询问。为每个主管代理配置多个协作者代理。将所有代理与相同的知识库集成。使用外部路由逻辑合并来自多个主管代理的响应。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发实时患者护理 AI 助手，以响应处理临床查询、保险验证、预约安排和保险索赔的各个部门的查询。该公司希望使用多代理架构。公司必须确保人工智能助手具有可扩展性，并且能够为患者提供新功能。人工智能助手必须能够处理数千个并行的患者交互。公司必须确保患者收到针对特定领域的查询的适当答复。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A media company must use Amazon Bedrock to implement a robust governance process for AI-generated content. The company needs to manage hundreds of prompt templates. Multiple teams use the templates across multiple AWS Regions to generate content. The solution must provide version control with approval workflows that include notifications for pending reviews. The solution must also provide detailed audit trails that document prompt activities and consistent prompt parameterization to enforce quality standards. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock Studio prompt templates. Use Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to display prompt usage metrics. Store approval status in Amazon DynamoDB. Use AWS Lambda functions to enforce approvals.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock Studio 提示模板。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 仪表板显示提示使用指标。将审批状态存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。使用 AWS Lambda 函数强制执行批准。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to implement version control. Configure AWS CloudTrail for audit logging. Use AWS Identity and Access Management policies to control approval permissions. Create parameterized prompt templates by specifying variables.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 实施版本控制。配置 AWS CloudTrail 以进行审核日志记录。使用 AWS Identity and Access Management 策略来控制审批权限。通过指定变量创建参数化提示模板。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use AWS Step Functions to create an approval workflow. Store prompts in Amazon S3. Use tags to implement version control. Use Amazon EventBridge to send notifications.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Step Functions 创建审批工作流程。将提示存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用标签来实现版本控制。使用 Amazon EventBridge 发送通知。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy Amazon SageMaker Canvas with prompt templates stored in Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudFormation for version control. Use AWS Config to enforce approval policies.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon S3 中存储的提示模板部署 Amazon SageMaker Canvas。使用 AWS CloudFormation 进行版本控制。使用 AWS Config 强制执行审批策略。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 媒体公司必须使用 Amazon Bedrock 为 AI 生成的内容实施稳健的治理流程。公司需要管理数百个提示模板。多个团队跨多个 AWS 区域使用模板来生成内容。该解决方案必须提供带有审批工作流程的版本控制，其中包括待审核的通知。该解决方案还必须提供详细的审计跟踪，记录提示活动和一致的提示参数化，以执行质量标准。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A company is building a legal research AI assistant that uses Amazon Bedrock with an Anthropic Claude foundation model (FM). The AI assistant must retrieve highly relevant case law documents to augment the FM’s responses. The AI assistant must identify semantic relationships between legal concepts, specific legal terminology, and citations. The AI assistant must perform quickly and return precise results. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to use a default vector search configuration. Use Amazon Bedrock to expand queries to improve retrieval for legal documents based on specific terminology and citations.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 知识库以使用默认矢量搜索配置。使用 Amazon Bedrock 扩展查询，以改进基于特定术语和引文的法律文档检索。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to deploy a hybrid search architecture that combines vector search with keyword search. Apply an Amazon Bedrock reranker model to optimize result relevance.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 部署将矢量搜索与关键字搜索相结合的混合搜索架构。应用 Amazon Bedrock 重新排序模型来优化结果相关性。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Enable the Amazon Kendra query suggestion feature for end users. Use Amazon Bedrock to perform post-processing of search results to identify semantic similarity in the documents and to produce precise results.
choices.textZh: 为最终用户启用 Amazon Kendra 查询建议功能。使用 Amazon Bedrock 对搜索结果执行后处理，以识别文档中的语义相似性并生成精确的结果。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service with vector search and Amazon Bedrock Titan Embeddings to index and search legal documents. Use custom AWS Lambda functions to merge results with keyword-based filters that are stored in an Amazon RDS database.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 与矢量搜索和 Amazon Bedrock Titan Embeddings 来索引和搜索法律文档。使用自定义 AWS Lambda 函数将结果与存储在 Amazon RDS 数据库中的基于关键字的筛选器合并。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家公司正在构建一个法律研究 AI 助手，该助手使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Anthropic Claude 基础模型 (FM)。人工智能助手必须检索高度相关的判例法文件，以增强 FM 的响应。人工智能助手必须识别法律概念、特定法律术语和引文之间的语义关系。人工智能助手必须快速执行并返回精确的结果。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is building a video analysis platform on AWS. The platform will analyze a large video archive by using Amazon Rekognition and Amazon Bedrock. The platform must comply with predefined privacy standards. The platform must also use secure model I/O, control foundation model (FM) access patterns, and provide an audit of who accessed what and when. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure VPC endpoints for Amazon Bedrock model API calls. Implement Amazon Bedrock guardrails to filter harmful or unauthorized content in prompts and responses. Use Amazon Bedrock trace events to track all agent and model invocations for auditing purposes. Export the traces to Amazon CloudWatch Logs as an audit record of model usage. Store all prompts and outputs in Amazon S3 with server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
choices.textZh: 为 Amazon Bedrock 模型 API 调用配置 VPC 终端节点。实施 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以过滤提示和响应中的有害或未经授权的内容。使用 Amazon Bedrock 跟踪事件跟踪所有代理和模型调用以进行审计。将跟踪导出到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 作为模型使用情况的审核记录。将所有提示和输出存储在 Amazon S3 中，并使用 AWS KMS 密钥 (SSE-KMS) 进行服务器端加密。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Define access control by using IAM with attribute-based access control (ABAC) to map departments to specific permissions. Configure VPC endpoints for Amazon Bedrock model API calls. Use IAM condition keys to enforce specific GuardrailIdentifier and ModelId values. Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture management and data events for S3 objects and KMS key usage activities. Enable S3 server access logging to record detailed file-level interactions with the video archives. Send all CloudTrail logs to AWS CloudTrail Lake. Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms to detect and alert on unexpected activity from Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Rekognition, and AWS KMS.
choices.textZh: 通过使用 IAM 和基于属性的访问控制 (ABAC) 来定义访问控制，将部门映射到特定权限。为 Amazon Bedrock 模型 API 调用配置 VPC 终端节点。使用 IAM 条件键强制执行特定的 GuardrailIdentifier 和 ModelId 值。配置 AWS CloudTrail 以捕获 S3 对象和 KMS 密钥使用活动的管理和数据事件。启用 S3 服务器访问日志记录以记录与视频档案的详细文件级交互。将所有 CloudTrail 日志发送到 AWS CloudTrail Lake。设置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以检测来自 Amazon Bedrock、Amazon Rekognition 和 AWS KMS 的意外活动并发出警报。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Restrict access to services by using VPC endpoint policies. Use AWS Config to track resource changes and compliance with security rules. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) to encrypt data at rest. Store the model’s I/O in separate Amazon S3 buckets. Enable S3 server access logging to track file-level interactions.
choices.textZh: 使用 VPC 终端节点策略限制对服务的访问。使用 AWS Config 跟踪资源更改以及安全规则的合规性。使用带有 AWS KMS 密钥 (SSE-KMS) 的服务器端加密来加密静态数据。将模型的 I/O 存储在单独的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。启用 S3 服务器访问日志记录以跟踪文件级交互。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure AWS CloudTrail Insights to analyze API call patterns across accounts and detect anomalous activity in Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Rekognition, Amazon S3, and AWS KMS. Deploy Amazon Macie to scan and classify the video archive. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE- KMS) to encrypt all stored data. Configure CloudTrail to capture KMS API usage events for audit purposes. Configure Amazon EventBridge rules to process CloudTrail Insights anomalies and Macie findings. Use CloudWatch alarms to trigger automated notifications and security responses when potential security issues are detected.
choices.textZh: 配置 AWS CloudTrail Insights 以分析跨账户的 API 调用模式并检测 Amazon Bedrock、Amazon Rekognition、Amazon S3 和 AWS KMS 中的异常活动。部署 Amazon Macie 对视频存档进行扫描和分类。使用带有 AWS KMS 密钥 (SSE-KMS) 的服务器端加密来加密所有存储的数据。配置 CloudTrail 以捕获 KMS API 使用事件以进行审计。配置 Amazon EventBridge 规则以处理 CloudTrail Insights 异常和 Macie 结果。当检测到潜在的安全问题时，使用 CloudWatch 警报触发自动通知和安全响应。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建视频分析平台。该平台将使用 Amazon Rekognition 和 Amazon Bedrock 分析大型视频档案。该平台必须遵守预定义的隐私标准。该平台还必须使用安全模型 I/O、控制基础模型 (FM) 访问模式，并提供对谁访问什么以及何时访问的审核。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is creating a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs). The application must use Microsoft Entra ID to authenticate. All FM API calls must stay on private network paths. Access to the application must be limited by department to specific model families. The company also needs a comprehensive audit trail of model interactions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure SAML federation between Microsoft Entra ID and AWS Identity and Access Management. Create department-specific IAM roles that allow only the required ModelId values. Create AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoints for Amazon Bedrock runtime services. Enable AWS CloudTrail to capture Amazon Bedrock API calls. Configure Amazon Bedrock model invocation logging to record detailed model interactions.
choices.textZh: 配置 Microsoft Entra ID 与 AWS Identity and Access Management 之间的 SAML 联合。创建仅允许所需 ModelId 值的部门特定 IAM 角色。为 Amazon Bedrock 运行时服务创建 AWS PrivateLink 接口 VPC 终端节点。启用 AWS CloudTrail 以捕获 Amazon Bedrock API 调用。配置 Amazon Bedrock 模型调用日志记录以记录详细的模型交互。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an identity provider (IdP) connection in IAM to authenticate by using Microsoft Entra ID. Assign department permission sets to control access to specific model families. Deploy AWS Lambda functions in private subnets with a NAT gateway for egress to Amazon Bedrock public endpoints. Enable CloudWatch Logs to capture model interactions for auditing purposes.
choices.textZh: 在 IAM 中创建身份提供商 (IdP) 连接以使用 Microsoft Entra ID 进行身份验证。分配部门权限集以控制对特定模型系列的访问。在私有子网中部署 AWS Lambda 函数，并使用 NAT 网关出口到 Amazon Bedrock 公共终端节点。启用 CloudWatch Logs 来捕获模型交互以进行审计。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create a SAML identity provider (IdP) in IAM to authenticate by using Microsoft Entra ID. Use IAM permissions boundaries to limit department roles' access to specific model families. Configure public Amazon Bedrock API endpoints with VPC routing to maintain private network connectivity. Set up CloudTrail with Amazon S3 Lifecycle rules to manage audit logs of model interactions.
choices.textZh: 在 IAM 中创建 SAML 身份提供商 (IdP)，以使用 Microsoft Entra ID 进行身份验证。使用 IAM 权限边界来限制部门角色对特定模型系列的访问。使用 VPC 路由配置公共 Amazon Bedrock API 终端节点以维护专用网络连接。使用 Amazon S3 生命周期规则设置 CloudTrail 以管理模型交互的审核日志。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure OpenID Connect (OIDC) federation between Microsoft Entra ID and IAM. Use attribute- based access control to map department attributes to specific model access permissions. Apply SCP policies to restrict access to Amazon Bedrock FM families based on department. Use Microsoft Entra ID's built-in logging capabilities to maintain an audit trail of model interactions.
choices.textZh: 配置 Microsoft Entra ID 和 IAM 之间的 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 联合。使用基于属性的访问控制将部门属性映射到特定模型访问权限。应用 SCP 策略以根据部门限制对 Amazon Bedrock FM 系列的访问。使用 Microsoft Entra ID 的内置日志记录功能来维护模型交互的审核跟踪。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司正在创建使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 的生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序。应用程序必须使用 Microsoft Entra ID 进行身份验证。所有 FM API 调用都必须位于专用网络路径上。部门必须将应用程序的访问权限限制为特定型号系列。该公司还需要对模型交互进行全面的审计跟踪。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is using Amazon Bedrock and Anthropic Claude 3 Haiku to develop an AI assistant. The AI assistant normally processes 10,000 requests each hour but experiences surges of up to 30,000 requests each hour during peak usage periods. The AI assistant must respond within 2 seconds while operating across multiple AWS Regions. The company observes that during peak usage periods, the AI assistant experiences throughput bottlenecks that cause increased latency and occasional request timeouts. The company must resolve the performance issues. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Purchase provisioned throughput and sufficient model units (MUs) in a single Region. Configure the application to retry failed requests with exponential backoff.
choices.textZh: 在单个区域中购买预配置吞吐量和足够的模型单元 (MU)。配置应用程序以使用指数退避重试失败的请求。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement token batching to reduce API overhead. Use cross-Region inference profiles to automatically distribute traffic across available Regions.
choices.textZh: 实施令牌批处理以减少 API 开销。使用跨区域推理配置文件在可用区域之间自动分配流量。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Set up auto scaling AWS Lambda functions in each Region. Implement client-side round-robin request distribution. Purchase one model unit (MU) of provisioned throughput as a backup.
choices.textZh: 在每个区域中设置自动扩展 AWS Lambda 函数。实现客户端循环请求分发。购买一个预配置吞吐量的模型单元 (MU) 作为备份。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Implement batch inference for all requests by using Amazon S3 buckets across multiple Regions. Use Amazon SQS to set up an asynchronous retrieval process.
choices.textZh: 使用跨多个区域的 Amazon S3 存储桶对所有请求实施批量推理。使用 Amazon SQS 设置异步检索流程。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Anthropic Claude 3 Haiku 开发人工智能助手。 AI 助手通常每小时处理 10,000 个请求，但在使用高峰期每小时会激增多达 30,000 个请求。 AI 助手在跨多个 AWS 区域运行时必须在 2 秒内做出响应。该公司观察到，在使用高峰期，人工智能助手会遇到吞吐量瓶颈，导致延迟增加和偶尔的请求超时。公司必须解决绩效问题。哪种解决方案可以满足这个要求？

prompt: A university is building an AI-powered application that includes several sub-applications. The sub- applications include AI assistants, assignment graders, and internal analytics applications. The university is defining and testing multiple prompts by using various foundation models (FMs). The university wants to compare variants of each prompt and choose the variant that yield outputs that are best-suited for specified use cases. The university requires a version control solution for the prompts. The university must be able to test prompt variations and collect audit trails for prompt changes and usage. The solution must also maintain consistency while allowing the prompts to integrate into the main application. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to create versioned prompts. Include parameterized variables for each use case.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 创建版本化提示。包括每个用例的参数化变量。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Store prompts in Amazon S3. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the model interactions and service integrations.
choices.textZh: 将提示存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Step Functions 编排模型交互和服务集成。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Flows to create workflows that combine FMs and AWS services.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Flows 创建结合 FM 和 AWS 服务的工作流程。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure AWS Config to record prompt changes. Use AWS CloudTrail to track prompt usage.
choices.textZh: 配置 AWS Config 以记录提示的更改。使用 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪提示的使用情况。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock intelligent prompt routing.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 的智能提示路由。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一所大学正在构建一个由人工智能驱动的应用程序，其中包括多个子应用程序。子应用程序包括人工智能助手、作业评分器和内部分析应用程序。该大学正在使用各种基础模型 (FM) 定义和测试多种提示。该大学希望比较每个提示的变体，并选择产生最适合特定用例的输出的变体。该大学需要提示的版本控制解决方案。大学必须能够测试即时变化并收集审计跟踪以进行即时更改和使用。该解决方案还必须保持一致性，同时允许提示集成到主应用程序中。哪种解决方案组合能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A company is building a generative AI (GenAI) application that produces content based on a variety of internal and external data sources. The company wants to ensure that the generated output is fully traceable. The application must support data source registration and enable metadata tagging to attribute content to its original source. The application must also maintain audit logs of data access and usage throughout the pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Lake Formation to catalog data sources and control access. Apply metadata tags directly in Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor API activity.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lake Formation 对数据源进行编目并控制访问。直接在 Amazon S3 中应用元数据标签。使用 AWS CloudTrail 监控 API 活动。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to register and tag data sources. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to monitor access patterns and application behavior.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Glue 数据目录注册和标记数据源。使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 监控访问模式和应用程序行为。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Store data in Amazon S3 and use object tagging for attribution. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to manage schema information. Use AWS CloudTrail to log access to S3 buckets.
choices.textZh: 将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中并使用对象标记进行归因。使用 AWS Glue 数据目录来管理架构信息。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录对 S3 存储桶的访问。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to register all data sources. Apply metadata tags to attribute data sources. Use AWS CloudTrail to log access and activity across services.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Glue 数据目录注册所有数据源。将元数据标签应用于属性数据源。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录跨服务的访问和活动。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家公司正在构建生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 应用程序，该应用程序根据各种内部和外部数据源生成内容。该公司希望确保生成的输出完全可追溯。应用程序必须支持数据源注册并启用元数据标记以将内容归因于其原始源。应用程序还必须维护整个管道中数据访问和使用的审核日志。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A medical company is building a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide evidence-based medical information. The application uses Amazon OpenSearch Service to retrieve vector embeddings. Users report that searches frequently miss results that contain exact medical terms and acronyms and return too many semantically similar but irrelevant documents. The company needs to improve retrieval quality and maintain low end-user latency, even as the document collection grows to millions of documents. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure hybrid search by combining vector similarity with keyword matching to improve semantic understanding and exact term and acronym matching.
choices.textZh: 通过将向量相似性与关键字匹配相结合来配置混合搜索，以提高语义理解以及精确的术语和首字母缩略词匹配。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Increase the dimensions of the vector embeddings from 384 to 1536. Use a post-processing AWS Lambda function to filter out irrelevant results after retrieval.
choices.textZh: 将向量嵌入的维度从 384 增加到 1536。检索后使用后处理 AWS Lambda 函数过滤掉不相关的结果。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Replace OpenSearch Service with Amazon Kendra. Use query expansion to handle medical acronyms and terminology variants during pre-processing.
choices.textZh: 将 OpenSearch 服务替换为 Amazon Kendra。在预处理期间使用查询扩展来处理医学首字母缩略词和术语变体。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Implement a two-stage retrieval architecture in which initial vector search results are re-ranked by an ML model hosted on Amazon SageMaker.
choices.textZh: 实施一个两阶段检索架构，其中初始向量搜索结果由 Amazon SageMaker 上托管的 ML 模型重新排名。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家医疗公司正在构建生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 应用程序，该应用程序使用检索增强生成 (RAG) 来提供基于证据的医疗信息。该应用程序使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 来检索向量嵌入。用户报告说，搜索经常会错过包含确切医学术语和首字母缩略词的结果，并返回太多语义相似但不相关的文档。即使文档集合增长到数百万个文档，公司也需要提高检索质量并保持较低的最终用户延迟。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: An ecommerce company is developing a generative AI application that uses Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude to recommend products to customers. Customers report that some recommended products are not available for sale on the website or are not relevant to the customer. Customers also report that the solution takes a long time to generate some recommendations. The company investigates the issues and finds that most interactions between customers and the product recommendation solution are unique. The company confirms that the solution recommends products that are not in the company’s product catalog. The company must resolve these issues. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Increase grounding within Amazon Bedrock Guardrails. Enable Automated Reasoning checks. Set up provisioned throughput.
choices.textZh: 增加亚马逊基岩护栏内的接地。启用自动推理检查。设置预置吞吐量。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use prompt engineering to restrict the model responses to relevant products. Use streaming techniques such as the InvokeModelWithResponseStream action to reduce perceived latency for the customers.
choices.textZh: 使用即时工程来限制模型对相关产品的响应。使用 InvokeModelWithResponseStream 操作等流技术来减少客户感知的延迟。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation RAG. Set the PerformanceConfigLatency parameter to optimized.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。实施检索增强生成 RAG。将 PerformanceConfigLatency 参数设置为优化。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Store product catalog data in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Validate the model’s product recommendations against the product catalog. Use Amazon DynamoDB to implement response caching.
choices.textZh: 将产品目录数据存储在 Amazon OpenSearch Service 中。根据产品目录验证模型的产品推荐。使用 Amazon DynamoDB 实施响应缓存。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家电子商务公司正在开发一款生成式 AI 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Anthropic Claude 向客户推荐产品。客户反映某些推荐产品无法在网站上销售或与客户无关。客户还报告说，该解决方案需要很长时间才能生成一些建议。该公司调查了这些问题，发现客户与产品推荐解决方案之间的大多数交互都是独特的。该公司确认该解决方案推荐的产品不在该公司的产品目录中。公司必须解决这些问题。哪种解决方案可以满足这个要求？

prompt: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations with all features enabled to manage multiple AWS accounts. Employees use Amazon Bedrock across multiple accounts. The company must prevent specific topics and proprietary information from being included in prompts to Amazon Bedrock models. The company must ensure that employees can use only approved Amazon Bedrock models. The company wants to manage these controls centrally. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create an IAM permissions boundary for each employee's IAM role. Configure the permissions boundary to require an approved Amazon Bedrock guardrail identifier to invoke Amazon Bedrock models. Create an SCP that allows employees to use only approved models.
choices.textZh: 为每个员工的 IAM 角色创建 IAM 权限边界。配置权限边界以需要经过批准的 Amazon Bedrock 护栏标识符才能调用 Amazon Bedrock 模型。创建一个 SCP，允许员工仅使用经批准的模型。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an SCP that allows employees to use only approved models. Configure the SCP to require employees to specify a guardrail identifier in calls to invoke an approved model.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 SCP，允许员工仅使用经批准的模型。配置 SCP 以要求员工在调用中指定护栏标识符以调用批准的模型。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an SCP that prevents an employee from invoking a model if a centrally deployed guardrail identifier is not specified in a call to the model. Create a permissions boundary on each employee's IAM role that allows each employee to invoke only approved models.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 SCP，如果在模型调用中未指定集中部署的护栏标识符，该 SCP 会阻止员工调用模型。在每个员工的 IAM 角色上创建权限边界，允许每个员工仅调用批准的模型。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use AWS CloudFormation to create a custom Amazon Bedrock guardrail that has a block filtering policy. Use stack sets to deploy the guardrail to each account in the organization.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 创建一个具有阻止过滤策略的自定义 Amazon Bedrock guardrail。使用 stack sets 将该 guardrail 部署到组织中的每个账户。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Use AWS CloudFormation to create a custom Amazon Bedrock guardrail that has a mask filtering policy. Use stack sets to deploy the guardrail to each account in the organization.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 创建一个具有掩码过滤策略的自定义 Amazon Bedrock guardrail。使用 stack sets 将该 guardrail 部署到组织中的每个账户。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织，并启用了管理多个 AWS 账户的所有功能。员工在多个账户中使用 Amazon Bedrock。公司必须防止特定主题和专有信息包含在 Amazon Bedrock 模型的提示中。公司必须确保员工只能使用经批准的 Amazon Bedrock 型号。该公司希望集中管理这些控制。哪种解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

prompt: A healthcare company is using Amazon Bedrock to build a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application that helps practitioners make clinical decisions. The application must achieve high accuracy for patient information retrievals, identify hallucinations in generated content, and reduce human review costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Comprehend to analyze and classify RAG responses and to extract medical entities and relationships. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate automated evaluations. Configure Amazon CloudWatch metrics to track entity recognition confidence scores. Configure CloudWatch to send an alert when accuracy falls below specified thresholds.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 分析和分类 RAG 响应并提取医疗实体和关系。使用 AWS Step Functions 协调自动化评估。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 指标以跟踪实体识别置信度分数。配置 CloudWatch 以在准确性低于指定阈值时发送警报。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement automated large language model (LLM)-based evaluations that use a specialized model that is fine-tuned for medical content to assess all responses. Deploy AWS Lambda functions to parallelize evaluations. Publish results to Amazon CloudWatch metrics that track relevance and factual accuracy.
choices.textZh: 实施基于自动化大语言模型 (LLM) 的评估，该评估使用针对医疗内容进行微调的专用模型来评估所有响应。部署 AWS Lambda 函数以并行化评估。将结果发布到跟踪相关性和事实准确性的 Amazon CloudWatch 指标。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics to generate test queries that have known answers on a regular schedule, and track model success rates. Set up dashboards that compare synthetic test results against expected outcomes.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics 以定期生成具有已知答案的测试查询，并跟踪模型成功率。设置仪表板，将综合测试结果与预期结果进行比较。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy a hybrid evaluation system that uses an automated LLM-as-a-judge evaluation to initially screen responses and targeted human reviews for edge cases. Use a built-in Amazon Bedrock evaluation to track retrieval precision and hallucination rates.
choices.textZh: 部署一个混合评估系统，该系统使用自动化的法学硕士作为法官评估来初步筛选回答并针对边缘情况进行有针对性的人工审查。使用内置的 Amazon Bedrock 评估来跟踪检索精度和幻觉率。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用程序，帮助从业人员做出临床决策。该应用程序必须实现患者信息检索的高精度，识别生成内容中的幻觉，并降低人工审核成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A healthcare company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop a real-time patient care AI assistant to respond to queries for separate departments that handle clinical inquiries, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and insurance claims. The company wants to use a multi-agent architecture. The company must ensure that the AI assistant is scalable and can onboard new features for patients. The AI assistant must be able to handle thousands of parallel patient interactions. The company must ensure that patients receive appropriate domain-specific responses to queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Isolate data for each agent by using separate knowledge bases. Use IAM filtering to control access to each knowledge base. Deploy a supervisor agent to perform natural language intent classification on patient inquiries. Configure the supervisor agent to route queries to specialized collaborator agents to respond to department-specific queries. Configure each specialized collaborator agent to use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with the agent’s department-specific knowledge base.
choices.textZh: 使用单独的知识库隔离每个代理的数据。使用 IAM 过滤来控制对每个知识库的访问。部署主管代理对患者询问进行自然语言意图分类。配置主管代理将查询路由到专门的协作代理以响应部门特定的查询。配置每个专业协作代理以将检索增强生成 (RAG) 与代理的部门特定知识库结合使用。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create a separate supervisor agent for each department. Configure individual collaborator agents to perform natural language intent classification for each specialty domain within each department. Integrate each collaborator agent with department-specific knowledge bases only. Implement manual handoff processes between the supervisor agents.
choices.textZh: 为每个部门创建一个单独的主管代理。配置单独的协作代理以对每个部门内的每个专业领域执行自然语言意图分类。仅将每个协作代理与特定于部门的知识库集成。在主管代理之间实施手动切换流程。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Isolate data for each department in separate knowledge bases. Use IAM filtering to control access to each knowledge base. Deploy a single general-purpose agent. Configure multiple action groups within the general-purpose agent to perform specific department functions. Implement rule-based routing logic within the general-purpose agent instructions.
choices.textZh: 将每个部门的数据隔离在单独的知识库中。使用 IAM 过滤来控制对每个知识库的访问。部署单个通用代理。在通用代理内配置多个操作组以执行特定的部门功能。在通用代理指令中实现基于规则的路由逻辑。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Implement multiple independent supervisor agents that run in parallel to respond to patient inquiries for each department. Configure multiple collaborator agents for each supervisor agent. Integrate all agents with the same knowledge base. Use external routing logic to merge responses from multiple supervisor agents.
choices.textZh: 实施多个独立的主管代理，这些代理并行运行以响应每个部门的患者询问。为每个主管代理配置多个协作者代理。将所有代理与相同的知识库集成。使用外部路由逻辑合并来自多个主管代理的响应。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发实时患者护理 AI 助手，以响应处理临床查询、保险验证、预约安排和保险索赔的各个部门的查询。该公司希望使用多代理架构。 公司必须确保 AI 助手具有可扩展性，并且可以为患者添加新功能。人工智能助手必须能够处理数千个并行的患者交互。公司必须确保患者收到针对特定领域的查询的适当答复。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: An ecommerce company is developing a generative AI (GenAI) solution that uses Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude to recommend products to customers. Customers report that some recommended products are not available for sale or are not relevant. Customers also report long response times for some recommendations. The company confirms that most customer interactions are unique and that the solution recommends products not present in the product catalog. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Increase grounding within Amazon Bedrock Guardrails. Enable automated reasoning checks. Set up provisioned throughput.
choices.textZh: 增加亚马逊基岩护栏内的接地。启用自动推理检查。设置预置吞吐量。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use prompt engineering to restrict model responses to relevant products. Use streaming inference to reduce perceived latency.
choices.textZh: 使用即时工程来限制模型对相关产品的响应。使用流推理来减少感知延迟。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). Set the PerformanceConfigLatency parameter to optimized.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Store product catalog data in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Validate model recommendations against the catalog. Use Amazon DynamoDB for response caching.
