categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家电子商务公司正在开发一种生成式 AI (GenAI) 解决方案，该解决方案使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Anthropic Claude 向客户推荐产品。客户报告某些推荐的产品无法销售或不相关。客户还报告说，某些建议的响应时间很长。该公司确认，大多数客户交互都是独特的，并且该解决方案会推荐产品目录中不存在的产品。哪种解决方案可以满足这个要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A university recently digitized a collection of archival documents, academic journals, and manuscripts. The university stores the digital files in an AWS Lake Formation data lake. The university hires a GenAI developer to build a solution to allow users to search the digital files by using text queries. The solution must return journal abstracts that are semantically similar to a user's query. Users must be able to search the digitized collection based on text and metadata that is associated with the journal abstracts. The metadata of the digitized files does not contain keywords. The solution must match similar abstracts to one another based on the similarity of their text. The data lake contains fewer than 1 million files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Titan Embeddings in Amazon Bedrock to create vector representations of the digitized files. Store embeddings in the OpenSearch Neural plugin for Amazon OpenSearch Service.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的 Amazon Titan Embeddings 创建数字化文件的矢量表示。将嵌入存储在 Amazon OpenSearch Service 的 OpenSearch Neural 插件中。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Comprehend to extract topics from the digitized files. Store the topics and file metadata in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. Query the abstract metadata against the data in the Aurora database.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 从数字化文件中提取主题。将主题和文件元数据存储在 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库中。根据 Aurora 数据库中的数据查询抽象元数据。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker AI to deploy a sentence-transformer model. Use the model to create vector representations of the digitized files. Store embeddings in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database that has the pgvector extension.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 部署句子转换器模型。使用该模型创建数字化文件的矢量表示。将嵌入存储在具有 pgvector 扩展名的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库中。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon Titan Embeddings in Amazon Bedrock to create vector representations of the digitized files. Store embeddings in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless database that has the pgvector extension.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 中使用 Amazon Titan Embeddings 创建数字化文件的矢量表示。将嵌入存储在具有 pgvector 扩展名的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless 数据库中。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一所大学最近对一系列档案文件、学术期刊和手稿进行了数字化。该大学将数字文件存储在 AWS Lake Formation 数据湖中。该大学聘请了一位 GenAI 开发人员来构建一个解决方案，允许用户使用文本查询来搜索数字文件。该解决方案必须返回语义上与用户查询相似的期刊摘要。用户必须能够根据与期刊摘要相关的文本和元数据搜索数字化馆藏。数字化文件的元数据不包含关键字。该解决方案必须根据文本的相似性将相似的摘要相互匹配。数据湖包含的文件少于 100 万个。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

prompt: An enterprise application uses an Amazon Bedrock foundation model (FM) to process and analyze 50 to 200 pages of technical documents. Users are experiencing inconsistent responses and receiving truncated outputs when processing documents that exceed the FM's context window limits. Which solution will resolve this problem?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure fixed-size chunking at 4,000 tokens for each chunk with 20% overlap. Use application-level logic to link multiple chunks sequentially until the FM's maximum context window of 200,000 tokens is reached before making inference calls.
choices.textZh: 为每个块配置 4,000 个标记的固定大小分块，重叠率为 20%。使用应用程序级逻辑按顺序链接多个块，直到在进行推理调用之前达到 FM 的最大上下文窗口 200,000 个令牌。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use hierarchical chunking with parent chunks of 8,000 tokens and child chunks of 2,000 tokens. Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases built-in retrieval to automatically select relevant parent chunks based on query context. Configure overlap tokens to maintain semantic continuity.
choices.textZh: 使用分层分块，父块包含 8,000 个标记，子块包含 2,000 个标记。使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库内置检索根据查询上下文自动选择相关父块。配置重叠标记以保持语义连续性。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use semantic chunking with a breakpoint percentile threshold of 95% and a buffer size of 3 sentences. Use the RetrieveAndGenerate API to dynamically select the most relevant chunks based on embedding similarity scores.
choices.textZh: 使用语义分块，断点百分位阈值为 95%，缓冲区大小为 3 个句子。使用 RetrieveAndGenerate API 根据嵌入相似度分数动态选择最相关的块。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create a pre-processing AWS Lambda function that analyzes document token count by using the FM's tokenizer. Configure the Lambda function to split documents into equal segments that fit within 80% of the context window. Configure the Lambda function to process each segment independently before aggregating the results.
choices.textZh: 创建一个预处理 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数使用 FM 的标记生成器分析文档标记计数。配置 Lambda 函数以将文档分割为适合上下文窗口 80% 的相等片段。配置 Lambda 函数以在聚合结果之前独立处理每个段。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 企业应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 处理和分析 50 到 200 页的技术文档。在处理超出 FM 上下文窗口限制的文档时，用户会遇到不一致的响应并收到被截断的输出。哪种解决方案可以解决这个问题？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is developing a generative AI (GenAI) application that analyzes customer service calls in real time and generates suggested responses for human customer service agents. The application must process 500,000 concurrent calls during peak hours with less than 200 ms end-to-end latency for each suggestion. The company uses existing architecture to transcribe customer call audio streams. The application must not exceed a predefined monthly compute budget and must maintain auto scaling capabilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy a large, complex reasoning model on Amazon Bedrock. Purchase provisioned throughput and optimize for batch processing.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 上部署大型、复杂的推理模型。购买预配置吞吐量并优化批处理。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy a low-latency, real-time optimized model on Amazon Bedrock. Purchase provisioned throughput and set up automatic scaling policies.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 上部署低延迟、实时优化的模型。购买预配置吞吐量并设置自动扩展策略。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy a large language model (LLM) on an Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint that uses dedicated GPU instances.
choices.textZh: 在使用专用 GPU 实例的 Amazon SageMaker 实时终端节点上部署大型语言模型 (LLM)。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy a mid-sized language model on an Amazon SageMaker serverless endpoint that is optimized for batch processing.
choices.textZh: 在针对批处理进行优化的 Amazon SageMaker 无服务器终端节点上部署中型语言模型。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在开发一种生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 应用程序，该应用程序可以实时分析客户服务呼叫并为人类客户服务代理生成建议的响应。应用程序必须在高峰时段处理 500,000 个并发调用，每个建议的端到端延迟低于 200 毫秒。该公司使用现有架构来转录客户呼叫音频流。应用程序不得超过预定义的每月计算预算，并且必须保持自动扩展功能。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company provides a service that helps users from around the world discover new restaurants. The service has 50 million monthly active users. The company wants to implement a semantic search solution across a database that contains 20 million restaurants and 200 million reviews. The company currently stores the data in PostgreSQL. The solution must support complex natural language queries and return results for at least 95% of queries within 500 ms. The solution must maintain data freshness for restaurant details that update hourly. The solution must also scale cost-effectively during peak usage periods. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Migrate the restaurant data to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Implement keyword-based search rules that use custom analyzers and relevance tuning to find restaurants based on attributes such as cuisine type, features, and location. Create Amazon API Gateway HTTP API endpoints to transform user queries into structured search parameters.
choices.textZh: 将餐厅数据迁移到 Amazon OpenSearch Service。实施基于关键字的搜索规则，使用自定义分析器和相关性调整来根据菜系类型、特色和位置等属性查找餐厅。创建 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 终端节点以将用户查询转换为结构化搜索参数。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Migrate the restaurant data to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use a foundation model (FM) in Amazon Bedrock to generate vector embeddings from restaurant descriptions, reviews, and menu items. When users submit natural language queries, convert the queries to embeddings by using the same FM. Perform k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) searches to find semantically similar results.
choices.textZh: 将餐厅数据迁移到 Amazon OpenSearch Service。使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的基础模型 (FM) 根据餐厅描述、评论和菜单项生成矢量嵌入。当用户提交自然语言查询时，使用相同的 FM 将查询转换为嵌入。执行 k 最近邻 (k-NN) 搜索以查找语义相似的结果。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Keep the restaurant data in PostgreSQL and implement a pgvector extension. Use a foundation model (FM) in Amazon Bedrock to generate vector embeddings from restaurant data. Store the vector embeddings directly in PostgreSQL. Create an AWS Lambda function to convert natural language queries to vector representations by using the same FM. Configure the Lambda function to perform similarity searches within the database.
choices.textZh: 将餐厅数据保存在 PostgreSQL 中并实现 pgvector 扩展。使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的基础模型 (FM) 从餐厅数据生成矢量嵌入。将矢量 嵌入直接存储在 PostgreSQL 中。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，以使用相同的 FM 将自然语言查询转换为矢量表示。配置 Lambda 函数以在数据库中执行相似性搜索。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Migrate restaurant data to an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base by using a custom ingestion pipeline. Configure the knowledge base to automatically generate embeddings from restaurant information. Use the Amazon Bedrock Retrieve API with built-in vector search capabilities to query the knowledge base directly by using natural language input.
choices.textZh: 使用自定义提取管道将餐厅数据迁移到 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。配置知识库以自动从餐厅信息生成嵌入。使用具有内置矢量搜索功能的 Amazon Bedrock Retrieve API，通过自然语言输入直接查询知识库。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司提供一项服务，帮助世界各地的用户发现新餐厅。该服务每月有 5000 万活跃用户。该公司希望在包含 2000 万家餐厅和 2 亿条评论的数据库中实施语义搜索解决方案。该公司目前将数据存储在 PostgreSQL 中。该解决方案必须支持复杂的自然语言查询，并在 500 毫秒内返回至少 95% 的查询结果。该解决方案必须保持每小时更新的餐厅详细信息的数据新鲜度。该解决方案还必须在高峰使用期间经济有效地进行扩展。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company needs to pre-process unstructured data such as customer transcripts, financial reports, and documentation. The company stores the unstructured data in Amazon S3 to support an Amazon Bedrock application. The company must validate data quality, create auditable metadata, monitor data metrics, and customize text chunking to optimize foundation model (FM) performance. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a data flow. Configure Amazon CloudWatch metrics and alarms to monitor data quality. Use a custom AWS Lambda function to pre-process the data. Load processed data into Amazon Bedrock.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler 创建数据流。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 指标和警报以监控数据质量。使用自定义 AWS Lambda 函数预处理数据。将处理后的数据加载到 Amazon Bedrock 中。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Set up an AWS Glue crawler to catalog data sources. Create AWS Glue ETL jobs to run custom transformation scripts. Use AWS Glue Data Quality to validate and monitor data quality. Load processed data into Amazon Bedrock.
choices.textZh: 设置 AWS Glue 爬网程序来对数据源进行编目。创建 AWS Glue ETL 作业以运行自定义转换脚本。使用 AWS Glue 数据质量来验证和监控数据质量。将处理后的数据加载到 Amazon Bedrock 中。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Comprehend to extract entities. Create an AWS Lambda function to chunk text. Run Amazon Athena to query and validate data quality. Load processed data into Amazon Bedrock.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 提取实体。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来对文本进行分块。运行 Amazon Athena 来查询和验证数据质量。将处理后的数据加载到 Amazon Bedrock 中。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow to orchestrate data pre-processing tasks. Run custom code on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to monitor data quality. Load processed data into Amazon Bedrock.
choices.textZh: 创建 AWS Step Functions 工作流程来编排数据预处理任务。在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行自定义代码。使用 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor 监控数据质量。将处理后的数据加载到 Amazon Bedrock 中。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司需要预处理非结构化数据，例如客户记录、财务报告和文档。该公司将非结构化数据存储在 Amazon S3 中以支持 Amazon Bedrock 应用程序。 公司必须验证数据质量、创建可审核的元数据、监控数据指标并自定义文本分块以优化基础模型 (FM) 性能。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is building a generative AI (GenAI) application that processes financial reports and provides summaries for analysts. The application must run two compute environments. In one environment, AWS Lambda functions must use the Python SDK to analyze reports on demand. In the second environment, Amazon EKS containers must use the JavaScript SDK to batch process multiple reports on a schedule. The application must maintain conversational context throughout multi-turn interactions, use the same foundation model (FM) across environments, and ensure consistent authentication. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use the Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel API with a separate authentication method for each environment. Store conversation states in Amazon DynamoDB. Use custom I/O formatting logic for each programming language.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel API，为每个环境提供单独的身份验证方法。将对话状态存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。为每种编程语言使用自定义 I/O 格式化逻辑。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use the Amazon Bedrock Converse API directly in both environments with a common authentication mechanism that uses IAM roles. Store conversation states in Amazon ElastiCache. Create programming language-specific wrappers for model parameters.
choices.textZh: 在两种环境中直接使用 Amazon Bedrock Converse API，并采用使用 IAM 角色的通用身份验证机制。将对话状态存储在 Amazon ElastiCache 中。为模型参数创建特定于编程语言的包装器。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create a centralized Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoint that handles all model interactions by using the InvokeModel API. Store interaction history in application process memory in each Lambda function or EKS container. Use environment variables to configure model parameters.
choices.textZh: 创建一个集中式 Amazon API Gateway REST API 终端节点，使用 InvokeModel API 处理所有模型交互。将交互历史记录存储在每个 Lambda 函数或 EKS 容器的应用程序进程内存中。使用环境变量来配置模型参数。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use the Amazon Bedrock Converse API and IAM roles for authentication. Pass previous messages in the request messages array to maintain conversational context. Use programming language-specific SDKs to establish consistent API interfaces.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Converse API 和 IAM 角色进行身份验证。传递请求消息数组中的先前消息以维护会话上下文。使用特定于编程语言的 SDK 建立一致的 API 接口。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在构建生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 应用程序，用于处理财务报告并为分析师提供摘要。应用程序必须运行两个计算环境。在一种环境中，AWS Lambda 函数必须使用 Python SDK 来按需分析报告。在第二个环境中，Amazon EKS 容器必须使用 JavaScript SDK 按计划批量处理多个报告。应用程序必须在整个多轮交互中维护对话上下文，跨环境使用相同的基础模型 (FM)，并确保一致的身份验证。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A medical company uses Amazon Bedrock to power a clinical documentation summarization system. The system produces inconsistent summaries when handling complex clinical documents. The system performed well on simple clinical documents. The company needs a solution that diagnoses inconsistencies, compares prompt performance against established metrics, and maintains historical records of prompt versions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create multiple prompt variants by using Prompt management in Amazon Bedrock. Manually test the prompts with simple clinical documents. Deploy the highest performing version by using the Amazon Bedrock console.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的提示管理创建多个提示变体。使用简单的临床文档手动测试提示。使用 Amazon Bedrock 控制台部署性能最高的版本。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement version control for prompts in a code repository with a test suite that contains complex clinical documents and quantifiable evaluation metrics. Use an automated testing framework to compare prompt versions and document performance patterns.
choices.textZh: 使用包含复杂临床文档和可量化评估指标的测试套件对代码存储库中的提示实施版本控制。使用自动化测试框架来比较提示版本和文档性能模式。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy each new prompt version to separate Amazon Bedrock API endpoints. Split production traffic between the endpoints. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to capture response metrics and user feedback for automatic version selection.
choices.textZh: 将每个新的提示版本部署到单独的 Amazon Bedrock API 终端节点。在端点之间分割生产流量。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 以捕获响应指标和用户反馈以自动选择版本。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create a custom prompt evaluation flow in Amazon Bedrock Flows that applies the same clinical document inputs to different prompt variants. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to analyze and score the factual accuracy of each version.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock Flows 中创建自定义提示评估流程，将相同的临床文档输入应用于不同的提示变体。使用 Amazon Comprehend Medical 对每个版本的事实准确性进行分析和评分。

promptZh: 一家医疗公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 为临床文档摘要系统提供支持。在处理复杂的临床文档时，系统会生成不一致的摘要。该系统在简单的临床文档上表现良好。该公司需要一种解决方案来诊断不一致情况，将即时性能与既定指标进行比较，并维护即时版本的历史记录。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A pharmaceutical company is developing a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application that uses an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. The knowledge base uses Amazon OpenSearch Service as a data source for more than 25 million scientific papers. Users report that the application produces inconsistent answers that cite irrelevant sections of papers when queries span methodology, results, and discussion sections of the papers. The company needs to improve the knowledge base to preserve semantic context across related paragraphs on the scale of the entire corpus of data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base to use fixed-size chunking. Set a 300-token maximum chunk size and a 10% overlap between chunks. Use an appropriate Amazon Bedrock embedding model.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库以使用固定大小分块。设置 300 个令牌的最大块大小和块之间 10% 的重叠。使用适当的 Amazon Bedrock 嵌入模型。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base to use hierarchical chunking. Use parent chunks that contain 1,000 tokens and child chunks that contain 200 tokens. Set a 50-token overlap between chunks.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库以使用分层分块。使用包含 1,000 个令牌的父块和包含 200 个令牌的子块。设置块之间 50 个令牌的重叠。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base to use semantic chunking. Use a buffer size of 1 and a breakpoint percentile threshold of 85% to determine chunk boundaries based on content meaning.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库以使用语义分块。使用缓冲区大小 1 和断点百分位阈值 85% 来根据内容含义确定块边界。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base not to use chunking. Manually split each document into separate files before ingestion. Apply post-processing reranking during retrieval.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库不使用分块。在摄取之前手动将每个文档拆分为单独的文件。在检索期间应用后处理重新排序。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家制药公司正在开发使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库的检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用程序。该知识库使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 作为超过 2500 万篇科学论文的数据源。用户报告说，当查询跨越论文的方法、结果和讨论部分时，该应用程序会产生不一致的答案，引用论文中不相关的部分。该公司需要改进知识库，以在整个数据集的规模上保留相关段落之间的语义上下文。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is building a serverless application that uses AWS Lambda functions to help students around the world summarize notes. The application uses Anthropic Claude through Amazon Bedrock. The company observes that most of the traffic occurs during evenings in each time zone. Users report experiencing throttling errors during peak usage times in their time zones. The company needs to resolve the throttling issues by ensuring continuous operation of the application. The solution must maintain application performance quality and must not require a fixed hourly cost during low traffic periods. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor model errors. Set provisioned throughput to a value that is safely higher than the peak traffic observed.
choices.textZh: 创建自定义 Amazon CloudWatch 指标来监控模型错误。将预置吞吐量设置为安全高于观察到的峰值流量的值。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor model errors. Set up a failover mechanism to redirect invocations to a backup AWS Region when the errors exceed a specified threshold.
choices.textZh: 创建自定义 Amazon CloudWatch 指标来监控模型错误。设置故障转移机制，以便在错误超过指定阈值时将调用重定向到备份 AWS 区域。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Enable invocation logging in Amazon Bedrock. Monitor key metrics such as Invocations, InputTokenCount, OutputTokenCount, and InvocationThrottles. Distribute traffic across cross-Region inference endpoints.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 中启用调用日志记录。监视关键指标，例如调用、InputTokenCount、OutputTokenCount 和 InvocableThrottles。跨区域推理端点分配流量。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Enable invocation logging in Amazon Bedrock. Monitor InvocationLatency, InvocationClientErrors, and InvocationServerErrors metrics. Distribute traffic across multiple versions of the same model.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 中启用调用日志记录。监视 InvocableLatency、InitationClientErrors 和 InitationServerErrors 指标。在同一模型的多个版本之间分配流量。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在构建一个无服务器应用程序，该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数来帮助世界各地的学生总结笔记。该应用程序通过 Amazon Bedrock 使用 Anthropic Claude。该公司观察到，每个时区的大部分流量都发生在晚上。用户报告在其所在时区的高峰使用时间遇到限制错误。公司需要通过确保应用程序的持续运行来解决限制问题。该解决方案必须保持应用程序性能质量，并且在低流量期间不得要求固定的每小时成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: Company configures a landing zone in AWS Control Tower. The company handles sensitive data that must remain within the European Union. The company must use only the eu-central-1 Region. The company uses Service Control Policies (SCPs) to enforce data residency policies. GenAI developers at the company are assigned IAM roles that have full permissions for Amazon Bedrock. The company must ensure that GenAI developers can use the Amazon Nova Pro model through Amazon Bedrock only by using cross-Region inference (CRI) and only in eu-central-1. The company enables model access for the GenAI developer IAM roles in Amazon Bedrock. However, when a GenAI developer attempts to invoke the model through the Amazon Bedrock Chat/Text playground, the GenAI developer receives the following error: User arn:aws:sts:123456789012:assumed-role/AssumedDevRole/DevUserName Action: bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream On resource(s): arn:aws:bedrock:eu-west-3::foundation-model/amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 Context: a service control policy explicitly denies the action The company needs a solution to resolve the error. The solution must retain the company's existing governance controls and must provide precise access control. The solution must comply with the company's existing data residency policies. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

choices.textZh: Extend the existing SCPs to enable CRI for the eu.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 inference profile

choices.label: E

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A financial services company uses an AI application to process financial documents by using Amazon Bedrock. During business hours, the application handles approximately 10,000 requests each hour, which requires consistent throughput. The company uses the CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API to purchase provisioned throughput. Amazon CloudWatch metrics show that the provisioned capacity is unused while on-demand requests are being throttled. The company finds the following code in the application: response = bedrock_runtime.invoke_model( modelId="anthropic.claude-v2", body=json.dumps(payload) ) The company needs the application to use the provisioned throughput and to resolve the throttling issues. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Increase the number of model units (MUs) in the provisioned throughput configuration.
choices.textZh: 增加预配置吞吐量配置中的模型单元 (MU) 数量。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Replace the model ID parameter with the ARN of the provisioned model that the CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API returns.
choices.textZh: 将模型 ID 参数替换为 CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API 返回的预配置模型的 ARN。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Add exponential backoff retry logic to handle throttling exceptions during peak hours.
choices.textZh: 添加指数退避重试逻辑以处理高峰时段的限制异常。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Modify the application to use the invokeModelWithResponseStream API instead of the invokeModel API.
choices.textZh: 修改应用程序以使用 invokeModelWithResponseStream API 而不是 invokeModel API。

promptZh: 一家金融服务公司使用 AI 应用程序通过 Amazon Bedrock 处理财务文档。在工作时间内，应用程序每小时处理大约 10,000 个请求，这需要一致的吞吐量。该公司使用 CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API 来购买预配置吞吐量。 Amazon CloudWatch 指标显示，在按需请求受到限制时，预置容量未使用。该公司在应用程序中发现以下代码： response = bedrock_runtime.invoke_model( modelId="anthropic.claude-v2", body=json.dumps(payload) ) 该公司需要应用程序使用预配置的吞吐量并解决限制问题。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A bank is building a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses Amazon Bedrock to assess loan applications by using scanned financial documents. The application must extract structured data from the documents. The application must redact personally identifiable information (PII) before inference. The application must use foundation models (FMs) to generate approvals. The application must route low-confidence document extraction results to human reviewers who are within the same AWS Region as the loan applicant. The company must ensure that the application complies with strict Regional data residency and auditability requirements. The application must be able to scale to handle 25,000 applications each day and provide 99.9% availability. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Select THREE.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy Amazon Textract and Amazon Augmented AI within the same Region to extract relevant data from the scanned documents. Route low-confidence pages to human reviewers.
choices.textZh: 在同一区域内部署 Amazon Textract 和 Amazon Augmented AI，以从扫描的文档中提取相关数据。将低置信度页面发送给人工审阅者。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda functions to detect and redact PII from submitted documents before inference. Apply Amazon Bedrock guardrails to prevent inappropriate or unauthorized content in model outputs. Configure Region-specific IAM roles to enforce data residency requirements and to control access to the extracted data.
choices.textZh: 在推理之前使用 AWS Lambda 函数从提交的文档中检测和编辑 PII。应用 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以防止模型输出中出现不当或未经授权的内容。配置区域特定的 IAM 角色以强制执行数据驻留要求并控制对提取的数据的访问。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Kendra and Amazon OpenSearch Service to extract field-level values semantically from the uploaded documents before inference.
choices.textZh: 在推理之前使用 Amazon Kendra 和 Amazon OpenSearch Service 从上传的文档中按语义提取字段级值。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Store uploaded documents in Amazon S3 and apply object metadata. Configure IAM policies to store original documents within the same Region as each applicant. Enable object tagging for future audits.
choices.textZh: 将上传的文档存储在 Amazon S3 中并应用对象元数据。配置 IAM 策略，以便将原始文档存储在与每位申请人相同的 Region 内。启用对象标签以备将来审计。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Use AWS Glue Data Quality to validate the structured document data. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a review workflow that includes a prompt engineering step that transforms validated data into optimized prompts before invoking Amazon Bedrock to assess loan applications.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Glue Data Quality 来验证结构化文档数据。使用 AWS Step Functions 来编排一个审查工作流，该工作流包括一个提示工程步骤，该步骤将已验证的数据转换为优化的提示，然后再调用 Amazon Bedrock 来评估贷款申请。

choices.label: F
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify to generate fairness and bias reports based on model scoring decisions that Amazon Bedrock makes.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Clarify 根据 Amazon Bedrock 所做的模型评分决策生成公平性和偏差报告。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家银行正在构建生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 通过扫描的财务文档来评估贷款申请。应用程序必须从文档中提取结构化数据。应用程序必须在推理之前编辑个人身份信息 (PII)。应用程序必须使用基础模型 (FM) 来生成批准。应用程序必须将低可信度文档提取结果发送给与贷款申请人位于同一 AWS 区域的人工审核员。公司必须确保应用程序符合严格的区域数据驻留和可审核性要求。应用程序必须能够扩展以每天处理 25,000 个应用程序并提供 99.9% 的可用性。 哪种解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？ （选择三项。）

prompt: A retail company has a generative AI (GenAI) product recommendation application that uses Amazon Bedrock. The application suggests products to customers based on browsing history and demographics. The company needs to implement fairness evaluation across multiple demographic groups to detect and measure bias in recommendations between two prompt approaches. The company wants to collect and monitor fairness metrics in real time. The company must receive an alert if the fairness metrics show a discrepancy of more than 15% between demographic groups. The company must receive weekly reports that compare the performance of the two prompt approaches. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST custom development effort?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard to display default metrics from Amazon Bedrock API calls. Create custom metrics based on model outputs. Set up Amazon EventBridge rules to invoke AWS Lambda functions that perform post-processing analysis on model responses and publish custom fairness metrics.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板以显示来自 Amazon Bedrock API 调用的默认指标。根据模型输出创建自定义指标。设置 Amazon EventBridge 规则以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，这些函数对模型响应执行后处理分析并发布自定义公平性指标。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create the two prompt variants in Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management. Use Amazon Bedrock Flows to deploy the prompt variants with defined traffic allocation. Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to monitor demographic fairness. Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms on the GuardrailContentSource dimension by using InvocationsIntervened metrics to detect recommendation discrepancy threshold violations.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 中创建两个提示变体。使用 Amazon Bedrock Flows 通过定义的流量分配来部署提示变体。配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以监控人口统计公平性。通过使用 InvoicesIntervened 指标在 GuardrailContentSource 维度上设置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报来检测建议差异阈值违规情况。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Set up Amazon SageMaker Clarify to analyze model outputs. Publish fairness metrics to Amazon CloudWatch. Create CloudWatch composite alarms that combine SageMaker Clarify bias metrics with Amazon Bedrock latency metrics.
choices.textZh: 设置 Amazon SageMaker Clarify 来分析模型输出。将公平指标发布到 Amazon CloudWatch。创建将 SageMaker Clarify 偏差指标与 Amazon Bedrock 延迟指标相结合的 CloudWatch 复合警报。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock model evaluation job to compare fairness between the two prompt variants. Enable model invocation logging in Amazon CloudWatch. Set up CloudWatch alarms for InvocationsIntervened metrics with a dimension for each demographic group.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon Bedrock 模型评估作业以比较两个提示变体之间的公平性。在 Amazon CloudWatch 中启用模型调用日志记录。使用每个人口统计组的维度，为 IncallsIntervened 指标设置 CloudWatch 警报。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家零售公司有一个使用 Amazon Bedrock 的生成式 AI (GenAI) 产品推荐应用程序。该应用程序根据浏览历史和人口统计数据向客户推荐产品。该公司需要对多个人口群体实施公平性评估，以检测和衡量两种提示方法之间推荐的偏差。该公司希望实时收集和监控公平性指标。如果公平指标显示人口群体之间的差异超过 15%，则公司必须收到警报。公司必须收到每周报告，比较两种即时方法的性能。哪种解决方案能够以最少的定制开发工作满足这些要求？

prompt: A finance company is developing an AI assistant to help clients plan investments and manage their portfolios. The company identifies several high-risk conversation patterns such as requests for specific stock recommendations or guaranteed returns. High-risk conversation patterns could lead to regulatory violations if the company cannot implement appropriate controls. The company must ensure that the AI assistant does not provide inappropriate financial advice, generate content about competitors, or make claims that are not factually grounded in the company's approved financial guidance. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to implement a solution. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Select THREE)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Add the high-risk conversation patterns to a denied topics guardrail.
choices.textZh: 将高风险对话模式添加到被拒绝的主题护栏中。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure a content filter guardrail to filter prompts that contain the high-risk conversation patterns.
choices.textZh: 配置内容过滤器防护栏以过滤包含高风险对话模式的提示。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure a content filter guardrail to filter prompts that contain competitor names.
choices.textZh: 配置内容过滤器护栏以过滤包含竞争对手名称的提示。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Add the names of competitors as custom word filters. Set the input and output actions to block.
choices.textZh: 将竞争对手的名称添加为自定义词过滤器。将输入和输出操作设置为阻止。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Set a low grounding score threshold.
choices.textZh: 设置较低的 grounding score 阈值。

choices.label: F
choices.text: Set a high grounding score threshold.
choices.textZh: 设置较高的 grounding score 阈值。

promptZh: 一家金融公司正在开发人工智能助手，以帮助客户规划投资和管理其投资组合。该公司确定了几种高风险对话模式，例如请求特定股票推荐或保证回报。如果公司无法实施适当的控制，高风险的对话模式可能会导致违反监管规定。公司必须确保人工智能助手不会提供不适当的财务建议、生成有关竞争对手的内容或做出不符合公司批准的财务指导的事实主张。该公司希望使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 来实施解决方案。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？ （选择三项）

prompt: A wildlife conservation agency operates zoos globally. The agency uses various sensors, trackers, and audiovisual recorders to monitor animal behavior. The agency wants to launch a generative AI (GenAI) assistant that can ingest multimodal data to study animal behavior. The GenAI assistant must support natural language queries, avoid speculative behavioral interpretations, and maintain audit logs for ethical research audits. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Ingest raw videos into Amazon Rekognition to detect animal postures and expressions. Use Amazon Data Firehose to stream sensor and GPS data into Amazon S3. Prompt an Amazon Bedrock FM using basic templates stored in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use IAM for access control. Use AWS CloudTrail for audit logging.
choices.textZh: 将原始视频提取到 Amazon Rekognition 中以检测动物姿势和表情。使用 Amazon Data Firehose 将传感器和 GPS 数据流式传输到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中存储的基本模板提示 Amazon Bedrock FM。使用 IAM 进行访问控制。使用 AWS CloudTrail 进行审核日志记录。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Processing and Amazon Transcribe to pre-process multimodal data. Ingest curated summaries into an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Apply Amazon Bedrock guardrails to restrict speculative outputs. Use AWS AppConfig to manage prompt templates. Use AWS CloudTrail to log research activity for audits.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Processing 和 Amazon Transcribe 预处理多模式数据。将精选摘要纳入 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。应用 Amazon Bedrock 护栏来限制投机产出。使用 AWS AppConfig 管理提示模板。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录研究活动以供审核。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Serverless to index behavioral logs and telemetry. Use Amazon Comprehend to extract entities. Use Amazon Bedrock to answer questions over indexed data. Use IAM for access control and CloudTrail for audit logging.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless 为行为日志和遥测建立索引。使用 Amazon Comprehend 提取实体。使用 Amazon Bedrock 回答有关索引数据的问题。使用 IAM 进行访问控制，使用 CloudTrail 进行审核日志记录。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure Amazon O Business to federate data across Amazon S3, Amazon Kinesis, and Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. Use EventBridge for ingestion orchestration. Use custom AWS Lambda functions to filter LLM outputs for ethical compliance.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon O Business 以跨 Amazon S3、Amazon Kinesis 和 Amazon SageMaker Feature Store 联合数据。使用 EventBridge 进行摄取编排。使用自定义 AWS Lambda 函数来过滤 LLM 输出以确保道德合规性。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家野生动物保护机构在全球范围内经营动物园。该机构使用各种传感器、跟踪器和视听记录器来监测动物行为。该机构希望推出一款生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 助手，可以摄取多模式数据来研究动物行为。 GenAI 助手必须支持自然语言查询，避免推测性行为解释，并维护道德研究审计的审计日志。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company uses Amazon Bedrock to implement a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)-based system to serve medical information to users. The company needs to compare multiple chunking strategies, evaluate the generation quality of two foundation models (FMs), and enforce quality thresholds for deployment. Which Amazon Bedrock evaluation configuration will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a retrieve-only evaluation job that uses a supported version of Anthropic Claude Sonnet as the evaluator model. Configure metrics for context relevance and context coverage. Define deployment thresholds in a separate CI/CD pipeline.
choices.textZh: 创建仅检索评估作业，该作业使用受支持的 Anthropic Claude Sonnet 版本作为评估器模型。配置上下文相关性和上下文覆盖范围的指标。在单独的 CI/CD 管道中定义部署阈值。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create a retrieve-and-generate evaluation job that uses custom precision-at-k metrics and an LLM-as-a- judge metric with a scale of 1–5. Include each chunking strategy in the evaluation dataset. Use a supported version of Anthropic Claude Sonnet to evaluate responses from both FMs.
choices.textZh: 创建一个检索并生成评估作业，该作业使用自定义的 precision-at-k 指标和范围为 1-5 的 LLM-as-a-judge 指标。将每个分块策略包含在评估数据集中。使用受支持的 Anthropic Claude Sonnet 版本来评估两个 FM 的响应。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create a separate evaluation job for each chunking strategy and FM combination. Use Amazon Bedrock built-in metrics for correctness and completeness. Manually review scores before deployment approval.
choices.textZh: 为每个分块策略和 FM 组合创建单独的评估作业。使用 Amazon Bedrock 内置指标来确保正确性和完整性。在部署批准之前手动审核分数。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Set up a pipeline that uses multiple retrieve-only evaluation jobs to assess retrieval quality. Create separate evaluation jobs for both FMs that use Amazon Nova Pro as the LLM-as-a-judge model. Evaluate based on faithfulness and citation precision metrics.
choices.textZh: 设置一个使用多个仅检索评估作业来评估检索质量的管道。为使用 Amazon Nova Pro 作为 LLM-as-a-judge 模型的两个 FM 创建单独的评估作业。根据忠实度和引用精度指标进行评估。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 实施基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的系统，为用户提供医疗信息。该公司需要比较多种分块策略，评估两个基础模型 (FM) 的生成质量，并强制执行部署质量阈值。哪种 Amazon Bedrock 评估配置可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company purchases Amazon Q Developer Pro subscriptions for 500 developers to improve code quality and productivity. The company needs to create an observability system that tracks adoption metrics across the company. The observability system must be able to identify active subscription users compared to underused subscriptions. The system must give the company the ability to recognize power users every quarter and to identify teams that require additional training. The system must provide visibility into usage patterns such as the number of lines of Amazon Q generated code that each user has accepted. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a usage dashboard for Amazon Q Developer. Use the usage dashboard to track aggregated usage adoption metrics.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use the Amazon Q Developer built-in administrator dashboard to track user adoption metrics across the company’s organization in AWS Organizations.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Q Developer 内置管理员控制面板在 AWS Organizations 中跟踪整个公司组织的用户采用指标。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Collect user-level metrics in Amazon Q Developer. Store the metrics in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the usage data. Create dashboards to show adoption metrics for users and teams.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon Q Developer 中收集用户级指标。将指标存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon QuickSight 可视化使用数据。创建仪表板以显示用户和团队的采用指标。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure AWS CloudTrail to track all Amazon Q Developer API calls in the company’s organization in AWS Organizations. Use an AWS Lambda function to process the logs. Store the processed logs in Amazon DynamoDB. Create custom dashboards in Amazon Managed Grafana to visualize the data.
choices.textZh: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 以跟踪 AWS Organizations 中公司组织中的所有 Amazon Q Developer API 调用。使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理日志。将处理后的日志存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。在 Amazon Managed Grafana 中创建自定义控制面板以可视化数据。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司为 500 名开发人员购买 Amazon Q Developer Pro 订阅，以提高代码质量和工作效率。公司需要创建一个可观察系统来跟踪整个公司的采用指标。可观察性系统必须能够识别活跃订阅用户与未充分利用的订阅。该系统必须使公司能够每季度识别高级用户并识别需要额外培训的团队。系统必须提供对使用模式的可见性，例如每个用户已接受的 Amazon Q 生成代码的行数。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A company runs a generative AI (GenAI)-powered summarization application in an application AWS account that uses Amazon Bedrock. The application architecture includes an Amazon API Gateway REST API that forwards requests to AWS Lambda functions that are attached to private VPC subnets. The application summarizes sensitive customer records that the company stores in a governed data lake in a centralized data storage account. The company has enabled Amazon S3, Amazon Athena, and AWS Glue in the data storage account. The company must ensure that calls that the application makes to Amazon Bedrock use only private connectivity between the company's application VPC and Amazon Bedrock. The company's data lake must provide fine-grained column-level access across the company's AWS accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: In the application account, create interface VPC endpoints for Amazon Bedrock runtimes. Run Lambda functions in private subnets. Use IAM conditions on inference and data-plane policies to allow calls only to approved endpoints and roles. In the data storage account, use AWS Lake Formation LF-tag- based access control to create table-level and column-level cross-account grants.
choices.textZh: 在应用程序账户中，为 Amazon Bedrock 运行时创建接口 VPC 终端节点。在私有子网中运行 Lambda 函数。在推理和数据平面策略上使用 IAM 条件，仅允许调用经批准的终端节点和角色。在数据存储账户中，使用基于 AWS Lake Formation LF 标签的访问控制来创建表级和列级跨账户授权。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Run Lambda functions in private subnets. Configure a NAT gateway to provide access to Amazon Bedrock and the data lake. Use S3 bucket policies and ACLs to manage permissions. Export AWS CloudTrail logs to Amazon S3 to perform weekly reviews.
choices.textZh: 在私有子网中运行 Lambda 函数。配置 NAT 网关以提供对 Amazon Bedrock 和数据湖的访问。使用 S3 存储桶策略和 ACL 来管理权限。将 AWS CloudTrail 日志导出到 Amazon S3 以执行每周审核。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create a gateway endpoint only for Amazon S3 in the application account. Invoke Amazon Bedrock through public endpoints. Use database-level grants in AWS Lake Formation to manage data access. Stream AWS CloudTrail logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Do not set up metric filters or alarms.
choices.textZh: 仅在应用程序账户中为 Amazon S3 创建网关终端节点。通过公共终端节点调用 Amazon Bedrock。使用 AWS Lake Formation 中的数据库级授权来管理数据访问。将 AWS CloudTrail 日志流式传输到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。不要设置指标过滤器或警报。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use VPC endpoints to provide access to Amazon Bedrock and Amazon S3 in the application account. Use only IAM path-based policies to manage data lake access. Send AWS CloudTrail logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Periodically create dashboards and allow public fallback for cross-Region reads to reduce setup time.
choices.textZh: 使用 VPC 终端节点提供对应用程序账户中的 Amazon Bedrock 和 Amazon S3 的访问。仅使用 IAM 基于路径的策略来管理数据湖访问。将 AWS CloudTrail 日志发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。定期创建仪表板并允许跨区域读取的公共回退以减少设置时间。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家公司在使用 Amazon Bedrock 的应用程序 AWS 账户中运行由生成式 AI (GenAI) 支持的摘要应用程序。该应用程序架构包括一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API，该 API 将请求转发到附加到私有 VPC 子网的 AWS Lambda 函数。该应用程序汇总了公司存储在集中数据存储帐户的受管数据湖中的敏感客户记录。该公司已在数据存储账户中启用 Amazon S3、Amazon Athena 和 AWS Glue。公司必须确保应用程序对 Amazon Bedrock 进行的调用仅使用公司应用程序 VPC 和 Amazon Bedrock 之间的专用连接。公司的数据湖必须跨公司的 AWS 账户提供细粒度的列级访问。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A pharmaceutical company is developing a Retrieval Augmented Generation application that uses an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. The knowledge base uses Amazon OpenSearch Service as a data source for more than 25 million scientific papers. Users report that the application produces inconsistent answers that cite irrelevant sections of papers when queries span methodology, results, and discussion sections of the papers. The company needs to improve the knowledge base to preserve semantic context across related paragraphs on the scale of the entire corpus of data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base to use fixed-size chunking. Set a 300-token maximum chunk size and a 10% overlap between chunks. Use an appropriate Amazon Bedrock embedding model.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库以使用固定大小分块。设置 300 个令牌的最大块大小和块之间 10% 的重叠。使用适当的 Amazon Bedrock 嵌入模型。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base to use hierarchical chunking. Use parent chunks that contain 1,000 tokens and child chunks that contain 200 tokens. Set a 50-token overlap between chunks.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库以使用分层分块。使用包含 1,000 个令牌的父块和包含 200 个令牌的子块。设置块之间 50 个令牌的重叠。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base to use semantic chunking. Use a buffer size of 1 and a breakpoint percentile threshold of 85% to determine chunk boundaries based on content meaning.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库以使用语义分块。使用缓冲区大小 1 和断点百分位阈值 85% 来根据内容含义确定块边界。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure the knowledge base not to use chunking. Manually split each document into separate files before ingestion. Apply post-processing reranking during retrieval.
choices.textZh: 配置知识库不使用分块。在摄取之前手动将每个文档拆分为单独的文件。在检索期间应用后处理重新排序。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家制药公司正在开发一个使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库的检索增强生成应用程序。该知识库使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 作为超过 2500 万篇科学论文的数据源。用户报告说，当查询跨越论文的方法、结果和讨论部分时，该应用程序会产生不一致的答案，引用论文中不相关的部分。该公司需要改进知识库，以在整个数据集的规模上保留相关段落之间的语义上下文。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A financial services company needs to build a document analysis system that uses Amazon Bedrock to process quarterly reports. The system must analyze financial data, perform sentiment analysis, and validate compliance across batches of reports. Each batch contains 5 reports. Each report requires multiple foundation model (FM) calls. The solution must finish the analysis within 10 seconds for each batch. Current sequential processing takes 45 seconds for each batch. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process each analysis type sequentially. Configure the Lambda function timeouts to 10 seconds. Configure automatic retries with exponential backoff.
choices.textZh: 使用具有预配置并发性的 AWS Lambda 函数来按顺序处理每种分析类型。将 Lambda 函数超时配置为 10 秒。配置具有指数退避的自动重试。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use AWS Step Functions with a Parallel state to invoke separate AWS Lambda functions for each analysis type simultaneously. Configure Amazon Bedrock client timeouts. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to track execution time and model inference latency.
choices.textZh: 将 AWS Step Functions 与并行状态结合使用，同时为每种分析类型调用单独的 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Amazon Bedrock 客户端超时。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标来跟踪执行时间和模型推理延迟。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an Amazon SQS queue to buffer analysis requests. Deploy multiple AWS Lambda functions with reserved concurrency. Configure each Lambda function to process different aspects of each report sequentially and then combine the results.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon SQS 队列来缓冲分析请求。使用预留并发部署多个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置每个 Lambda 函数以按顺序处理每个报告的不同方面，然后合并结果。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy an Amazon ECS cluster that runs containers that process each report sequentially. Use a load balancer to distribute batch workloads. Configure an auto-scaling policy based on CPU utilization.
choices.textZh: 部署一个 Amazon ECS 集群，该集群运行按顺序处理每个报告的容器。使用负载均衡器来分配批量工作负载。根据CPU利用率配置自动伸缩策略。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司需要构建一个使用 Amazon Bedrock 处理季度报告的文档分析系统。系统必须分析财务数据、执行情绪分析并验证各批次报告的合规性。每批次包含 5 个报告。每个报告都需要多次基础模型 (FM) 调用。每批次解决方案必须在 10 秒内完成分析。当前每个批次的顺序处理需要 45 秒。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: An ecommerce company is using Amazon Bedrock to build a generative AI (GenAI) application. The application uses AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a multi-agent workflow to produce detailed product descriptions. The workflow consists of three sequential states: a description generator, a technical specifications validator, and a brand voice consistency checker. Each state produces intermediate reasoning traces and outputs that are passed to the next state. The application uses an Amazon S3 bucket for process storage and to store outputs. During testing, the company discovers that outputs between Step Functions states frequently exceed the 256 KB quota and cause workflow failures. A GenAI Developer needs to revise the application architecture to efficiently handle the Step Functions 256 KB quota and maintain workflow observability. The revised architecture must preserve the existing multi-agent reasoning and acting (ReAct) pattern. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Store intermediate outputs in Amazon DynamoDB. Pass only references between states. Create a Map state that retrieves the complete data from DynamoDB when required for each agent's processing step.
choices.textZh: 将中间输出存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。仅在状态之间传递引用。创建一个映射状态，以便在每个代理的处理步骤需要时从 DynamoDB 检索完整数据。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure an Amazon Bedrock integration to use the S3 bucket URI in the input parameters for large outputs. Use the ResultPath and ResultSelector fields to route S3 references between the agent steps while maintaining the sequential validation workflow.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 集成以在输入参数中使用 S3 存储桶 URI 来实现大型输出。使用 ResultPath 和 ResultSelector 字段在代理步骤之间路由 S3 引用，同时维护顺序验证工作流程。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda functions to compress outputs to less than 256 KB before each agent state. Configure each agent task to decompress outputs before processing and to compress results before passing them to the next state.
choices.textZh: 在每个代理状态之前，使用 AWS Lambda 函数将输出压缩到小于 256 KB。将每个代理任务配置为在处理之前解压缩输出，并在将结果传递到下一个状态之前压缩结果。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure a separate Step Functions state machine to handle each agent’s processing. Use Amazon EventBridge to coordinate the execution flow between state machines. Use S3 references for the outputs as event data.
choices.textZh: 配置单独的 Step Functions 状态机来处理每个代理的处理。使用 Amazon EventBridge 协调状态机之间的执行流。使用输出的 S3 引用作为事件数据。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家电子商务公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序。该应用程序使用 AWS Step Functions 编排多代理工作流程以生成详细的产品描述。该工作流程由三个连续状态组成：描述生成器、技术规范验证器和品牌声音一致性检查器。每个状态都会产生传递到下一个状态的中间推理轨迹和输出。该应用程序使用 Amazon S3 存储桶进行流程存储并存储输出。在测试过程中，该公司发现 Step Functions 状态之间的输出经常超过 256 KB 配额并导致工作流程失败。 GenAI 开发人员需要修改应用程序架构，以有效处理 Step Functions 256 KB 配额并保持工作流可观察性。修订后的架构必须保留现有的多智能体推理和行动 (ReAct) 模式。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A medical device company wants to feed reports of medical procedures that used the company’s devices into an AI assistant. To protect patient privacy, the AI assistant must expose patient personally identifiable information (PII) only to surgeons. The AI assistant must redact PII for engineers. The AI assistant must reference only medical reports that are less than 3 years old. The company stores reports in an Amazon S3 bucket as soon as each report is published. The company has already set up an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. The AI assistant uses Amazon Cognito to authenticate users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enable Amazon Macie PII detection on the S3 bucket. Use an S3 trigger to invoke an AWS Lambda function that redacts PII from the reports. Configure the Lambda function to delete outdated documents and invoke knowledge base syncing.
choices.textZh: 在 S3 存储桶上启用 Amazon Macie PII 检测。使用 S3 触发器调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数从报告中编辑 PII。配置 Lambda 函数以删除过期文档并调用知识库同步。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Invoke an AWS Lambda function to sync the S3 bucket and the knowledge base when a new report is uploaded. Use a second Lambda function with Amazon Comprehend to redact PII for engineers. Use S3 Lifecycle rules to remove reports older than 3 years.
choices.textZh: 上传新报告时调用 AWS Lambda 函数以同步 S3 存储桶和知识库。使用第二个 Lambda 函数与 Amazon Comprehend 为工程师编辑 PII。使用 S3 生命周期规则删除超过 3 年的报告。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to remove reports that are older than 3 years. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to run daily syncs between the bucket and the knowledge base. When users interact with the AI assistant, apply a guardrail configuration selected based on the user’s Cognito user group to redact PII from responses when required.
choices.textZh: 设置 S3 生命周期配置以删除超过 3 年的报告。安排 AWS Lambda 函数在存储桶和知识库之间运行每日同步。当用户与 AI 助手交互时，应用根据用户的 Cognito 用户组选择的护栏配置，以便在需要时从响应中编辑 PII。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create a second knowledge base. Use Lambda and Amazon Comprehend to redact PII before syncing to the second knowledge base. Route users to the appropriate knowledge base based on Cognito group membership.
choices.textZh: 创建第二个知识库。在同步到第二个知识库之前，使用 Lambda 和 Amazon Comprehend 编辑 PII。根据 Cognito 组成员身份将用户路由到适当的知识库。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家医疗设备公司希望将使用该公司设备的医疗程序报告提供给人工智能助手。为了保护患者隐私，人工智能助手必须仅向外科医生公开患者个人身份信息 (PII)。 AI 助手必须为工程师编辑 PII。 AI助手只能参考3年前的医疗报告。每份报告发布后，该公司都会将报告存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该公司已经建立了 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。 AI 助手使用 Amazon Cognito 对用户进行身份验证。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A bank is developing a generative AI (GenAI)-powered AI assistant that uses Amazon Bedrock to assist the bank’s website users with account inquiries and financial guidance. The bank must ensure that the AI assistant does not reveal any personally identifiable information (PII) in customer interactions. The AI assistant must not send PII in prompts to the GenAI model. The AI assistant must not respond to customer requests to provide investment advice. The bank must collect audit logs of all customer interactions, including any images or documents that are transmitted during customer interactions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Macie to detect and redact PII in user inputs and in the model responses. Apply prompt engineering techniques to force the model to avoid investment advice topics. Use AWS CloudTrail to capture conversation logs.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Macie 检测和编辑用户输入和模型响应中的 PII。应用及时的工程技术来迫使模型避免投资建议主题。使用 AWS CloudTrail 捕获对话日志。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use an AWS Lambda function and Amazon Comprehend to detect and redact PII. Use Amazon Comprehend topic modeling to prevent the AI assistant from discussing investment advice topics. Set up custom metrics in Amazon CloudWatch to capture customer conversations.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon Comprehend 检测和编辑 PII。使用 Amazon Comprehend 主题建模来防止 AI 助手讨论投资建议主题。在 Amazon CloudWatch 中设置自定义指标以捕获客户对话。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to apply a sensitive information policy to detect and filter PII. Set up a topic policy to ensure that the AI assistant avoids investment advice topics. Use the Converse API to log model invocations. Enable delivery and image logging to Amazon S3.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以应用敏感信息策略来检测和过滤 PII。设置话题策略，确保AI助手避开投资建议话题。使用 Converse API 记录模型调用。启用到 Amazon S3 的传输和图像记录。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use regex controls to match patterns for PII. Apply prompt engineering techniques to avoid returning PII or investment advice topics to customers. Enable model invocation logging, delivery logging, and image logging to Amazon S3.
choices.textZh: 使用正则表达式控件来匹配 PII 的模式。应用及时的工程技术以避免将 PII 或投资建议主题返回给客户。启用模型调用日志记录、传输日志记录和图像日志记录到 Amazon S3。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家银行正在开发一款由生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 支持的人工智能助手，该助手使用 Amazon Bedrock 协助银行网站用户进行账户查询和财务指导。银行必须确保人工智能助手不会在客户互动中泄露任何个人身份信息（PII）。 AI 助手不得在提示中向 GenAI 模型发送 PII。人工智能助手不得响应客户请求提供投资建议。银行必须收集所有客户互动的审核日志，包括客户互动期间传输的任何图像或文档。哪种解决方案能够以最少的操作工作满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is using Amazon Bedrock to build a customer-facing AI assistant that handles sensitive customer inquiries. The company must use defense-in-depth safety controls to block sophisticated prompt injection attacks. The company must keep audit logs of all safety interventions. The AI assistant must have cross- Region failover capabilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails with content filters set to high to protect against prompt injection attacks. Use a guardrail profile to implement cross-Region guardrail inference. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs with custom metrics to capture detailed guardrail intervention events.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏，将内容过滤器设置为高，以防止即时注入攻击。使用护栏配置文件实现跨Region的护栏推理。将 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 与自定义指标结合使用来捕获详细的护栏干预事件。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails with content filters set to high. Use AWS WAF to block suspicious inputs. Use AWS CloudTrail to log API calls.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏，并将内容过滤器设置为高。使用 AWS WAF 阻止可疑输入。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录 API 调用。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy Amazon Comprehend custom classifiers to detect prompt injection attacks. Use Amazon API Gateway request validation. Use CloudWatch Logs to capture intervention events.
choices.textZh: 部署 Amazon Comprehend 自定义分类器以检测提示注入攻击。使用 Amazon API Gateway 请求验证。使用 CloudWatch Logs 捕获干预事件。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails with custom content filters and word filters set to high. Configure cross-Region guardrail replication for failover. Store logs in AWS CloudTrail for compliance auditing.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏，将自定义内容过滤器和单词过滤器设置为高。配置跨区域 Guardrail 复制以进行故障转移。将日志存储在 AWS CloudTrail 中以进行合规性审核。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建面向客户的 AI 助手，用于处理敏感的客户查询。公司必须使用深度防御安全控制来阻止复杂的即时注入攻击。公司必须保留所有安全干预措施的审核日志。 AI助手必须具备跨Region的故障转移能力。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A financial services company is deploying a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses Amazon Bedrock to assist customer service representatives to provide personalized investment advice to customers. The company must implement a comprehensive governance solution that follows responsible AI practices and meets regulatory requirements. The solution must detect and prevent hallucinations in recommendations. The solution must have safety controls for customer interactions. The solution must also monitor model behavior drift in real time and maintain audit trails of all prompt-response pairs for regulatory review. The company must deploy the solution within 60 days. The solution must integrate with the company's existing compliance dashboard and respond to customers within 200 ms. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to apply custom content filters and toxicity detection. Use Amazon Bedrock Model Evaluation to detect hallucinations. Store prompt-response pairs in Amazon DynamoDB to capture audit trails and set a TTL. Integrate Amazon CloudWatch custom metrics with the existing compliance dashboard.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以应用自定义内容过滤器和毒性检测。使用 Amazon Bedrock 模型评估来检测幻觉。在 Amazon DynamoDB 中存储提示-响应对以捕获审核跟踪并设置 TTL。将 Amazon CloudWatch 自定义指标与现有合规性仪表板集成。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy Amazon Bedrock and use AWS PrivateLink to access the application securely. Use AWS Lambda functions to implement custom prompt validation. Store prompt-response pairs in an Amazon S3 bucket and configure S3 Lifecycle policies. Create custom Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to monitor model performance metrics.
choices.textZh: 部署 Amazon Bedrock 并使用 AWS PrivateLink 安全地访问应用程序。使用 AWS Lambda 函数实施自定义提示验证。将提示-响应对存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中并配置 S3 生命周期策略。创建自定义 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板来监控模型性能指标。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Agents and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to ground responses. Use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to enforce content safety. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to store and index prompt-response pairs. Integrate OpenSearch Service with Amazon QuickSight to create compliance reports and to detect model behavior drift.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 代理和 Amazon Bedrock 知识库来进行地面响应。使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 加强内容安全。使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 存储提示-响应对并为其编制索引。将 OpenSearch Service 与 Amazon QuickSight 集成以创建合规性报告并检测模型行为偏差。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to detect model behavior drift. Use AWS WAF to filter content. Store customer interactions in an encrypted Amazon RDS database. Use Amazon API Gateway to create custom HTTP APIs to integrate with the compliance dashboard.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor 检测模型行为漂移。使用 AWS WAF 过滤内容。将客户交互存储在加密的 Amazon RDS 数据库中。使用 Amazon API Gateway 创建自定义 HTTP API 以与合规性仪表板集成。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在部署生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 协助客户服务代表向客户提供个性化投资建议。公司必须实施全面的治理解决方案，遵循负责任的人工智能实践并满足监管要求。该解决方案必须检测并防止建议中的幻觉。该解决方案必须具有针对客户交互的安全控制。该解决方案还必须实时监控模型行为漂移，并维护所有提示响应对的审计跟踪以供监管审查。公司必须在 60 天内部署该解决方案。该解决方案必须与公司现有的合规仪表板集成，并在 200 毫秒内响应客户。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A software company is using Amazon Q Business to build an AI assistant that allows employees to access company information and personal information by using natural language prompts. The company stores this information in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each department in the company has a dedicated prefix in the S3 bucket. Each object name includes the S3 prefix of the department that it belongs to. Each department can belong to only a single group in AWS IAM Identity Center. Each employee belongs to a single department. The company configures Amazon Q Business to access data stored in an S3 bucket as a data source. The company needs to ensure that the AI assistant respects access controls based on the user's IAM Identity Center group membership. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a JSON file named acl.json in each department folder. In each file, create access control entries that specify the IAM Identity Center group that should have access to that department's data. Indicate the location of the JSON file in the Access Control section of the data source settings.
choices.textZh: 在每个部门文件夹中创建一个名为 acl.json 的 JSON 文件。在每个文件中，创建访问控制条目，指定应有权访问该部门数据的 IAM Identity Center 组。在数据源设置的访问控制部分中指示 JSON 文件的位置。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create a single JSON file named acl.json at the top level of the S3 bucket. Add access control entries that map each department's S3 prefix to its corresponding IAM Identity Center group. Indicate the location of the JSON file in the Access Control section of the data source settings.
choices.textZh: 在 S3 存储桶的顶层创建一个名为 acl.json 的 JSON 文件。添加访问控制条目，将每个部门的 S3 前缀映射到其相应的 IAM 身份中心组。在数据源设置的访问控制部分中指示 JSON 文件的位置。

choices.label: C
choices.text: For each IAM Identity Center group, create a separate permissions set that denies access to all prefixes in the S3 bucket. Add a StringNotEquals condition key to the permissions set for each group that specifies the department each group is associated with. Attach the permissions sets to the Identity Center groups.
choices.textZh: 对于每个 IAM Identity Center 组，创建一个单独的权限集，拒绝访问 S3 存储桶中的所有前缀。将 StringNotEquals 条件键添加到每个组的权限集中，指定每个组关联的部门。将权限集附加到 Identity Center 组。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create a metadata file named metadata.json at the top level of the S3 bucket. Add an AccessControlList object to the file that specifies the S3 path of each department's prefix. Specify the IAM Identity Center group that should have access to each department's prefix. Reference the file location in the data source metadata settings.
choices.textZh: 在 S3 存储桶的顶层创建一个名为metadata.json 的元数据文件。将 AccessControlList 对象添加到指定每个部门前缀的 S3 路径的文件中。指定应有权访问每个部门的前缀的 IAM 身份中心组。引用数据源元数据设置中的文件位置。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家软件公司正在使用 Amazon Q Business 构建 AI 助手，允许员工通过自然语言提示访问公司信息和个人信息。该公司将此信息存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。 公司的每个部门在 S3 存储桶中都有一个专用前缀。每个对象名称都包含其所属部门的 S3 前缀。每个部门只能属于 AWS IAM Identity Center 中的一个组。每个员工都属于一个部门。该公司将 Amazon Q Business 配置为访问存储在 S3 存储桶中作为数据源的数据。公司需要确保 AI 助手遵守基于用户 IAM Identity Center 组成员身份的访问控制。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这一要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company is developing an AI-powered search assistant application to help investment advisors quickly retrieve investment data. The application runs as an AWS Lambda function. The company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop the application by using an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base that uses Amazon OpenSearch Serverless as its data source. The application agent must manage collections at scale by automatically assigning access permissions to collections and indexes that match a specific pattern. The company uses Amazon Bedrock tools to test the knowledge base. The knowledge base sync process finishes successfully. However, the test reveals a 400 Bad Authorization error from the BedrockAgentRuntime API and a 403 Forbidden error when the test attempts to access OpenSearch Serverless. The company must resolve the permissions issues. Which combination of solutions will meet this requirement? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Update the Lambda function execution role to include the bedrock:InvokeAgent permission. Add the aoss:APIAccessAll permission to the Lambda execution role.
choices.textZh: 更新 Lambda 函数执行角色以包含 bedrock:InvokeAgent 权限。为 Lambda 执行角色添加 aoss:APIAccessAll 权限。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an OpenSearch Serverless data access policy that includes pattern-based resource rules.
choices.textZh: 创建包含基于模式的资源规则的 OpenSearch Serverless 数据访问策略。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure a VPC endpoint policy for OpenSearch Serverless. Add the endpoint to the Lambda function's VPC configuration.
choices.textZh: 为 OpenSearch Serverless 配置 VPC 终端节点策略。将终端节点添加到 Lambda 函数的 VPC 配置。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure AWS Secrets Manager to store OpenSearch Serverless credentials. Grant the Lambda function access to retrieve the credentials.
choices.textZh: 配置 AWS Secrets Manager 来存储 OpenSearch Serverless 凭证。授予 Lambda 函数访问这些凭证的权限。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Enable IAM authentication for the OpenSearch Serverless domain. Add the es:ESHttp* permission to the Lambda function execution role.
choices.textZh: 为 OpenSearch Serverless domain 启用 IAM 认证。将 es:ESHttp* 权限添加到 Lambda 函数执行角色中。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在开发一款人工智能驱动的搜索助手应用程序，以帮助投资顾问快速检索投资数据。该应用程序作为 AWS Lambda 函数运行。该公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 来开发应用程序，方法是使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库，该知识库使用 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless 作为其数据源。应用程序代理必须通过自动向与特定模式匹配的集合和索引分配访问权限来大规模管理集合。该公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 工具来测试知识库。知识库同步过程成功完成。但是，测试显示 BedrockAgentRuntime API 出现 400 Bad Authorization 错误，并且在测试尝试访问 OpenSearch Serverless 时出现 403 Forbidden 错误。公司必须解决权限问题。哪种解决方案组合可以满足此要求？ （选择两项。）

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A research company is developing a GenAI system to produce summaries of technical documents. The company must catalog all data sources in a central location. The company needs a solution that can automatically discover and update data sources. The solution must tag each generated summary with citations as metadata that users can query. The solution must retain tamper-evident, immutable audit logs for every model invocation and store I/O records. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Comprehend to identify data sources in the documents. Store generated summaries in Amazon S3 and enable S3 Object Lock. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to generate reports about application throughput. Do not include logs for each invocation.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 识别文档中的数据源。将生成的摘要存储在 Amazon S3 中并启用 S3 对象锁定。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标生成有关应用程序吞吐量的报告。不要包含每次调用的日志。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog with crawlers to maintain data sources. Store generated summaries in Amazon S3. Write object tags that include a source ID. Store Amazon Bedrock model invocation logs in Amazon S3. Enable S3 Object Lock on the S3 bucket that stores invocation logs. Use AWS CloudTrail log file integrity validation to provide tamper-evident immutability.
choices.textZh: 将 AWS Glue Data Catalog 与爬网程序结合使用来维护数据源。将生成的摘要存储在 Amazon S3 中。写入包含源 ID 的对象标签。将 Amazon Bedrock 模型调用日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。在存储调用日志的 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 对象锁定。使用 AWS CloudTrail 日志文件完整性验证来提供防篡改的不变性。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Store application outputs in Amazon DynamoDB. Apply item-level tags that include source attribution. Write application events to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use IAM roles to provide audit traceability.
choices.textZh: 将应用程序输出存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。应用包含来源归属的项目级标签。将应用程序事件写入 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。使用 IAM 角色提供审计可追溯性。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use AWS AppConfig feature flags to implement data versioning. Restrict access to the model by using IAM condition keys. Maintain a versioned mapping file of source-to-output relationships in Amazon S3.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS AppConfig 功能标志来实施数据版本控制。使用 IAM 条件键限制对模型的访问。在 Amazon S3 中维护源到输出关系的版本化映射文件。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家研究公司正在开发 GenAI 系统来生成技术文档摘要。公司必须在一个中心位置对所有数据源进行编目。该公司需要一个能够自动发现和更新数据源的解决方案。该解决方案必须使用 引用来标记每个生成的摘要，作为用户可以查询的元数据。该解决方案必须为每个模型调用保留防篡改、不可变的审核日志并存储 I/O 记录。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A company provides a service that helps users from around the world discover new restaurants. The service has 50 million monthly active users. The company wants to implement a semantic search solution across a database that contains 20 million restaurants and 200 million reviews. The company currently stores the data in a PostgreSQL database. The solution must support complex natural language queries and return results for at least 95% of queries within 500 ms. The solution must maintain data freshness for restaurant details that update hourly. The solution must also scale cost-effectively during peak usage periods. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Migrate the restaurant data to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Implement keyword-based search rules that use custom analyzers and relevance tuning to find restaurants based on attributes such as cuisine type, feature, and location. Create Amazon API Gateway HTTP API endpoints to transform user queries into structured search parameters.
choices.textZh: 将餐厅数据迁移到 Amazon OpenSearch Service。实施基于关键字的搜索规则，使用自定义分析器和相关性调整来根据菜系类型、特色和位置等属性查找餐厅。创建 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 终端节点以将用户查询转换为结构化搜索参数。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Migrate the restaurant data to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use a foundation model (FM) in Amazon Bedrock to generate vector embeddings from restaurant descriptions, reviews, and menu items. When users submit natural language queries, convert the queries to embeddings by using the same FM. Perform k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) searches to find semantically similar results.
choices.textZh: 将餐厅数据迁移到 Amazon OpenSearch Service。使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的基础模型 (FM) 根据餐厅描述、评论和菜单项生成矢量嵌入。当用户提交自然语言查询时，使用相同的 FM 将查询转换为嵌入。执行 k 最近邻 (k-NN) 搜索以查找语义相似的结果。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Keep the restaurant data in PostgreSQL and implement a pgvector extension. Use a foundation model (FM) in Amazon Bedrock to generate vector embeddings from restaurant data. Store the vector embeddings directly in PostgreSQL. Create an AWS Lambda function to convert natural language queries to vector representations by using the same FM. Configure the Lambda function to perform similarity searches within the database.
choices.textZh: 将餐厅数据保存在 PostgreSQL 中并实现 pgvector 扩展。使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的基础模型 (FM) 从餐厅数据生成矢量嵌入。将向量嵌入直接存储在 PostgreSQL 中。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，以使用相同的 FM 将自然语言查询转换为矢量表示。配置 Lambda 函数以在数据库中执行相似性搜索。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Migrate the restaurant data to an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base by using a custom ingestion pipeline. Configure the knowledge base to automatically generate embeddings from restaurant information. Use the Amazon Bedrock Retrieve API with built-in vector search capabilities to query the knowledge base directly by using natural language input.
choices.textZh: 使用自定义提取管道将餐厅数据迁移到 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。配置知识库以自动从餐厅信息生成嵌入。使用具有内置矢量搜索功能的 Amazon Bedrock Retrieve API，通过自然语言输入直接查询知识库。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家公司提供一项服务，帮助世界各地的用户发现新餐厅。该服务每月有 5000 万活跃用户。该公司希望在包含 2000 万家餐厅和 2 亿条评论的数据库中实施语义搜索解决方案。该公司目前将数据存储在 PostgreSQL 数据库中。该解决方案必须支持复杂的自然语言查询，并在 500 毫秒内返回至少 95% 的查询结果。该解决方案必须保持每小时更新的餐厅详细信息的数据新鲜度。该解决方案还必须在高峰使用期间经济有效地进行扩展。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop a customer support AI assistant. The AI assistant must respond to customer questions about their accounts. The AI assistant must not expose personal information in responses. The company must comply with data residency policies by ensuring that all processing occurs within the same AWS Region where each customer is located. The company wants to evaluate how effective the AI assistant is at preventing the exposure of personal information before the company makes the AI assistant available to customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure a cross-Region Amazon Bedrock guardrail to apply sensitive information filters. Set the guardrail to detect mode during development and testing. Switch to block mode for production deployment.
choices.textZh: 配置跨区域 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以应用敏感信息过滤器。在开发和测试过程中将护栏设置为检测模式。切换到块模式进行生产部署。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure an Amazon Bedrock guardrail to apply sensitive information filters. Set the guardrail to mask mode during development and testing. Switch to block mode for production deployment. Deploy a copy of the guardrail to each Region where the company operates.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以应用敏感信息过滤器。在开发和测试过程中将护栏设置为屏蔽模式。切换到块模式进行生产部署。将护栏副本部署到公司运营的每个区域。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure an Amazon Bedrock guardrail to apply content and topic filters. Set the guardrail to detect mode during development, testing, and production. Disable invocation logging for the Amazon Bedrock model.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以应用内容和主题过滤器。在开发、测试和生产过程中将护栏设置为检测模式。禁用 Amazon Bedrock 模型的调用日志记录。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure a cross-Region Amazon Bedrock guardrail to apply a set of content and word filters. Set the guardrail to detect mode during development and testing. Switch to mask mode for production deployment.
choices.textZh: 配置跨区域 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以应用一组内容和文字过滤器。在开发和测试过程中将护栏设置为检测模式。切换到掩码模式进行生产部署。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发客户支持 AI 助手。人工智能助手必须回答客户有关其帐户的问题。 AI助手不得在回复中暴露个人信息。公司必须遵守数据驻留策略，确保所有处理都发生在每个客户所在的同一 AWS 区域内。该公司希望在向客户提供人工智能助手之前，评估人工智能助手在防止个人信息泄露方面的有效性。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A financial services company uses an AI application to process financial documents by using Amazon Bedrock. During business hours, the application handles approximately 10,000 requests each hour, which requires consistent throughput. The company uses the CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API to purchase provisioned throughput. Amazon CloudWatch metrics show that the provisioned capacity is unused while on-demand requests are being throttled. The company finds the following code in the application: python response = bedrock_runtime.invoke_model(modelId="anthropic.claude-v2", body=json.dumps(payload)) The company needs the application to use the provisioned throughput and to resolve the throttling issues. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Increase the number of model units (MUs) in the provisioned throughput configuration.
choices.textZh: 增加预配置吞吐量配置中的模型单元 (MU) 数量。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Replace the model ID parameter with the ARN of the provisioned model that the CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API returns.
choices.textZh: 将模型 ID 参数替换为 CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API 返回的预配置模型的 ARN。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Add exponential backoff retry logic to handle throttling exceptions during peak hours.
choices.textZh: 添加指数退避重试逻辑以处理高峰时段的限制异常。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Modify the application to use the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API instead of the InvokeModel API.
choices.textZh: 修改应用程序以使用 InvokeModelWithResponseStream API 而不是 InvokeModel API。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司使用 AI 应用程序通过 Amazon Bedrock 处理财务文档。在工作时间内，应用程序每小时处理大约 10,000 个请求，这需要一致的吞吐量。该公司使用 CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API 来购买预配置吞吐量。 Amazon CloudWatch 指标显示，在按需请求受到限制时，预置容量未使用。该公司在应用程序中发现以下代码： python response = bedrock_runtime.invoke_model(modelId="anthropic.claude-v2", body=json.dumps(payload)) 该公司需要应用程序使用预配置的吞吐量并解决限制问题。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A financial services company is developing a real-time generative AI (GenAI) assistant to support human call center agents. The GenAI assistant must transcribe live customer speech, analyze context, and provide incremental suggestions to call center agents while a customer is still speaking. To preserve responsiveness, the GenAI assistant must maintain end-to-end latency under 1 second from speech to initial response display. The architecture must use only managed AWS services and must support bidirectional streaming to ensure that call center agents receive updates in real time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Transcribe streaming to transcribe calls. Pass the text to Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis. Feed the results to Anthropic Claude on Amazon Bedrock by using the InvokeModel API. Store results in Amazon DynamoDB. Use a WebSocket API to display the results.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 流式传输来转录呼叫。将文本传递给 Amazon Comprehend 进行情感分析。使用 InvokeModel API 将结果提供给 Amazon Bedrock 上的 Anthropic Claude。将结果存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。使用 WebSocket API 显示结果。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Transcribe streaming with partial results enabled to deliver fragments of transcribed text before customers finish speaking. Forward text fragments to Amazon Bedrock by using the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API. Stream responses to call center agents through an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 流式传输并启用部分结果，以便在客户说完之前传送转录文本片段。使用 InvokeModelWithResponseStream API 将文本片段转发到 Amazon Bedrock。通过 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API 将响应流式传输至呼叫中心代理。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Transcribe batch processing to convert calls to text. Pass complete transcripts to Anthropic Claude on Amazon Bedrock by using the ConverseStream API. Return responses through an Amazon Lex chatbot interface.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 批处理将呼叫转换为文本。使用 ConverseStream API 将完整的转录本传递给 Amazon Bedrock 上的 Anthropic Claude。通过 Amazon Lex 聊天机器人界面返回响应。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use the Amazon Transcribe streaming API with an AWS Lambda function to transcribe each audio segment. Call the Amazon Titan Embeddings model on Amazon Bedrock by using the InvokeModel API. Publish results to Amazon SNS.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 流 API 和 AWS Lambda 函数来转录每个音频片段。使用 InvokeModel API 调用 Amazon Bedrock 上的 Amazon Titan Embeddings 模型。将结果发布到 Amazon SNS。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在开发实时生成人工智能 (GenAI) 助手来支持人类呼叫中心代理。 GenAI 助手必须转录实时客户语音、分析上下文，并在客户仍在讲话时向呼叫中心代理提供增量建议。为了保持响应能力，GenAI 助手必须将从语音到初始响应显示的端到端延迟保持在 1 秒以内。该架构必须仅使用托管 AWS 服务，并且必须支持双向流，以确保呼叫中心代理实时接收更新。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is building a multicloud generative AI (GenAI)-powered secret resolution application that uses Amazon Bedrock and Agent Squad. The application resolves secrets from multiple sources, including key stores and hardware security modules (HSMs). The application uses AWS Lambda functions to retrieve secrets from the sources. The application uses AWS AppConfig to implement dynamic feature gating. The application supports secret chaining and detects secret drift. The application handles short-lived and expiring secrets. The application also supports prompt flows for templated instructions. The application uses AWS Step Functions to orchestrate agents to resolve the secrets and to manage secret validation and drift detection. The company finds multiple issues during application testing. The application does not refresh expired secrets in time for agents to use. The application sends alerts for secret drift, but agents still use stale data.
