Prompt flows within the application reuse outdated templates, which cause cascading failures. The company must resolve the performance issues. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Step Functions Map states to run agent workflows in parallel. Pass updated secret metadata through Lambda function outputs. Use AWS AppConfig to version all prompt flows to gate and roll back faulty templates.
choices.textZh: 使用 Step Functions Map 状态并行运行代理工作流。通过 Lambda 函数输出传递更新的秘密元数据。使用 AWS AppConfig 对所有提示流进行版本控制，以控制和回滚错误模板。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Agents only. Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to restrict prompt variation. Use an inline JSON schema for a single agent’s workflow definition to chain tool calls.
choices.textZh: 仅使用 Amazon Bedrock 代理。配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以限制即时变化。使用单个代理的工作流定义的内联 JSON 模式来链接工具调用。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use a centralized Amazon EventBridge pipeline to invoke each agent. Store intermediate prompts in Amazon DynamoDB. Resolve agent ordering by using TTL-based backoff and retries.
choices.textZh: 使用集中式 Amazon EventBridge 管道来调用每个代理。将中间提示存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。通过使用基于 TTL 的退避和重试来解决代理排序问题。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon EventBridge Pipes to invoke resolvers based on Amazon CloudWatch log patterns. Store response metadata in DynamoDB with TTL and versioned writes. Use Amazon Q Developer to dynamically generate fallback prompts.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon EventBridge Pipes 根据 Amazon CloudWatch 日志模式调用解析器。使用 TTL 和版本化写入将响应元数据存储在 DynamoDB 中。使用 Amazon Q Developer 动态生成后备提示。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在构建一个由多云生成 AI (GenAI) 支持的秘密解析应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Agent Squad。该应用程序解析来自多个来源的机密，包括密钥存储和硬件安全模块 (HSM)。该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数从源检索机密。该应用程序使用 AWS AppConfig 来实现动态功能门控。该应用程序支持秘密链接并检测秘密漂移。该应用程序处理短期和过期的秘密。该应用程序还支持模板化指令的提示流程。该应用程序使用 AWS Step Functions 协调代理来解析密钥并管理密钥验证和偏差检测。该公司在应用程序测试过程中发现了多个问题。应用程序没有及时刷新过期的机密以供代理使用。该应用程序发送秘密漂移警报，但代理仍然使用过时的数据。应用程序内的提示流重复使用过时的模板，这会导致级联故障。公司必须解决绩效问题。哪种解决方案可以满足这个要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A company is building an AI advisory application by using Amazon Bedrock. The application will provide recommendations to customers. The company needs the application to explain its reasoning process and cite specific sources for data. The application must retrieve information from company data sources and show step- by-step reasoning for recommendations. The application must also link data claims to source documents and maintain response latency under 3 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with source attribution enabled. Use the Anthropic Claude Messages API with RAG to set high-relevance thresholds for source documents. Store reasoning and citations in Amazon S3 for auditing purposes.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库并启用来源归因。将 Anthropic Claude Messages API 与 RAG 结合使用，为源文档设置高相关性阈值。将推理和引文存储在 Amazon S3 中以供审核之用。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude models and extended thinking. Configure a 4,000-token thinking budget. Store reasoning traces and citations in Amazon DynamoDB for auditing purposes.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock 与 Anthropic Claude 模型和扩展思维结合使用。配置 4,000 代币的思考预算。将推理跟踪和引文存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中以用于审计目的。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure Amazon SageMaker AI with a custom Anthropic Claude model. Use the model’s reasoning parameter and AWS Lambda to process responses. Add source citations from a separate Amazon RDS database.
choices.textZh: 使用自定义 Anthropic Claude 模型配置 Amazon SageMaker AI。使用模型的推理参数和 AWS Lambda 处理响应。添加来自单独 Amazon RDS 数据库的来源引用。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude models and chain-of-thought reasoning. Configure custom retrieval tracking with the Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases API. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor response latency metrics.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock 与 Anthropic Claude 模型和思维链推理结合使用。使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库 API 配置自定义检索跟踪。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控响应延迟指标。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建 AI 咨询应用程序。该应用程序将为客户提供建议。该公司需要应用程序来解释其推理过程并引用具体的数据来源。应用程序必须从公司数据源检索信息并显示推荐的逐步推理。应用程序还必须将数据声明链接到源文档，并将响应延迟保持在 3 秒以内。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A healthcare company is using Amazon Bedrock to build a system to help practitioners make clinical decisions. The system must provide treatment recommendations to physicians based only on approved medical documentation and must cite specific sources. The system must not hallucinate or produce factually incorrect information. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Integrate Amazon Bedrock with Amazon Kendra to retrieve approved documents. Implement custom post-processing to compare generated responses against source documents and to include citations.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock 与 Amazon Kendra 集成以检索批准的文档。实施自定义后处理，将生成的响应与源文档进行比较并包含引用。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base and connect it to approved clinical source documents. Use the Amazon Bedrock RetrieveAndGenerate API to return citations from the knowledge base.
choices.textZh: 部署 Amazon Bedrock 知识库并将其连接到批准的临床源文档。使用 Amazon Bedrock RetrieveAndGenerate API 从知识库返回引文。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Comprehend Medical to extract medical entities. Implement verification logic against a medical terminology database.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Amazon Comprehend Medical 提取医疗实体。针对医学术语数据库实施验证逻辑。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base with Retrieve API calls and InvokeModel API calls to retrieve approved clinical source documents. Implement verification logic to compare against retrieved sources and to cite sources.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库以及 Retrieve API 调用和 InvokeModel API 调用来检索批准的临床源文档。实施验证逻辑以与检索到的来源进行比较并引用来源。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建一个系统来帮助从业人员做出临床决策。该系统必须仅根据批准的医疗文件向医生提供治疗建议，并且必须引用特定来源。系统不得产生幻觉或产生事实上不正确的信息。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A hotel company wants to enhance a legacy Java-based property management system (PMS) by adding AI capabilities. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to provide staff with room availability information and hotel-specific details. The solution must maintain separate access controls for each hotel that the company manages. The solution must provide room availability information in near real time and must maintain consistent performance during peak usage periods. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy a single Amazon Bedrock knowledge base that contains combined data for all hotels. Configure AWS Lambda functions to synchronize data from each hotel’s PMS database through direct API connections. Implement AWS CloudTrail logging with hotel-specific filters to audit access logs for each hotel’s data.
choices.textZh: 部署一个包含所有酒店组合数据的 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。配置 AWS Lambda 函数以通过直接 API 连接同步每个酒店的 PMS 数据库的数据。使用特定于酒店的过滤器实施 AWS CloudTrail 日志记录，以审核每个酒店数据的访问日志。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for each hotel that is invoked by changes to the PMS database. Configure the rule to send updates to a centralized Amazon Bedrock knowledge base in a management AWS account. Configure resource-based policies to enforce hotel-specific access controls.
choices.textZh: 为 PMS 数据库更改所调用的每家酒店创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置规则以将更新发送到管理 AWS 账户中的集中式 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。配置基于资源的策略以实施特定于酒店的访问控制。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Implement one Amazon Bedrock knowledge base for each hotel in a multi-account structure. Use direct data ingestion to provide near real-time room availability information. Schedule regular synchronization for less critical information.
choices.textZh: 为多账户结构中的每家酒店实施一个 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。使用直接数据摄取来提供近乎实时的房间可用性信息。安排定期同步不太重要的信息。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Build a centralized Amazon Bedrock Agents solution that uses multiple knowledge bases. Implement AWS IAM Identity Center with hotel-specific permission sets to control staff access.
choices.textZh: 构建使用多个知识库的集中式 Amazon Bedrock Agents 解决方案。使用特定于酒店的权限集实施 AWS IAM Identity Center 以控制员工访问。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家酒店公司希望通过添加 AI 功能来增强基于 Java 的传统物业管理系统 (PMS)。该公司希望使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库为员工提供客房可用性信息和酒店特定详细信息。该解决方案必须为公司管理的每家酒店维护单独的访问控制。该解决方案必须近乎实时地提供房间可用性信息，并且必须在高峰使用期间保持一致的性能。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: An elevator service company has developed an AI assistant application by using Amazon Bedrock. The application generates elevator maintenance recommendations to support the company’s elevator technicians. The company uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect the elevator sensor data. New regulatory rules require that a human technician must review all AI-generated recommendations. The company needs to establish human oversight workflows to review and approve AI recommendations. The company must store all human technician review decisions for audit purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a custom approval workflow by using AWS Lambda functions and Amazon SQS queues for human review of AI recommendations. Store all review decisions in Amazon DynamoDB for audit purposes.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon SQS 队列创建自定义审批工作流程，以对 AI 建议进行人工审核。将所有审核决策存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中以供审计之用。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow that has a human approval step that uses the waitForTaskToken API to pause execution. After a human technician completes a review, use an AWS Lambda function to call the SendTaskSuccess API with the approval decision. Store all review decisions in Amazon DynamoDB.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 AWS Step Functions 工作流程，其中包含人工审批步骤，该步骤使用 waitForTaskToken API 来暂停执行。技术人员完成审核后，使用 AWS Lambda 函数调用 SendTaskSuccess API 并做出批准决定。将所有审核决策存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an AWS Glue workflow that has a human approval step. After the human technician review, integrate the application with an AWS Lambda function that calls the SendTaskSuccess API. Store all human technician review decisions in Amazon DynamoDB.
choices.textZh: 创建具有人工批准步骤的 AWS Glue 工作流程。经过技术人员审核后，将应用程序与调用 SendTaskSuccess API 的 AWS Lambda 函数集成。将所有技术人员审核决策存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure Amazon EventBridge rules with custom event patterns to route AI recommendations to human technicians for review. Create AWS Glue jobs to process human technician approval queues. Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache all human technician review decisions.
choices.textZh: 使用自定义事件模式配置 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以将 AI 建议发送给技术人员进行审核。创建 AWS Glue 作业来处理技术人员审批队列。使用 Amazon ElastiCache 缓存所有技术人员审核决策。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家电梯服务公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发了一款 AI 助手应用程序。该应用程序生成电梯维护建议来支持公司的电梯技术人员。该公司使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 收集电梯传感器数据。 新的监管规则要求技术人员必须审查所有人工智能生成的建议。公司需要建立人工监督工作流程来审查和批准人工智能建议。公司必须存储所有技术人员审查决定以供审计之用。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A company is using Amazon Bedrock to design an application to help researchers apply for grants. The application is based on an Amazon Nova Pro foundation model (FM). The application contains four required inputs and must provide responses in a consistent text format. The company wants to receive a notification in Amazon Bedrock if a response contains bullying language. However, the company does not want to block all flagged responses. The company creates an Amazon Bedrock flow that takes an input prompt and sends it to the Amazon Nova Pro FM. The Amazon Nova Pro FM provides a response. Which additional steps must the company take to meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to specify the required inputs as variables. Select an Amazon Nova Pro FM. Specify the output format for the response. Add the prompt to the prompts node of the flow.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 将所需输入指定为变量。选择 Amazon Nova Pro FM。指定响应的输出格式。将提示添加到流程的提示节点。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock guardrail that applies the hate content filter. Set the filter response to block. Add the guardrail to the prompts node of the flow.
choices.textZh: 创建应用仇恨内容过滤器的 Amazon Bedrock 护栏。将过滤器响应设置为阻止。将护栏添加到流程的提示节点。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock prompt router. Specify an Amazon Nova Pro FM. Add the required inputs as variables to the input node of the flow. Add the prompt router to the prompts node. Add the output format to the output node.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon Bedrock 提示路由器。指定 Amazon Nova Pro FM。将所需的输入作为变量添加到流的输入节点。将提示路由器添加到提示节点。将输出格式添加到输出节点。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock guardrail that applies the insults content filter. Set the filter response to detect. Add the guardrail to the prompts node of the flow.
choices.textZh: 创建一个应用了 insults 内容过滤器的 Amazon Bedrock guardrail。将过滤器响应设置为 detect。将该 guardrail 添加到流程的 prompts 节点。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock application inference profile that specifies an Amazon Nova Pro FM. Specify the output format for the response in the description. Include a tag for each of the input variables. Add the profile to the prompts node of the flow.
choices.textZh: 创建一个指定 Amazon Nova Pro FM 的 Amazon Bedrock application inference profile。在描述中指定响应的输出格式。为每个输入变量包含一个标签。将该 profile 添加到流程的 prompts 节点。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 设计一个应用程序来帮助研究人员申请资助。该应用程序基于 Amazon Nova Pro 基础模型 (FM)。该应用程序包含四个必需的输入，并且必须以一致的文本格式提供响应。如果回复包含欺凌性语言，该公司希望在 Amazon Bedrock 中收到通知。然而，该公司不想阻止所有标记的回复。该公司创建了一个 Amazon Bedrock 流程，该流程接受输入提示并将其发送到 Amazon Nova Pro FM。 Amazon Nova Pro FM 提供了响应。公司必须采取哪些额外步骤来满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

prompt: A company is developing a customer communication platform that uses an AI assistant powered by an Amazon Bedrock foundation model (FM). The AI assistant summarizes customer messages and generates initial response drafts. The company wants to use Amazon Comprehend to implement layered content filtering. The layered content filtering must prevent sharing of offensive content, protect customer privacy, and detect potential inappropriate advice solicitation. Inappropriate advice solicitation includes requests for unethical practices, harmful activities, or manipulative behaviors. The solution must maintain acceptable overall response times, so all pre-processing filters must finish before the content reaches the FM. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use parallel processing with asynchronous API calls. Use toxicity detection for offensive content. Use prompt safety classification for inappropriate advice solicitation. Use personally identifiable information (PII) detection without redaction.
choices.textZh: 通过异步 API 调用使用并行处理。对令人反感的内容使用毒性检测。使用及时的安全分类来征求不适当的建议。使用个人身份信息 (PII) 检测而不进行编辑。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use custom classification to build an FM that detects offensive content and inappropriate advice solicitation. Apply personally identifiable information (PII) detection as a secondary filter only when messages pass the custom classifier.
choices.textZh: 使用自定义分类构建可检测攻击性内容和不当建议征求的 FM。仅当邮件通过自定义分类器时，才应用个人身份信息 (PII) 检测作为辅助过滤器。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy a multi-stage process. Configure the process to use prompt safety classification first, then toxicity detection on safe prompts only, and finally personally identifiable information (PII) detection in streaming mode. Route flagged messages through Amazon EventBridge for human review.
choices.textZh: 部署多阶段流程。将流程配置为首先使用提示安全分类，然后仅在安全提示上进行毒性检测，最后在流模式下进行个人身份信息 (PII) 检测。通过 Amazon EventBridge 路由标记的消息以供人工审核。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use toxicity detection with thresholds configured to 0.5 for all categories. Use parallel processing for both prompt safety classification and personally identifiable information (PII) detection with entity redaction. Apply Amazon CloudWatch alarms to filter metrics.
choices.textZh: 对所有类别使用阈值配置为 0.5 的毒性检测。使用并行处理进行即时安全分类和个人身份信息 (PII) 检测以及实体编辑。应用 Amazon CloudWatch 警报来筛选指标。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司正在开发一个客户沟通平台，该平台使用由 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 提供支持的 AI 助手。人工智能助手总结客户消息并生成初步回复草稿。该公司希望使用 Amazon Comprehend 实施分层内容过滤。分层内容过滤必须防止共享攻击性内容、保护客户隐私并检测潜在的不当建议征求。不适当的建议征求包括要求不道德的做法、有害的活动或操纵行为。该解决方案必须保持可接受的总体响应时间，因此所有预处理过滤器必须在内容到达 FM 之前完成。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A medical company is creating a generative AI (GenAI) system by using Amazon Bedrock. The system processes data from various sources and must maintain end-to-end data lineage. The system must also use real- time personally identifiable information (PII) filtering and audit trails to automatically report compliance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to register all data sources and track lineage. Use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails PII filters. Enable AWS CloudTrail logging for all Amazon Bedrock API calls with Amazon S3 integration. Use Amazon Macie to scan stored data for sensitive information and publish findings to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the findings and generate automated compliance reports.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Glue 数据目录注册所有数据源并跟踪沿袭。使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails PII 过滤器。通过 Amazon S3 集成为所有 Amazon Bedrock API 调用启用 AWS CloudTrail 日志记录。使用 Amazon Macie 扫描存储的数据中的敏感信息并将结果发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。创建 CloudWatch 仪表板以可视化结果并生成自动合规性报告。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use AWS Config to track data source configurations and changes. Use AWS WAF with custom rules to filter PII at the application layer before Amazon Bedrock processes the data. Configure Amazon EventBridge to capture and route audit events to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical with scheduled AWS Lambda functions to analyze stored outputs for compliance violations.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Config 跟踪数据源配置和更改。在 Amazon Bedrock 处理数据之前，使用具有自定义规则的 AWS WAF 在应用程序层过滤 PII。配置 Amazon EventBridge 以捕获审核事件并将其路由到 Amazon S3。将 Amazon Comprehend Medical 与计划的 AWS Lambda 函数结合使用来分析存储的输出是否存在合规性违规行为。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use AWS DataSync to replicate data sources to track lineage. Configure Amazon Macie to scan Amazon Bedrock outputs for sensitive information. Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to log user interactions. Deploy Amazon Textract with AWS Step Functions workflows to identify and redact PII from generated reports.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS DataSync 复制数据源以跟踪沿袭。配置 Amazon Macie 以扫描 Amazon Bedrock 输出以获取敏感信息。使用 AWS Systems Manager 会话管理器记录用户交互。使用 AWS Step Functions 工作流程部署 Amazon Textract，以从生成的报告中识别和编辑 PII。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure Amazon Athena to query data sources to analyze and report on data lineage. Use Amazon CloudWatch custom metrics to monitor PII exposure in Amazon Bedrock responses and establish AWS X-Ray tracing to generate an audit trail. Use an Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels model to detect sensitive information in the data that Amazon Bedrock processes.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Athena 以查询数据源以分析和报告数据沿袭。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 自定义指标监控 Amazon Bedrock 响应中的 PII 暴露情况并建立 AWS X-Ray 跟踪以生成审核跟踪。使用 Amazon Rekognition 自定义标签模型检测 Amazon Bedrock 处理的数据中的敏感信息。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家医疗公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 创建生成式 AI (GenAI) 系统。系统处理来自各种来源的数据，并且必须维护端到端的数据沿袭。该系统还必须使用实时个人身份信息（PII）过滤和审计跟踪来自动报告合规性。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A GenAI developer is evaluating Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs) to enhance a Europe-based company's internal business application. The company has a multi-account landing zone in AWS Control Tower. The company uses Service Control Policies (SCPs) to allow its accounts to use only the eu-north-1 and eu-west-1 Regions. All customer data must remain in private networks within the approved AWS Regions. The GenAI developer selects an FM based on analysis and testing and hosts the model in the eu-central-1 Region and the eu-west-3 Region. The GenAI developer must enable access to the FM for the company's employees. The GenAI developer must ensure that requests to the FM are private and remain within the same Regions as the FM. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy an AWS Lambda function that is exposed by a private Amazon API Gateway REST API to a VPC in eu-north-1. Create a VPC endpoint for the selected FM in eu-central-1 and eu-west-3. Extend existing SCPs to allow employees to use the FM. Integrate the REST API with the business application.
choices.textZh: 部署由私有 Amazon API Gateway REST API 向 eu-north-1 中的 VPC 公开的 AWS Lambda 函数。在 eu-central-1 和 eu-west-3 中为选定的 FM 创建 VPC 终端节点。扩展现有 SCP 以允许员工使用 FM。将 REST API 与业务应用程序集成。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy the FM on Amazon EC2 instances in eu-north-1. Deploy a private Amazon API Gateway REST API in front of the EC2 instances. Configure an Amazon Bedrock VPC endpoint. Integrate the REST API with the business application.
choices.textZh: 在 eu-north-1 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上部署 FM。在 EC2 实例前面部署私有 Amazon API Gateway REST API。配置 Amazon Bedrock VPC 终端节点。将 REST API 与业务应用程序集成。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure the FM to use cross-Region inference through a Europe-scoped endpoint. Configure an Amazon Bedrock VPC endpoint. Extend existing SCPs to allow employees to use the FM through inference profiles in Europe-based Regions where the FM is available. Use an inference profile to integrate Amazon Bedrock with the business application.
choices.textZh: 将 FM 配置为通过欧洲范围的端点使用跨区域推理。配置 Amazon Bedrock VPC 终端节点。扩展现有 SCP，以允许员工在可使用 FM 的欧洲区域通过推理配置文件使用 FM。使用推理配置文件将 Amazon Bedrock 与业务应用程序集成。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy the FM in Amazon SageMaker in eu-north-1. Configure a SageMaker VPC endpoint. Extend existing SCPs to allow employees to use the SageMaker endpoint. Integrate the FM in SageMaker with the business application.
choices.textZh: 在 eu-north-1 的 Amazon SageMaker 中部署 FM。配置 SageMaker VPC 终端节点。扩展现有 SCP 以允许员工使用 SageMaker 端点。将 SageMaker 中的 FM 与业务应用程序集成。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一位 GenAI 开发人员正在评估 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM)，以增强一家欧洲公司的内部业务应用程序。该公司在 AWS Control Tower 中拥有多账户登陆区。该公司使用服务控制策略 (SCP) 允许其账户仅使用 eu-north-1 和 eu-west-1 区域。所有客户数据必须保留在批准的 AWS 区域内的专用网络中。 GenAI 开发人员根据分析和测试选择 FM，并将模型托管在 eu-central-1 区域和 eu-west-3 区域。 GenAI 开发人员必须允许公司员工访问 FM。 GenAI 开发人员必须确保向 FM 发出的请求是私密的，并且与 FM 位于同一区域内。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A media company is launching a platform that allows thousands of users every hour to upload images and text content. The platform uses Amazon Bedrock to process the uploaded content to generate creative compositions. The company needs a solution to ensure that the platform does not process or produce inappropriate content. The platform must not expose personally identifiable information (PII) in the compositions. The solution must integrate with the company's existing Amazon S3 storage workflow. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST infrastructure management overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enable the Enhanced Monitoring tool. Use an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to filter traffic to the platform. Use Amazon Comprehend PII detection to pre-process the data. Create a CloudWatch alarm to monitor for Amazon Comprehend PII detection events. Create an AWS Step Functions workflow that includes an Amazon Rekognition image moderation step.
choices.textZh: 启用增强监控工具。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 警报来过滤流向平台的流量。使用 Amazon Comprehend PII 检测来预处理数据。创建 CloudWatch 警报以监控 Amazon Comprehend PII 检测事件。创建包含 Amazon Rekognition 图像审核步骤的 AWS Step Functions 工作流程。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with request validation templates to screen content before storing the uploaded content in Amazon S3. Use Amazon SageMaker AI to build custom content moderation models that process content before sending the processed content to Amazon Bedrock.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 和请求验证模板来筛选内容，然后再将上传的内容存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 构建自定义内容审核模型，在将处理后的内容发送到 Amazon Bedrock 之前处理内容。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool that uses pre-authentication AWS Lambda functions to run content moderation checks. Use Amazon Textract to filter text content and Amazon Rekognition to filter image content before allowing users to upload content to the platform.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 Amazon Cognito 用户池，该池使用预身份验证 AWS Lambda 函数来运行内容审核检查。在允许用户将内容上传到平台之前，使用 Amazon Textract 过滤文本内容，使用 Amazon Rekognition 过滤图像内容。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow that uses built-in Amazon Bedrock guardrails to filter content. Use Amazon Comprehend PII detection to pre-process the content. Use Amazon Rekognition image moderation.
choices.textZh: 创建一个使用内置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏来过滤内容的 AWS Step Functions 工作流程。使用 Amazon Comprehend PII 检测来预处理内容。使用 Amazon Rekognition 图像审核。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家媒体公司正在推出一个平台，每小时允许数千名用户上传图像和文本内容。该平台使用 Amazon Bedrock 处理上传的内容以生成创意作品。该公司需要一个解决方案来确保平台不会处理或产生不当内容。平台不得公开作品中的个人身份信息 (PII)。该解决方案必须与公司现有的 Amazon S3 存储工作流程集成。 哪种解决方案能够以最少的基础设施管理开销满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A book publishing company wants to build a book recommendation system that uses an AI assistant. The AI assistant will use ML to generate a list of recommended books from the company's book catalog. The system must suggest books based on conversations with customers. The company stores the text of the books, customers' and editors' reviews of the books, and extracted book metadata in Amazon S3. The system must support low-latency responses and scale efficiently to handle more than 10,000 concurrent users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to generate embeddings. Store the embeddings as a vector store in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Create an AWS Lambda function that queries the knowledge base. Configure Amazon API Gateway to invoke the Lambda function when handling user requests.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库生成嵌入。将嵌入作为向量存储存储在 Amazon OpenSearch Service 中。创建查询知识库的 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Amazon API Gateway 以在处理用户请求时调用 Lambda 函数。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to generate embeddings. Store the embeddings as a vector store in Amazon DynamoDB. Create an AWS Lambda function that queries the knowledge base. Configure Amazon API Gateway to invoke the Lambda function when handling user requests.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库生成嵌入。将嵌入作为向量存储存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。创建查询知识库的 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Amazon API Gateway 以在处理用户请求时调用 Lambda 函数。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker AI to deploy a pre-trained model to build a personalized recommendation engine for books. Deploy the model as a SageMaker AI endpoint. Invoke the model endpoint by using Amazon API Gateway.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 部署预训练模型来构建个性化图书推荐引擎。将模型部署为 SageMaker AI 端点。使用 Amazon API Gateway 调用模型终端节点。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an Amazon Kendra GenAI Enterprise Edition index that uses the S3 connector to index the book catalog data stored in Amazon S3. Configure built-in FAQ in the Kendra index. Develop an AWS Lambda function that queries the Kendra index based on user conversations. Deploy Amazon API Gateway to expose this functionality and invoke the Lambda function.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon Kendra GenAI Enterprise Edition 索引，该索引使用 S3 连接器对 Amazon S3 中存储的图书目录数据建立索引。在 Kendra 索引中配置内置常见问题解答。开发一个 AWS Lambda 函数，根据用户对话查询 Kendra 索引。部署 Amazon API Gateway 以公开此功能并调用 Lambda 函数。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家图书出版公司想要构建一个使用 AI 助手的图书推荐系统。人工智能助手将使用机器学习从公司的图书目录中生成推荐书籍列表。系统必须根据与客户的对话来推荐书籍。该公司在 Amazon S3 中存储书籍文本、客户和编辑对书籍的评论以及提取的书籍元数据。系统必须支持低延迟响应并有效扩展以处理超过 10,000 个并发用户。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A financial services company is developing a customer service AI assistant by using Amazon Bedrock. The AI assistant must not discuss investment advice with users. The AI assistant must block harmful content, mask personally identifiable information (PII), and maintain audit trails for compliance reporting. The AI assistant must apply content filtering to both user inputs and model responses based on content sensitivity. The company requires an Amazon Bedrock guardrail configuration that will effectively enforce policies with minimal false positives. The solution must provide multiple handling strategies for multiple types of sensitive content. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure a single guardrail and set content filters to high for all categories. Set up denied topics for investment advice and include sample phrases to block. Set up sensitive information filters that apply the block action for all PII entities. Apply the guardrail to all model inference calls.
choices.textZh: 配置单个护栏并将所有类别的内容过滤器设置为高。设置投资建议的拒绝主题，并包含要阻止的示例短语。设置敏感信息过滤器，对所有 PII 实体应用阻止操作。将护栏应用于所有模型推理调用。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure multiple guardrails by using tiered policies. Create one guardrail and set content filters to high. Configure the guardrail to block PII for public interactions. Configure a second guardrail and set content filters to medium. Configure the second guardrail to mask PII for internal use. Configure multiple topic-specific guardrails to block investment advice and set up contextual grounding checks.
choices.textZh: 使用分层策略配置多个护栏。创建一根护栏并将内容过滤器设置为高。配置护栏以阻止 PII 进行公共交互。配置第二个护栏并将内容过滤器设置为中。配置第二个护栏以屏蔽 PII 以供内部使用。配置多个特定主题的护栏来阻止投资建议并设置上下文接地检查。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure a guardrail and set content filters to medium for harmful content. Set up denied topics for investment advice and include clear definitions and sample phrases to block. Configure sensitive information filters to mask PII in responses and to block financial information in inputs. Enable both input and output evaluations that use custom blocked messages for audits.
choices.textZh: 配置护栏并将有害内容的内容过滤器设置为中。设置拒绝的投资建议主题，并包含要阻止的明确定义和示例短语。配置敏感信息过滤器以屏蔽响应中的 PII 并阻止输入中的财务信息。启用使用自定义阻止消息进行审核的输入和输出评估。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create a separate guardrail for each use case. Create one guardrail that applies a harmful content filter. Create a guardrail to apply topic filters for investment advice. Create a guardrail to apply sensitive information filters to block PII. Use AWS Step Functions to chain the guardrails sequentially.
choices.textZh: 为每个用例创建单独的护栏。创建一个应用有害内容过滤器的护栏。创建护栏以应用主题过滤器来获取投资建议。创建护栏以应用敏感信息过滤器来阻止 PII。使用 AWS Step Functions 按顺序链接护栏。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发客户服务 AI 助手。 AI助手不得与用户讨论投资建议。人工智能助手必须阻止有害内容、掩盖个人身份信息 (PII)，并维护合规报告的审计跟踪。人工智能助手必须根据内容敏感性对用户输入和模型响应应用内容过滤。该公司需要 Amazon Bedrock 护栏配置，以有效执行策略并最大限度地减少误报。解决方案必须针对多种类型的敏感内容提供多种处理策略。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company is developing a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application to help investment analysts query complex financial relationships across multiple investment vehicles, market sectors, and regulatory environments. The dataset contains highly interconnected entities that have multi-hop relationships. Analysts must examine relationships holistically to provide accurate investment guidance. The application must deliver comprehensive answers that capture indirect relationships between financial entities and must respond in less than 3 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with GraphRAG and Amazon Neptune Analytics to store financial data. Analyze multi-hop relationships between entities and automatically identify related information across documents.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock 知识库与 GraphRAG 和 Amazon Neptune Analytics 结合使用来存储财务数据。分析实体之间的多跳关系并自动识别跨文档的相关信息。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and an Amazon OpenSearch Service vector store to implement custom relationship identification logic that uses AWS Lambda to query multiple vector embeddings in sequence.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库和 Amazon OpenSearch Service 矢量存储来实现自定义关系识别逻辑，该逻辑使用 AWS Lambda 按顺序查询多个矢量嵌入。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Serverless vector search with k-nearest neighbor (k-NN). Implement manual relationship mapping in an application layer that runs on Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling.
choices.textZh: 使用带有 k 最近邻 (k-NN) 的 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless 矢量搜索。在 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 上运行的应用程序层中实施手动关系映射。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon DynamoDB to store financial data in a custom indexing system. Use AWS Lambda to query relevant records. Use Amazon SageMaker to generate responses.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 将财务数据存储在自定义索引系统中。使用AWS Lambda查询相关记录。使用 Amazon SageMaker 生成响应。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在开发检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用程序，以帮助投资分析师查询跨多种投资工具、市场部门和监管环境的复杂财务关系。该数据集包含具有多跳关系的高度互连的实体。分析师必须全面审视关系，以提供准确的投资指导。应用程序必须提供全面的答案，捕获金融实体之间的间接关系，并且必须在 3 秒内做出响应。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

prompt: A company uses Amazon Bedrock to generate technical content for customers. The company has recently experienced a surge in hallucinated outputs when the company’s model generates summaries of long technical documents. The model outputs include inaccurate or fabricated details. The company’s current solution uses a large foundation model (FM) with a basic one-shot prompt that includes the full document in a single input. The company needs a solution that will reduce hallucinations and meet factual accuracy goals. The solution must process more than 1,000 documents each hour and deliver summaries within 3 seconds for each document. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Implement zero-shot chain-of-thought (CoT) instructions that require step-by-step reasoning with explicit fact verification before the model generates each summary.
choices.textZh: 实现零样本思想链 (CoT) 指令，这些指令需要在模型生成每个摘要之前进行逐步推理并进行明确的事实验证。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. Apply semantic chunking and tuned embeddings to ground summaries in source content.
choices.textZh: 将检索增强生成 (RAG) 与 Amazon Bedrock 知识库结合使用。将语义分块和调整的嵌入应用于源内容中的基本摘要。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to block any generated output that matches patterns that are associated with hallucinated content.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 护栏以阻止任何与幻觉内容关联的模式匹配的生成输出。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Increase the temperature parameter in Amazon Bedrock.
choices.textZh: 增加 Amazon Bedrock 中的 temperature 参数。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Prompt the Amazon Bedrock model to summarize each full document in one pass.
choices.textZh: 提示 Amazon Bedrock 模型一次性总结每个完整文档。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 为客户生成技术内容。当该公司的模型生成长技术文档的摘要时，该公司最近经历了幻觉输出的激增。模型输出包含不准确或捏造的细节。该公司当前的解决方案使用大型基础模型 (FM) 和基本的一次性提示，在一次输入中包含完整文档。该公司需要一种能够减少幻觉并满足事实准确性目标的解决方案。该解决方案必须每小时处理超过 1,000 个文档，并在 3 秒内为每个文档提供摘要。哪种解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company is developing a customer service AI assistant application that uses a foundation model (FM) in Amazon Bedrock. The application must provide transparent responses by documenting reasoning and by citing sources that are used for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). The application must capture comprehensive audit trails for all responses to users. The application must be able to serve up to 10,000 concurrent users and must respond to each customer inquiry within 2 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enable tracing for Amazon Bedrock Agents. Configure structured prompts that direct the FM to provide evidence presentations. Integrate Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with data sources to enable RAG. Configure the application to reference and cite authoritative content. Deploy the application in a Multi- AZ architecture. Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions to scale the application. Use Amazon CloudFront to provide low-latency delivery.
choices.textZh: 启用 Amazon Bedrock 代理的跟踪。配置结构化提示，指导 FM 提供证据演示。将 Amazon Bedrock 知识库与数据源集成以启用 RAG。配置应用程序以引用和引用权威内容。在多可用区架构中部署应用程序。使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 函数扩展应用程序。使用 Amazon CloudFront 提供低延迟交付。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Enable tracing for Amazon Bedrock agents. Integrate a custom RAG pipeline with Amazon OpenSearch Service to retrieve and cite sources. Configure structured prompts to present retrieved evidence. Deploy the application behind an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Use AWS Lambda functions and Amazon CloudFront to scale the application and to provide low latency. Store logs in Amazon S3 and use AWS CloudTrail to capture audit trails.
choices.textZh: 启用 Amazon Bedrock 代理的跟踪。将自定义 RAG 管道与 Amazon OpenSearch Service 集成以检索和引用源。配置结构化提示来呈现检索到的证据。在 Amazon API Gateway REST API 后面部署应用程序。使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon CloudFront 扩展应用程序并提供低延迟。将日志存储在 Amazon S3 中并使用 AWS CloudTrail 捕获审计跟踪。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor latency and error rates. Embed model prompts directly in the application backend to cite sources. Store application interactions with users in Amazon RDS for audits.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控延迟和错误率。直接在应用程序后端嵌入模型提示以引用来源。将应用程序与用户的交互存储在 Amazon RDS 中以供审核。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Store generated responses and supporting evidence in an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable versioning on the bucket for audits. Use AWS Glue to catalog retrieved documents. Process the retrieved documents in Amazon Athena to generate periodic compliance reports.
choices.textZh: 将生成的响应和支持证据存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。在存储桶上启用版本控制以进行审核。使用 AWS Glue 对检索到的文档进行编目。在 Amazon Athena 中处理检索到的文档以生成定期合规性报告。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在开发一款客户服务 AI 助理应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的基础模型 (FM)。应用程序必须通过记录推理并引用用于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的来源来提供透明的响应。应用程序必须捕获对用户的所有响应的全面审计跟踪。该应用程序必须能够为多达 10,000 个并发用户提供服务，并且必须在 2 秒内响应每个客户的询问。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is designing an API for a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses a foundation model (FM) that is hosted on a managed model service. The API must stream responses to reduce latency, enforce token limits to manage compute resource usage, and implement retry logic to handle model timeouts and partial responses. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Integrate an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with an AWS Lambda function to invoke Amazon Bedrock. Use Lambda response streaming to stream responses. Enforce token limits within the Lambda function. Implement retry logic for model timeouts by using Lambda and API Gateway timeout configurations.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 与 AWS Lambda 函数集成以调用 Amazon Bedrock。使用 Lambda 响应流来传输响应。在 Lambda 函数中强制实施令牌限制。使用 Lambda 和 API Gateway 超时配置实现模型超时的重试逻辑。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Connect an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API directly to Amazon Bedrock. Simulate streaming by using client-side polling. Enforce token limits on the frontend. Configure retry behavior by using API Gateway integration settings.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 直接连接到 Amazon Bedrock。使用客户端轮询模拟流式传输。在前端强制执行令牌限制。使用 API Gateway 集成设置配置重试行为。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Connect an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to an Amazon ECS service that hosts a containerized inference server. Stream responses by using the WebSocket protocol. Enforce token limits within Amazon ECS. Handle model timeouts by using ECS task lifecycle hooks and restart policies.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API 连接到托管容器化推理服务器的 Amazon ECS 服务。使用 WebSocket 协议流式传输响应。在 Amazon ECS 中实施令牌限制。使用 ECS 任务生命周期挂钩和重启策略处理模型超时。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Integrate an Amazon API Gateway REST API with an AWS Lambda function that invokes Amazon Bedrock. Use Lambda response streaming to stream responses. Enforce token limits within the Lambda function. Implement retry logic by using Lambda and API Gateway timeout configurations.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon API Gateway REST API 与调用 Amazon Bedrock 的 AWS Lambda 函数集成。使用 Lambda 响应流来传输响应。在 Lambda 函数中强制实施令牌限制。使用 Lambda 和 API Gateway 超时配置实现重试逻辑。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在为生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序设计一个 API，该应用程序使用托管在托管模型服务上的基础模型 (FM)。 API 必须流式传输响应以减少延迟，强制执行令牌限制以管理计算资源使用情况，并实现重试逻辑以处理模型超时和部分响应。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is implementing a serverless inference API by using AWS Lambda. The API will dynamically invoke multiple AI models hosted on Amazon Bedrock. The company needs to design a solution that can switch between model providers without modifying or redeploying Lambda code in real time. The design must include safe rollout of configuration changes and validation and rollback capabilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Store the active model provider in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure a Lambda function to read the parameter at runtime to determine which model to invoke.
choices.textZh: 将活动模型提供程序存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。配置 Lambda 函数以在运行时读取参数以确定要调用哪个模型。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Store the active model provider in AWS AppConfig. Configure a Lambda function to read the configuration at runtime to determine which model to invoke.
choices.textZh: 将活动模型提供程序存储在 AWS AppConfig 中。配置 Lambda 函数以在运行时读取配置以确定要调用哪个模型。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to route requests to separate Lambda functions. Hardcode each Lambda function to a specific model provider. Switch the integration target manually.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon API Gateway REST API 以将请求路由到单独的 Lambda 函数。将每个 Lambda 函数硬编码到特定的模型提供程序。手动切换集成目标。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Store the active model provider in a JSON file hosted on Amazon S3. Use AWS AppConfig to reference the S3 file as a hosted configuration source. Configure a Lambda function to read the file through AppConfig at runtime to determine which model to invoke.
choices.textZh: 将活动模型提供程序存储在 Amazon S3 上托管的 JSON 文件中。使用 AWS AppConfig 引用 S3 文件作为托管配置源。配置 Lambda 函数以在运行时通过 AppConfig 读取文件，以确定要调用哪个模型。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Lambda 实施无服务器推理 API。该 API 将动态调用 Amazon Bedrock 上托管的多个 AI 模型。该公司需要设计一种解决方案，可以在模型提供商之间进行切换，而无需实时修改或重新部署 Lambda 代码。设计必须包括配置更改的安全推出以及验证和回滚功能。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A specialty coffee company has a mobile app that generates personalized coffee roast profiles by using Amazon Bedrock with a three-stage prompt chain. The prompt chain converts user inputs into structured metadata, retrieves relevant logs for coffee roasts, and generates a personalized roast recommendation for each customer. Users in multiple AWS Regions report inconsistent roast recommendations for identical inputs, slow inference during the retrieval step, and unsafe recommendations such as brewing at excessively high temperatures. The company must improve the stability of outputs for repeated inputs. The company must also improve app performance and the safety of the app’s outputs. The updated solution must ensure 99.5% output consistency for identical inputs and achieve inference latency of less than 1 second. The solution must also block unsafe or hallucinated recommendations by using validated safety controls. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy Amazon Bedrock with provisioned throughput to stabilize inference latency. Apply Amazon Bedrock guardrails with semantic denial rules to block unsafe outputs. Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to manage prompts by using approval workflows.
choices.textZh: 使用预配置吞吐量部署 Amazon Bedrock 以稳定推理延迟。应用具有语义拒绝规则的 Amazon Bedrock 护栏来阻止不安全的输出。使用 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 通过审批工作流程来管理提示。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Agents to manage chaining. Log model inputs and outputs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use logs from CloudWatch to perform A/B testing for prompt versions.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 代理来管理链接。将模型输入和输出记录到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。使用 CloudWatch 中的日志对提示版本执行 A/B 测试。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Cache prompt results in Amazon ElastiCache. Use AWS Lambda functions to pre-process metadata and to trace end-to-end latency. Use AWS X-Ray to identify and remediate performance bottlenecks.
choices.textZh: 在 Amazon ElastiCache 中缓存提示结果。使用 AWS Lambda 函数预处理元数据并跟踪端到端延迟。使用 AWS X-Ray 识别并修复性能瓶颈。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon Kendra to improve roast log retrieval accuracy. Store normalized prompt metadata within Amazon DynamoDB. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate multi-step prompts.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Kendra 提高烘焙日志检索准确性。在 Amazon DynamoDB 中存储标准化提示元数据。使用 AWS Step Functions 编排多步骤提示。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家精品咖啡公司拥有一款移动应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 和三阶段提示链生成个性化的咖啡烘焙配置文件。提示链将用户输入转换为结构化元数据，检索咖啡烘焙的相关日志，并为每个客户生成个性化的烘焙推荐。多个 AWS 区域的用户报告了相同输入的烘焙建议不一致、检索步骤期间推理缓慢以及不安全的建议（例如在过高的温度下冲泡）。公司必须提高重复投入产出的稳定性。公司还必须提高应用程序性能和应用程序输出的安全性。更新后的解决方案必须确保相同输入的输出一致性达到 99.5%，并实现推理延迟小于 1 秒。该解决方案还必须通过使用经过验证的安全控制来阻止不安全或幻觉的建议。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company developed a multimodal content analysis application by using Amazon Bedrock. The application routes different content types (text, images, and code) to specialized foundation models (FMs). The application needs to handle multiple types of routing decisions. Simple routing based on file extension must have minimal latency. Complex routing based on content semantics requires analysis before FM selection. The application must provide detailed history and support fallback options when primary FMs fail. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure AWS Lambda functions that call Amazon Bedrock FMs for all routing logic. Use conditional statements to determine the appropriate FM based on content type and semantics.
choices.textZh: 配置为所有路由逻辑调用 Amazon Bedrock FM 的 AWS Lambda 函数。使用条件语句根据内容类型和语义确定适当的 FM。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create a hybrid solution. Handle simple routing based on file extensions in application code. Handle complex content-based routing by using an AWS Step Functions state machine with JSONata for content analysis and the InvokeModel API for specialized FMs.
choices.textZh: 创建混合解决方案。根据应用程序代码中的文件扩展名处理简单路由。通过使用 AWS Step Functions 状态机以及用于内容分析的 JSONata 和用于专门 FM 的 InvokeModel API 来处理复杂的基于内容的路由。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy separate AWS Step Functions workflows for each content type with routing logic in AWS Lambda functions. Use Amazon EventBridge to coordinate between workflows when fallback to alternate FMs is required.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数中的路由逻辑为每种内容类型部署单独的 AWS Step Functions 工作流程。当需要回退到备用 FM 时，使用 Amazon EventBridge 在工作流程之间进行协调。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon SQS with different SQS queues for each content type. Configure AWS Lambda consumers that analyze content and invoke appropriate FMs based on message attributes by using Amazon Bedrock with an AWS SDK.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon SQS 与每种内容类型的不同 SQS 队列结合使用。通过将 Amazon Bedrock 与 AWS 开发工具包结合使用，配置 AWS Lambda 使用者来分析内容并根据消息属性调用适当的 FM。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发了多模式内容分析应用程序。该应用程序将不同的内容类型（文本、图像和代码）路由到专门的基础模型 (FM)。应用程序需要处理多种类型的路由决策。基于文件扩展名的简单路由必须具有最小的延迟。基于内容语义的复杂路由需要在FM选择之前进行分析。当主 FM 发生故障时，应用程序必须提供详细的历史记录并支持后备选项。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A company needs a system to automatically generate study materials from multiple content sources. The content sources include document files (PDF files, PowerPoint presentations, and Word documents) and multimedia files (recorded videos). The system must process more than 10,000 content sources daily with peak loads of 500 concurrent uploads. The system must also extract key concepts from document files and multimedia files and create contextually accurate summaries. The generated study materials must support real- time collaboration with version control. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) with AWS Lambda functions to orchestrate document file processing. Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to process all multimedia. Store the content in Amazon DocumentDB with replication. Collaborate by using Amazon SNS topic subscriptions. Track changes by using Amazon Bedrock Agents.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) 与 AWS Lambda 函数结合使用来编排文档文件处理。使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库处理所有多媒体。通过复制将内容存储在 Amazon DocumentDB 中。使用 Amazon SNS 主题订阅进行协作。使用 Amazon Bedrock Agent 跟踪更改。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) with foundation models (FMs) to process document files. Integrate BDA with Amazon Textract for PDF extraction and with Amazon Transcribe for multimedia files. Store the processed content in Amazon S3 with versioning enabled. Store the metadata in Amazon DynamoDB. Collaborate in real time by using AWS AppSync GraphQL subscriptions and DynamoDB.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) 与基础模型 (FM) 结合使用来处理文档文件。将 BDA 与 Amazon Textract 集成以提取 PDF，并与 Amazon Transcribe 集成以提取多媒体文件。将处理后的内容存储在启用版本控制的 Amazon S3 中。将元数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。使用 AWS AppSync GraphQL 订阅和 DynamoDB 进行实时协作。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) with Amazon SageMaker AI endpoints to host content extraction and summarization models. Use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to extract content from all file types. Store document files in Amazon Neptune for time series analysis. Collaborate by using Amazon Bedrock Chat for real-time messaging.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) 与 Amazon SageMaker AI 终端节点结合使用来托管内容提取和汇总模型。使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 从所有文件类型中提取内容。将文档文件存储在 Amazon Neptune 中以进行时间序列分析。使用 Amazon Bedrock Chat 进行实时消息传递进行协作。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) with AWS Lambda functions to process batches of content files. Fine-tune foundation models (FMs) in Amazon Bedrock to classify documents across all content types. Store the processed data in Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) by using Cluster Mode with sharding. Use Prompt management in Amazon Bedrock for version control.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA) 与 AWS Lambda 函数结合使用来处理批量内容文件。微调 Amazon Bedrock 中的基础模型 (FM)，以对所有内容类型的文档进行分类。使用集群模式和分片将处理后的数据存储在 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 中。使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的提示管理进行版本控制。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 公司需要一个系统来自动从多个内容源生成学习材料。内容源包括文档文件（PDF 文件、PowerPoint 演示文稿和 Word 文档）和多媒体文件（录制的视频）。系统每天必须处理超过 10,000 个内容源，峰值负载为 500 个并发上传。该系统还必须从文档文件和多媒体文件中提取关键概念，并创建上下文准确的摘要。生成的学习材料必须支持与版本控制的实时协作。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: An insurance company uses existing Amazon SageMaker AI infrastructure to support a web-based application that allows customers to predict what their insurance premiums will be. The company stores customer data that is used to train the SageMaker AI model in an Amazon S3 bucket. The dataset is growing rapidly. The company wants a solution to continuously re-train the model. The solution must automatically re-train and re- deploy the model to the application when an employee uploads a new customer data file to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Glue to run an ETL job on each uploaded file. Configure the ETL job to use the AWS SDK to invoke the SageMaker AI model endpoint. Use real-time inference with the endpoint to re-deploy the model after it is re-trained on the updated customer dataset.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Glue 对每个上传的文件运行 ETL 作业。配置 ETL 作业以使用 AWS 开发工具包调用 SageMaker AI 模型终端节点。在更新的客户数据集上重新训练模型后，使用端点的实时推理来重新部署模型。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create an AWS Lambda function and webhook handlers to generate an event when an employee uploads a new file. Configure SageMaker Pipelines to re-deploy the model after it is re-trained on the updated customer dataset. Use Amazon EventBridge to create an event bus. Set the Lambda function event as the source and SageMaker Pipelines as the target.
choices.textZh: 创建 AWS Lambda 函数和 Webhook 处理程序，以便在员工上传新文件时生成事件。配置 SageMaker Pipelines 以在更新的客户数据集上重新训练模型后重新部署模型。使用 Amazon EventBridge 创建事件总线。将 Lambda 函数事件设置为源，将 SageMaker Pipelines 设置为目标。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create an AWS Step Functions Express workflow with AWS SDK integrations to retrieve the customer data from the S3 bucket when an employee uploads a new file to the S3 bucket. Use a SageMaker Data Wrangler flow to export the data from the S3 bucket to SageMaker Autopilot. Use the SageMaker Autopilot to re-deploy the model after it has been re-trained on the updated customer dataset.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS 开发工具包集成创建 AWS Step Functions Express 工作流程，以便在员工将新文件上传到 S3 存储桶时从 S3 存储桶检索客户数据。使用 SageMaker Data Wrangler 流将数据从 S3 存储桶导出到 SageMaker Autopilot。在更新的客户数据集上重新训练模型后，使用 SageMaker Autopilot 重新部署模型。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an AWS Step Functions Standard workflow. Configure the first state to call an AWS Lambda function to respond when an employee uploads a new file to the S3 bucket. Use a pipeline in SageMaker Pipelines to re-deploy the model after it has been re-trained on the updated customer dataset. Use the next state in the workflow to run the pipeline when the first state receives a response.
choices.textZh: 创建 AWS Step Functions 标准工作流程。配置第一个状态以在员工将新文件上传到 S3 存储桶时调用 AWS Lambda 函数进行响应。在更新的客户数据集上重新训练模型后，使用 SageMaker Pipelines 中的管道重新部署模型。当第一个状态收到响应时，使用工作流中的下一个状态来运行管道。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家保险公司使用现有的 Amazon SageMaker AI 基础设施来支持基于 Web 的应用程序，该应用程序允许客户预测其保险费。该公司将客户数据存储在 中，用于在 Amazon S3 存储桶中训练 SageMaker AI 模型。数据集正在快速增长。该公司希望有一个解决方案来不断重新训练模型。当员工将新的客户数据文件上传到 S3 存储桶时，解决方案必须自动重新训练模型并将其重新部署到应用程序。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A financial services company is developing a generative AI (GenAI) application that serves both premium customers and standard customers. The application uses AWS Lambda functions behind an Amazon API Gateway REST API to process requests. The company needs to dynamically switch between AI models based on which customer tier each user belongs to. The company also wants to perform A/B testing for new features without redeploying code. The company needs to validate model parameters like temperature and maximum token limits before applying changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store parameters for each configuration. Use Lambda functions to poll for parameter updates. Use Amazon EventBridge events to trigger redeployments when configurations change.
choices.textZh: 为每个配置创建 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 参数。使用 Lambda 函数轮询参数更新。使用 Amazon EventBridge 事件在配置更改时触发重新部署。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Store model configurations in Amazon DynamoDB tables. Optimize access patterns to retrieve configurations according to customer tier. Configure Lambda functions to query DynamoDB at the beginning of each request to determine which model to use.
choices.textZh: 将模型配置存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。优化访问模式以根据客户层检索配置。配置 Lambda 函数以在每个请求开始时查询 DynamoDB，以确定要使用的模型。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use AWS AppConfig to manage model configurations. Use feature flags to perform A/B testing. Define JSON schema validation rules for model parameters. Configure Lambda functions to retrieve configurations by using the AWS AppConfig Agent.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS AppConfig 管理模型配置。使用功能标志执行 A/B 测试。定义模型参数的 JSON 模式验证规则。配置 Lambda 函数以使用 AWS AppConfig 代理检索配置。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster to store model configurations. Set short TTL values. Run custom validation logic in Lambda functions. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor configuration usage.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 集群来存储模型配置。设置短 TTL 值。在 Lambda 函数中运行自定义验证逻辑。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标来监控配置使用情况。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正在开发一款为高级客户和标准客户提供服务的生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway REST API 背后的 AWS Lambda 函数来处理请求。公司需要根据每个用户所属的客户层在人工智能模型之间动态切换。该公司还希望在不重新部署代码的情况下对新功能进行 A/B 测试。在应用更改之前，公司需要验证温度和最大代币限制等模型参数。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A retail company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop a customer service AI assistant. Analysis shows that 70% of customer inquiries are simple product questions that a smaller model can effectively handle. However, 30% of inquiries are complex return policy questions that require advanced reasoning. The company wants to implement a cost-effective model selection framework to automatically route customer inquiries to appropriate models based on inquiry complexity. The framework must maintain high customer satisfaction and minimize response latency. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a multi-stage architecture that uses a small foundation model (FM) to classify the complexity of each inquiry. Route simple inquiries to a smaller, more cost-effective model. Route complex inquiries to a larger, more capable model. Use AWS Lambda functions to handle routing logic.
choices.textZh: 创建一个多阶段架构，使用小型基础模型 (FM) 对每个查询的复杂性进行分类。将简单的查询转至更小、更具成本效益的模型。将复杂的查询路由到更大、更强大的模型。使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理路由逻辑。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock intelligent prompt routing to automatically analyze inquiries. Route simple product inquiries to smaller models and route complex return policy inquiries to more capable larger models.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 智能提示路由自动分析查询。将简单的产品查询路由至较小的型号，将复杂的退货政策查询路由至功能更强大的大型型号。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Implement a single-model solution that uses an Amazon Bedrock mid-sized foundation model (FM) with on-demand pricing. Include special instructions in model prompts to handle both simple and complex inquiries by using the same model.
choices.textZh: 实施使用 Amazon Bedrock 中型基础模型 (FM) 并按需定价的单模型解决方案。在模型提示中包含特殊说明，以使用同一模型处理简单和复杂的查询。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create separate Amazon Bedrock endpoints for simple and complex inquiries. Implement a rule-based routing system based on keyword detection. Use on-demand pricing for the smaller model and provisioned throughput for the larger model.
choices.textZh: 为简单和复杂的查询创建单独的 Amazon Bedrock 终端节点。实施基于关键字检测的基于规则的路由系统。对较小的模型使用按需定价，对较大的模型使用预配置吞吐量。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家零售公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发客户服务 AI 助手。分析显示，70% 的客户询问都是简单的产品问题，较小的模型可以有效处理。然而，30% 的询问是复杂的退货政策问题，需要高级推理。该公司希望实施一个经济高效的模型选择框架，根据查询复杂性自动将客户查询路由到适当的模型。该框架必须保持较高的客户满意度并最大限度地减少响应延迟。哪种解决方案能够以最少的实施工作满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is developing a customer support application that uses Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs) to provide real-time AI assistance to the company’s employees. The application must display AI- generated responses character by character as the responses are generated. The application needs to support thousands of concurrent users with minimal latency. The responses typically take 15 to 45 seconds to finish. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API with an AWS Lambda integration. Configure the WebSocket API to invoke the Amazon Bedrock InvokeModelWithResponseStream API and stream partial responses through WebSocket connections.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 集成配置 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API。配置 WebSocket API 以调用 Amazon Bedrock InvokeModelWithResponseStream API 并通过 WebSocket 连接流式传输部分响应。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API with an AWS Lambda integration. Configure the REST API to invoke the Amazon Bedrock standard InvokeModel API and implement frontend client-side polling every 100 ms for complete response chunks.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 集成配置 Amazon API Gateway REST API。配置 REST API 以调用 Amazon Bedrock 标准 InvokeModel API 并每 100 毫秒实施一次前端客户端轮询以获得完整的响应块。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Implement direct frontend client connections to Amazon Bedrock by using IAM user credentials and the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API without any intermediate gateway or proxy layer.
choices.textZh: 使用 IAM 用户凭证和 InvokeModelWithResponseStream API 实现与 Amazon Bedrock 的直接前端客户端连接，无需任何中间网关或代理层。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with an AWS Lambda integration. Configure the HTTP API to cache complete responses in an Amazon DynamoDB table and serve the responses through multiple paginated GET requests to frontend clients.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 集成配置 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API。配置 HTTP API 以在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中缓存完整响应，并通过多个分页 GET 请求向前端客户端提供响应。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在开发一款客户支持应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 为公司员工提供实时 AI 帮助。应用程序必须在生成响应时逐个字符地显示 AI 生成的响应。该应用程序需要以最小的延迟支持数千个并发用户。响应通常需要 15 到 45 秒才能完成。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A retail company runs an application that makes product recommendations to customers on the company’s website. The application uses Amazon Bedrock to generate recommendations by dynamically constructing prompts and sending them to foundation models (FMs). A GenAI developer has deployed an update to the application that instructs the FM to include a specific promotional message when the FM generates a response to prompts. When the developer tests the application, the promotional message does not always appear in the responses. When the promotional message does appear in the responses, it does not always flow with the rest of the text. The GenAI developer must ensure that the promotional message always appears in the FM responses. Which solution will meet this requirement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use an Amazon Bedrock Guardrails filter on the prompt. Set the input filter strength to HIGH.
choices.textZh: 根据提示使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 过滤器。将输入滤波器强度设置为“高”。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Generate multiple response variants that include the promotional message in different ways. Use a reranker model to select the most coherent version based on relevance to the original prompt.
choices.textZh: 生成多个响应变体，其中以不同方式包含促销信息。使用重新排序模型根据与原始提示的相关性来选择最连贯的版本。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Run the prompt through Amazon Bedrock. Process the response through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to add the promotional message. Rerank the results by using the original prompt and the desired message as context.
choices.textZh: 通过 Amazon Bedrock 运行提示。通过 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 处理响应以添加促销消息。使用原始提示和所需消息作为上下文对结果进行重新排序。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Reinforce the requirement to include the new promotional message within product recommendations by using an output indicator in prompts to the FM.
choices.textZh: 通过在 FM 提示中使用输出指示器，强化将新促销信息包含在产品推荐中的要求。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家零售公司运行一个应用程序，在公司网站上向客户推荐产品。该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 通过动态构建提示并将其发送到基础模型 (FM) 来生成建议。 GenAI 开发人员已部署了应用程序的更新，该更新指示 FM 在 FM 生成对提示的响应时包含特定的促销消息。当开发人员测试应用程序时，促销消息并不总是出现在响应中。当促销信息确实出现在回复中时，它并不总是与文本的其余部分一起流动。 GenAI 开发人员必须确保促销信息始终出现在 FM 响应中。哪种解决方案可以满足这个要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A healthcare company is developing an application to process medical queries. The application must answer complex queries with high accuracy by reducing semantic dilution. The application must refer to domain- specific terminology in medical documents to reduce ambiguity in medical terminology. The application must be able to respond to 1,000 queries each minute with response times less than 2 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon API Gateway to route incoming queries to an Amazon Bedrock agent. Configure the agent to use an Anthropic Claude model to decompose queries and an Amazon Titan model to expand queries. Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to store the reference medical documents.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 将传入查询路由到 Amazon Bedrock 代理。配置代理以使用 Anthropic Claude 模型来分解查询，并使用 Amazon Titan 模型来扩展查询。创建 Amazon Bedrock 知识库来存储参考医疗文档。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to store the reference medical documents. Enable query decomposition in the knowledge base. Configure an Amazon Bedrock flow that uses a foundation model and the knowledge base to support the application.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon Bedrock 知识库来存储参考医疗文档。在知识库中启用查询分解。配置使用基础模型和知识库来支持应用程序的 Amazon Bedrock 流。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker AI to host custom ML models for both query decomposition and query expansion. Configure Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases to store the reference medical documents. Encrypt the documents in the knowledge base.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 托管自定义 ML 模型以进行查询分解和查询扩展。配置 Amazon Bedrock 知识库以存储参考医疗文档。对知识库中的文档进行加密。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an Amazon Bedrock agent to orchestrate multiple AWS Lambda functions to decompose queries. Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to store the reference medical documents. Use the agent’s built-in knowledge base capabilities. Add deep research and reasoning capabilities to the agent to reduce ambiguity in the medical terminology.
choices.textZh: 创建 Amazon Bedrock 代理来协调多个 AWS Lambda 函数来分解查询。创建 Amazon Bedrock 知识库来存储参考医疗文档。使用代理的内置知识库功能。为代理添加深入的研究和推理功能，以减少医学术语中的歧义。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司正在开发一款应用程序来处理医疗查询。应用程序必须通过减少语义稀释来高精度地回答复杂的查询。应用程序必须引用医疗文档中特定领域的术语，以减少医学术语的歧义。应用程序必须能够每分钟响应 1,000 个查询，且响应时间少于 2 秒。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

prompt: A legal research company has a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application that uses Amazon Bedrock and Amazon OpenSearch Service. The application stores 768-dimensional vector embeddings for 15 million legal documents, including statutes, court rulings, and case summaries. The company's current chunking strategy segments text into fixed-length blocks of 500 tokens. The current chunking strategy often splits contextually linked information such as legal arguments, court opinions, or statute references across separate chunks. Researchers report that generated outputs frequently omit key context or cite outdated legal information. Recent application logs show a 40% increase in response times. The p95 latency metric exceeds 2 seconds. The company expects storage needs for the application to grow from 90 GB to 360 GB within a year. The company needs a solution to improve retrieval relevance and system performance at scale. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Increase the embedding vector dimensionality from 768 to 4,096 without changing the existing chunking or pre-processing strategy.
choices.textZh: 将嵌入向量维度从 768 增加到 4,096，而不改变现有的分块或预处理策略。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Replace dynamic retrieval with static, pre-written summaries that are stored in Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the summaries to reduce compute demand and improve predictability.
choices.textZh: 将动态检索替换为存储在 Amazon S3 中的静态、预先编写的摘要。使用 Amazon CloudFront 提供摘要以减少计算需求并提高可预测性。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Update the chunking strategy to use semantic boundaries such as complete legal arguments, clauses, or sections rather than fixed token limits. Regenerate vector embeddings to align with the new chunk structure.
choices.textZh: 更新分块策略以使用语义边界，例如完整的法律参数、子句或部分，而不是固定的标记限制。重新生成向量嵌入以与新的块结构保持一致。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Migrate from OpenSearch Service to Amazon DynamoDB. Implement keyword-based indexes to enable faster lookups for legal concepts.
choices.textZh: 从 OpenSearch Service 迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB。实施基于关键字的索引以更快地查找法律概念。

promptZh: 一家法律研究公司拥有一个使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Amazon OpenSearch Service 的检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用程序。该应用程序存储 1500 万份法律文件的 768 维向量嵌入，包括法规、法院裁决和案件摘要。该公司当前的分块策略将文本分割成 500 个标记的固定长度块。当前的分块策略通常将上下文相关的信息（例如法律论证、法院意见或法规参考）分割成不同的块。研究人员报告说，生成的输出经常忽略关键上下文或引用过时的法律信息。最近的应用程序日志显示响应时间增加了 40%。 p95 延迟指标超过 2 秒。该公司预计该应用程序的存储需求将在一年内从 90 GB 增长到 360 GB。该公司需要一种解决方案来大规模提高检索相关性和系统性能。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company has a recommendation system. The system's applications run on Amazon EC2 instances. The applications make API calls to Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs) to analyze customer behavior and generate personalized product recommendations. The system is experiencing intermittent issues. Some recommendations do not match customer preferences. The company needs an observability solution to monitor operational metrics and detect patterns of operational performance degradation compared to established baselines. The solution must also generate alerts with correlation data within 10 minutes when FM behavior deviates from expected patterns. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights for the application infrastructure. Set up CloudWatch alarms for latency thresholds. Add custom metrics for token counts by using the CloudWatch embedded metric format. Create CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the data.
choices.textZh: 为应用程序基础设施配置 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights。设置 CloudWatch 延迟阈值警报。使用 CloudWatch 嵌入式指标格式添加令牌计数的自定义指标。创建 CloudWatch 仪表板以可视化数据。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement AWS X-Ray to trace requests through the application components. Enable CloudWatch Logs Insights for error pattern detection. Set up AWS CloudTrail to monitor all API calls to Amazon Bedrock. Create custom dashboards in Amazon QuickSight.
choices.textZh: 实施 AWS X-Ray 以跟踪通过应用程序组件的请求。启用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 以进行错误模式检测。设置 AWS CloudTrail 以监控对 Amazon Bedrock 的所有 API 调用。在 Amazon QuickSight 中创建自定义控制面板。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights for the application resources. Create custom metrics for recommendation quality, token usage, and response latency by using the CloudWatch embedded metric format with dimensions for request types and user segments. Configure CloudWatch anomaly detection on the model metrics. Establish log pattern analysis by using CloudWatch Logs Insights.
choices.textZh: 为应用程序资源启用 Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights。使用具有请求类型和用户细分维度的 CloudWatch 嵌入式指标格式，创建推荐质量、令牌使用情况和响应延迟的自定义指标。针对模型指标配置 CloudWatch 异常检测。使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 建立日志模式分析。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service with the Observability plugin. Ingest model metrics and logs by using Amazon Kinesis. Create custom Piped Processing Language (PPL) queries to analyze model behavior patterns. Establish operational dashboards to visualize anomalies in real time.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon OpenSearch Service 与 Observability 插件结合使用。使用 Amazon Kinesis 提取模型指标和日志。创建自定义管道处理语言 (PPL) 查询来分析模型行为模式。建立操作仪表板以实时可视化异常情况。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司有一个推荐系统。该系统的应用程序在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。这些应用程序对 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 进行 API 调用，以分析客户行为并生成个性化产品推荐。系统遇到间歇性问题。有些建议与客户偏好不符。该公司需要一个可观察性解决方案来监控运营指标并检测与既定基线相比运营绩效下降的模式。当 FM 行为偏离预期模式时，该解决方案还必须在 10 分钟内生成带有相关数据的警报。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company uses an AI assistant application to summarize the company’s website content and provide information to customers. The company plans to use Amazon Bedrock to give the application access to a foundation model (FM). The company needs to deploy the AI assistant application to a development environment and a production environment. The solution must integrate the environments with the FM. The company wants to test the effectiveness of various FMs in each environment. The solution must provide product owners with the ability to easily switch between FMs for testing purposes in each environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create one AWS CDK application. Create multiple pipelines in AWS CodePipeline. Configure each pipeline to have its own settings for each FM. Configure the application to invoke the Amazon Bedrock FMs by using the aws_bedrock.ProvisionedModel.fromProvisionedModelArn() method.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 AWS CDK 应用程序。在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建多个管道。将每个管道配置为每个 FM 都有自己的设置。配置应用程序以使用 aws_bedrock.ProvisionedModel.fromProvisionedModelArn() 方法调用 Amazon Bedrock FM。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create a separate AWS CDK application for each environment. Configure the applications to invoke the Amazon Bedrock FMs by using the aws_bedrock.FoundationModel.fromFoundationModelId() method. Create a separate pipeline in AWS CodePipeline for each environment.
choices.textZh: 为每个环境创建单独的 AWS CDK 应用程序。配置应用程序以使用 aws_bedrock.FoundationModel.fromFoundationModelId() 方法调用 Amazon Bedrock FM。在 AWS CodePipeline 中为每个环境创建单独的管道。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create one AWS CDK application. Configure the application to invoke the Amazon Bedrock FMs by using the aws_bedrock.FoundationModel.fromFoundationModelId() method. Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline that has a deployment stage for each environment that uses AWS CodeBuild deploy actions.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 AWS CDK 应用程序。配置应用程序以使用 aws_bedrock.FoundationModel.fromFoundationModelId() 方法调用 Amazon Bedrock FM。在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建一个管道，该管道为使用 AWS CodeBuild 部署操作的每个环境都有一个部署阶段。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create one AWS CDK application for the production environment. Configure the application to invoke the Amazon Bedrock FMs by using the aws_bedrock.ProvisionedModel.fromProvisionedModelArn() method. Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. Configure the pipeline to deploy to the production environment by using an AWS CodeBuild deploy action. For the development environment, manually recreate the resources by referring to the production application code.
choices.textZh: 为生产环境创建一个 AWS CDK 应用程序。配置应用程序以使用 aws_bedrock.ProvisionedModel.fromProvisionedModelArn() 方法调用 Amazon Bedrock FM。在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建管道。使用 AWS CodeBuild 部署操作配置要部署到生产环境的管道。对于开发环境，请参考生产应用代码手动重新创建资源。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司使用人工智能助手应用程序来总结公司网站内容并向客户提供信息。该公司计划使用 Amazon Bedrock 为应用程序提供对基础模型 (FM) 的访问权限。公司需要将AI助手应用部署到开发环境和生产环境。该解决方案必须将环境与 FM 集成。该公司希望测试各种 FM 在每种环境中的有效性。该解决方案必须使产品所有者能够在 FM 之间轻松切换，以便在每个环境中进行测试。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is developing three specialized NLP models that support a customer service application. One model categorizes each customer’s specific issue. Another model extracts key information from the customer interactions. The third model generates responses. The company must ensure that the application achieves at least 95% accuracy for all tasks. The application must handle up to 500 concurrent requests and respond in less than 500 ms during daily 2-hour peak usage periods. The company must ensure that the application optimizes resource usage during periods of low demand between usage spikes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy all three models to a single Amazon SageMaker AI multi-model endpoint. Enable dynamic scaling on the endpoint. Use a compute optimized instance type. Configure auto scaling policies that are based on invocation metrics to handle peak loads.
choices.textZh: 将所有三个模型部署到单个 Amazon SageMaker AI 多模型终端节点。在端点上启用动态缩放。使用计算优化的实例类型。配置基于调用指标的自动扩展策略以处理峰值负载。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy each model to a separate Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint. Set provisioned concurrency to handle peak loads. Configure maximum concurrency limits and memory sizing based on each model's specific requirements.
choices.textZh: 将每个模型部署到单独的 Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference 终端节点。设置预配置并发来处理峰值负载。根据每个模型的具体要求配置最大并发限制和内存大小。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy the models by using Amazon Bedrock with provisioned throughput to handle peak loads. Configure the number of model units (MUs) based on expected token throughput needs. Implement request batching for each model.
choices.textZh: 使用具有预配置吞吐量的 Amazon Bedrock 来部署模型，以处理峰值负载。根据预期的令牌吞吐量需求配置模型单元 (MU) 的数量。为每个模型实施请求批处理。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy each model to a separate Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint. Use an asynchronous inference configuration. Store model requests and responses in Amazon S3. Use Amazon SNS to send alerts to users when the application finishes processing requests.
choices.textZh: 将每个模型部署到单独的 Amazon SageMaker AI 终端节点。使用异步推理配置。将模型请求和响应存储在 Amazon S3 中。当应用程序完成处理请求时，使用 Amazon SNS 向用户发送警报。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在开发三个支持客户服务应用程序的专用 NLP 模型。一种模型对每个客户的具体问题进行分类。另一个模型从客户交互中提取关键信息。第三个模型生成响应。公司必须确保应用程序的所有任务准确率至少达到 95%。应用程序必须处理最多 500 个并发请求，并在每天 2 小时的高峰使用期间在 500 毫秒内做出响应。公司必须确保应用程序在使用高峰之间的低需求期间优化资源使用。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is developing a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses Amazon Bedrock foundation models. The application has several custom tool integrations. The application has experienced unexpected token consumption surges despite consistent user traffic. The company needs a solution that uses Amazon Bedrock model invocation logging to monitor InputTokenCount and OutputTokenCount metrics. The solution must detect unusual patterns in tool usage and identify which specific tool integrations cause abnormal token consumption. The solution must also automatically adjust thresholds as traffic patterns change. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to capture model invocation logs. Create CloudWatch dashboards for token metrics. Configure static CloudWatch alarms with fixed thresholds for each tool integration.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 捕获模型调用日志。为令牌指标创建 CloudWatch 控制面板。为每个工具集成配置具有固定阈值的静态 CloudWatch 警报。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Store model invocation logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to analyze token usage trends.
choices.textZh: 将模型调用日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Glue 和 Amazon Athena 分析令牌使用趋势。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to capture model invocation logs. Create CloudWatch metric filters to extract tool-specific invocation patterns. Apply CloudWatch anomaly detection alarms that automatically adjust baselines for each tool’s token metrics.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 捕获模型调用日志。创建 CloudWatch 指标过滤器以提取特定于工具的调用模式。应用 CloudWatch 异常检测警报，自动调整每个工具的令牌指标的基线。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Store model invocation logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Lambda to process logs in real time. Manually update CloudWatch alarm thresholds based on trends identified by the Lambda function.
choices.textZh: 将模型调用日志存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用AWS Lambda实时处理日志。根据 Lambda 函数识别的趋势手动更新 CloudWatch 警报阈值。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在开发使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型的生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序。该应用程序具有多个自定义工具集成。尽管用户流量稳定，但该应用程序的令牌消耗却出现了意外的激增。该公司需要一个使用 Amazon Bedrock 模型调用日志记录来监控 InputTokenCount 和 OutputTokenCount 指标的解决方案。该解决方案必须检测工具使用中的异常模式，并识别哪些特定工具集成导致异常令牌消耗。该解决方案还必须随着流量模式的变化自动调整阈值。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop an AI-powered application that uses a foundation model (FM) that supports cross-Region inference and provisioned throughput. The application must serve users in Europe and North America with consistently low latency. The application must comply with data residency regulations that require European user data to remain within Europe-based AWS Regions. During testing, the application experiences service degradation when Regional traffic spikes reach service quotas. The company needs a solution that maintains application resilience and minimizes operational complexity. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy separate Amazon Bedrock instances in North American and European Regions. Use a custom routing layer that directs traffic based on user location. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor Regional service usage. Use Amazon SNS to send email alerts when usage approaches thresholds.
