choices.textZh: 在北美和欧洲区域部署单独的 Amazon Bedrock 实例。使用自定义路由层根据用户位置引导流量。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以监控区域服务使用情况。当使用量接近阈值时，使用 Amazon SNS 发送电子邮件警报。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock cross-Region inference profiles by specifying geographical codes in profile IDs when calling the InvokeModel API. Configure separate Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs to direct European and North American users to the appropriate Regional endpoints.
choices.textZh: 通过在调用 InvokeModel API 时在配置文件 ID 中指定地理代码来使用 Amazon Bedrock 跨区域推理配置文件。配置单独的 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 以将欧洲和北美用户定向到适当的区域终端节点。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy a multi-Region Amazon API Gateway HTTP API and AWS Lambda functions that implement retry logic to handle throttling. Configure the Lambda functions to call the FM in the nearest secondary Region when quotas are reached.
choices.textZh: 部署多区域 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 和 AWS Lambda 函数，以实现重试逻辑来处理限制。配置 Lambda 函数以在达到配额时调用最近的辅助区域中的 FM。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure provisioned throughput for Amazon Bedrock in multiple Regions. Implement failover logic in application code to switch Regions when throttling occurs. Use AWS Global Accelerator to route traffic based on user location.
choices.textZh: 在多个区域中为 Amazon Bedrock 配置预置吞吐量。在应用程序代码中实现故障转移逻辑，以在发生限制时切换区域。使用 AWS Global Accelerator 根据用户位置路由流量。

promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发人工智能驱动的应用程序，该应用程序使用支持跨区域推理和预配置吞吐量的基础模型 (FM)。该应用程序必须以始终如一的低延迟为欧洲和北美的用户提供服务。应用程序必须遵守要求欧洲用户数据保留在欧洲 AWS 区域内的数据驻留法规。在测试期间，当区域流量峰值达到服务配额时，应用程序会经历服务降级。该公司需要一种能够保持应用程序弹性并最大限度地降低运营复杂性的解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A global healthcare company is deploying a GenAI application on Amazon Bedrock to produce treatment recommendations. Regulations vary for each country where the company operates. Some countries require the company to retain all model inputs and outputs for 2 years. Other countries require the company to submit data for local audits only. Medical providers require consistent medical terminology across all locations. However, the treatment recommendations that the model produces must adapt to local patient demographics. The solution must also integrate with existing electronic health record (EHR) systems. The application must support up to 10,000 healthcare provider queries every day with sub-second response times. The company must be able to review the application before deployments and approve of prompt changes. The application must produce comprehensive logs for prompts, responses, and user context. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS CloudTrail to log API calls. Create standard prompts in Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management that include variables for patient demographics. Implement IAM policies to ensure that only approves users can access prompts.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录 API 调用。在 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 中创建标准提示，其中包括患者人口统计变量。实施 IAM 策略以确保只有批准的用户才能访问提示。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to collect detailed model invocation logs. Store the logs in Amazon S3. Create parameterized prompts in Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management that include variables for treatment options. Enable prompt versioning and set up an approval workflow.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 收集详细的模型调用日志。将日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。在 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 中创建参数化提示，其中包括治疗选项的变量。启用提示版本控制并设置审批工作流程。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create AWS Lambda functions to dynamically generate prompts that enforce clinical language requirements. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to track model invocations. Use Amazon SQS queues to implement a prompt approval workflow.
choices.textZh: 创建 AWS Lambda 函数以动态生成强制执行临床语言要求的提示。使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 跟踪模型调用。使用 Amazon SQS 队列实施即时审批工作流程。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Store prompt templates in Amazon S3. Use S3 Object Lock to implement version control. Use Amazon EventBridge to track model invocations. Use AWS Config to monitor changes to prompt templates.
choices.textZh: 将提示模板存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用S3对象锁来实现版本控制。使用 Amazon EventBridge 跟踪模型调用。使用 AWS Config 监控提示模板的更改。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家全球医疗保健公司正在 Amazon Bedrock 上部署 GenAI 应用程序以生成治疗建议。公司运营所在的每个国家/地区的法规有所不同。一些国家要求 公司将所有模型输入和输出保留 2 年。其他国家要求公司提交数据仅用于当地审计。医疗服务提供者要求所有地点使用一致的医学术语。然而，该模型产生的治疗建议必须适应当地患者的人口统计数据。该解决方案还必须与现有的电子健康记录 (EHR) 系统集成。该应用程序必须每天支持多达 10,000 个医疗保健提供者查询，响应时间为亚秒级。公司必须能够在部署之前审查应用程序并批准及时更改。应用程序必须生成提示、响应和用户上下文的全面日志。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company deploys multiple Amazon Bedrock–based generative AI (GenAI) applications across multiple business units for customer service, content generation, and document analysis. Some applications show unpredictable token consumption patterns. The company requires a comprehensive observability solution that provides real-time visibility into token usage patterns across multiple models. The observability solution must support custom dashboards for multiple stakeholder groups and provide alerting capabilities for token consumption across all the foundation models that the company’s applications use. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics as data sources to create custom Amazon QuickSight dashboards that show token usage trends and usage patterns across FMs.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标作为数据源来创建自定义 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板，以显示跨 FM 的令牌使用趋势和使用模式。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to analyze Amazon Bedrock invocation logs for token consumption patterns and usage attribution by application. Create custom queries to identify high-usage scenarios. Add log widgets to dashboards to enable continuous monitoring.
choices.textZh: 使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 分析 Amazon Bedrock 调用日志，了解令牌消耗模式和应用程序的使用归因。创建自定义查询来识别高使用场景。将日志小部件添加到仪表板以实现持续监控。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Create custom Amazon CloudWatch dashboards that combine native Amazon Bedrock token and invocation CloudWatch metrics. Set up CloudWatch alarms to monitor token usage thresholds.
choices.textZh: 创建结合了本机 Amazon Bedrock 令牌和调用 CloudWatch 指标的自定义 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板。设置 CloudWatch 警报以监控令牌使用阈值。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create dashboards that show token usage trends and patterns across the company’s FMs by using an Amazon Bedrock zero-ETL integration with Amazon Managed Grafana.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock zero-ETL 集成和 Amazon Managed Grafana 创建显示公司各个 FM 令牌使用趋势和模式的仪表板。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Implement Amazon EventBridge rules to capture Amazon Bedrock model invocation events. Route token usage data to Amazon OpenSearch Serverless by using Amazon Data Firehose. Use OpenSearch dashboards to analyze usage patterns.
choices.textZh: 实施 Amazon EventBridge 规则来捕获 Amazon Bedrock 模型调用事件。使用 Amazon Data Firehose 将令牌使用数据路由到 Amazon OpenSearch Serverless。使用 OpenSearch 仪表板分析使用模式。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司在多个业务部门部署多个基于 Amazon Bedrock 的生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序，用于客户服务、内容生成和文档分析。一些应用程序显示不可预测的令牌消耗模式。该公司需要一个全面的可观察性解决方案，提供跨多个模型的代币使用模式的实时可见性。可观察性解决方案必须支持多个利益相关者群体的自定义仪表板，并为公司应用程序使用的所有基础模型中的代币消耗提供警报功能。哪种解决方案组合能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

prompt: A company uses AWS Lake Formation to set up a data lake that contains databases and tables for multiple business units across multiple AWS Regions. The company wants to use a foundation model (FM) through Amazon Bedrock to perform fraud detection. The FM must ingest sensitive financial data from the data lake. The data includes some customer personally identifiable information (PII). The company must design an access control solution that prevents PII from appearing in a production environment. The FM must access only authorized data subsets that have PII redacted from specific data columns. The company must capture audit trails for all data access. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create a separate dataset in a separate Amazon S3 bucket for each business unit and Region combination. Configure S3 bucket policies to control access based on IAM roles that are assigned to FM training instances. Use S3 access logs to track data access.
choices.textZh: 在单独的 Amazon S3 存储桶中为每个业务部门和区域组合创建单独的数据集。配置 S3 存储桶策略以根据分配给 FM 训练实例的 IAM 角色控制访问。使用 S3 访问日志来跟踪数据访问。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure the FM to authenticate by using AWS Identity and Access Management roles and Lake Formation permissions based on LF-Tag expressions. Define business units and Regions as LF-Tags that are assigned to databases and tables. Use AWS CloudTrail to collect comprehensive audit trails of data access.
choices.textZh: 将 FM 配置为使用 AWS Identity and Access Management 角色和基于 LF-Tag 表达式的 Lake Formation 权限进行身份验证。将业务单位和区域定义为分配给数据库和表的 LF 标签。使用 AWS CloudTrail 收集数据访问的全面审计跟踪。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use direct IAM principal grants on specific databases and tables in Lake Formation. Create a custom application layer that logs access requests and further filters sensitive columns before sending data to the FM.
choices.textZh: 对 Lake Formation 中的特定数据库和表使用直接 IAM 主体授权。创建一个自定义应用程序层，用于记录访问请求并在将数据发送到 FM 之前进一步过滤敏感列。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure the FM to request temporary credentials from AWS Security Token Service. Access the data by using presigned S3 URLs that are generated by an API that applies business unit and Regional filters. Use AWS CloudTrail to collect comprehensive audit trails of data access.
choices.textZh: 配置 FM 以从 AWS Security Token Service 请求临时凭证。使用由应用业务部门和区域过滤器的 API 生成的预签名 S3 URL 访问数据。使用 AWS CloudTrail 收集数据访问的全面审计跟踪。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司使用 AWS Lake Formation 设置一个数据湖，其中包含跨多个 AWS 区域的多个业务部门的数据库和表。该公司希望通过 Amazon Web Services 使用基础模型 (FM) - AIP-C01 Amazon Bedrock 来执行欺诈检测。 FM 必须从数据湖中获取敏感的财务数据。这些数据包括一些客户个人身份信息 (PII)。公司必须设计一种访问控制解决方案，防止 PII 出现在生产环境中。 FM 必须仅访问已从特定数据列编辑 PII 的授权数据子集。公司必须捕获所有数据访问的审计跟踪。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop an AI-powered application that uses a foundation model that supports cross-Region inference and provisioned throughput. The application must serve users in Europe and North America with consistently low latency. The application must comply with data residency regulations that require European user data to remain within Europe-based AWS Regions. During testing, the application experiences service degradation when Regional traffic spikes reach service quotas. The company needs a solution that maintains application resilience and minimizes operational complexity. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy separate Amazon Bedrock instances in North American and European Regions. Use a custom routing layer that directs traffic based on user location. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor Regional service usage. Use Amazon SNS to send email alerts to the company when usage approaches specified thresholds.
choices.textZh: 在北美和欧洲区域部署单独的 Amazon Bedrock 实例。使用自定义路由层根据用户位置引导流量。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以监控区域服务使用情况。当使用量接近指定阈值时，使用 Amazon SNS 向公司发送电子邮件警报。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock cross-Region inference profiles by specifying geographical codes in profile IDs when the application calls the InvokeModel API. Configure separate Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs to direct European and North American users to the appropriate Regional endpoints.
choices.textZh: 当应用程序调用 InvokeModel API 时，通过在配置文件 ID 中指定地理代码来使用 Amazon Bedrock 跨区域推理配置文件。配置单独的 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 以将欧洲和北美用户定向到适当的区域终端节点。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy a multi-Region Amazon API Gateway HTTP API and AWS Lambda functions that implement retry logic to handle throttling. Configure the Lambda functions to call the foundation model in the nearest secondary Region when the application reaches service quotas in the primary Region. Use intelligent routing to ensure compliance with data residency requirements.
choices.textZh: 部署多区域 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 和 AWS Lambda 函数，以实现重试逻辑来处理限制。配置 Lambda 函数，以便在应用程序达到主区域中的服务配额时调用最近的辅助区域中的基础模型。使用智能路由确保符合数据驻留要求。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure provisioned throughput for Amazon Bedrock in multiple Regions. Implement failover logic in the application code to switch between Regions when throttling occurs. Use AWS Global Accelerator to route traffic to the appropriate endpoints based on user location.
choices.textZh: 在多个区域中为 Amazon Bedrock 配置预置吞吐量。在应用程序代码中实现故障转移逻辑，以便在发生限制时在 Region 之间进行切换。使用 AWS Global Accelerator 根据用户位置将流量路由到适当的终端节点。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发人工智能驱动的应用程序，该应用程序使用支持跨区域推理和预配置吞吐量的基础模型。该应用程序必须以始终如一的低延迟为欧洲和北美的用户提供服务。应用程序必须遵守要求欧洲用户数据保留在欧洲 AWS 区域内的数据驻留法规。在测试期间，当区域流量峰值达到服务配额时，应用程序会经历服务降级。该公司需要一种能够保持应用程序弹性并最大限度地降低运营复杂性的解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is developing a generative AI (GenAI) application by using Amazon Bedrock. The application will analyze patterns and relationships in the company’s data. The application will process millions of new data points daily across AWS Regions in Europe, North America, and Asia before storing the data in Amazon S3. The application must comply with local data protection and storage regulations. Data residency and processing must occur within the same continent. The application must also maintain audit trails of the application’s decision-making processes and provide data classification capabilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy the application in each Region with local IAM policies. Use Amazon Bedrock cross-Region inference to distribute the workload. Use Amazon CloudWatch to log AI decision-making processes. Manually track compliance certifications across Regions.
choices.textZh: 使用本地 IAM 策略在每个区域部署应用程序。使用 Amazon Bedrock 跨区域推理来分配工作负载。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 记录 AI 决策过程。手动跟踪跨区域的合规认证。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use SCPs with AWS Organizations to manage location-specific permissions. Use AWS CloudTrail immutable logs to audit decision-making processes. Import a custom model into Amazon Bedrock and deploy the model to each Region.
choices.textZh: 将 SCP 与 AWS Organizations 结合使用来管理特定于位置的权限。使用 AWS CloudTrail 不可变日志来审核决策流程。将自定义模型导入 Amazon Bedrock 并将模型部署到每个区域。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon S3 Object Lock with Region-specific S3 bucket policies. Pre-process the data points within the Region based on geographic origin before sending the data points to Amazon Bedrock. Use Amazon Macie to classify the data. Use AWS CloudTrail immutable logs to audit the decision-making processes.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon S3 对象锁定与区域特定的 S3 存储桶策略结合使用。在将数据点发送到 Amazon Bedrock 之前，根据地理来源预处理区域内的数据点。使用 Amazon Macie 对数据进行分类。使用 AWS CloudTrail 不可变日志来审核决策过程。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create separate AWS accounts for each Region with individual compliance frameworks. Use Amazon SageMaker AI with custom monitoring. Create manual compliance reports for each regulatory jurisdiction.
choices.textZh: 使用单独的合规性框架为每个区域创建单独的 AWS 账户。使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 进行自定义监控。为每个监管管辖区创建手动合规报告。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序。该应用程序将分析公司数据中的模式和关系。该应用程序每天将处理欧洲、北美和亚洲 AWS 区域的数百万个新数据点，然后将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。应用程序必须遵守当地的数据保护和存储法规。数据驻留和处理必须发生在同一大陆内。应用程序还必须维护应用程序决策过程的审计跟踪并提供数据分类功能。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company has deployed an AI assistant as a React application that uses AWS Amplify, an AWS AppSync GraphQL API, and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. The application uses the GraphQL API to call the Amazon Bedrock RetrieveAndGenerate API for knowledge base interactions. The company configures an AWS Lambda resolver to use the RequestResponse invocation type. Application users report frequent timeouts and slow response times. Users report these problems more frequently for complex questions that require longer processing. The company needs a solution to fix these performance issues and enhance the user experience. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Amplify AI Kit to implement streaming responses from the GraphQL API and to optimize client-side rendering.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Amplify AI Kit 实现来自 GraphQL API 的流式响应并优化客户端渲染。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Increase the timeout value of the Lambda resolver. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff.
choices.textZh: 增加 Lambda 解析器的超时值。使用指数退避实现重试逻辑。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Update the application to send an API request to an Amazon SQS queue. Update the AWS AppSync resolver to poll and process the queue.
choices.textZh: 更新应用程序以将 API 请求发送到 Amazon SQS 队列。更新 AWS AppSync 解析程序以轮询和处理队列。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Change the RetrieveAndGenerate API to the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API. Update the application to use an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to support the streaming response.
choices.textZh: 将 RetrieveAndGenerate API 更改为 InvokeModelWithResponseStream API。更新应用程序以使用 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API 来支持流式响应。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家公司已将 AI 助手部署为 React 应用程序，该应用程序使用 AWS Amplify、AWS AppSync GraphQL API 和 Amazon Bedrock 知识库。该应用程序使用 GraphQL API 调用 Amazon Bedrock RetrieveAndGenerate API 进行知识库交互。该公司将 AWS Lambda 解析器配置为使用 RequestResponse 调用类型。应用程序用户报告频繁超时和响应时间缓慢。对于需要较长处理时间的复杂问题，用户会更频繁地报告这些问题。该公司需要一个解决方案来解决这些性能问题并增强用户体验。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company has a recommendation system running on Amazon EC2 instances. The applications make API calls to Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs) to analyze customer behavior and generate personalized product recommendations. The system experiences intermittent issues where some recommendations do not match customer preferences. The company needs an observability solution to monitor operational metrics and detect patterns of performance degradation compared to established baselines. The solution must generate alerts with correlation data within 10 minutes when FM behavior deviates from expected patterns. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights. Set up alarms for latency thresholds. Add custom token metrics using the CloudWatch embedded metric format.
choices.textZh: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights。设置延迟阈值警报。使用 CloudWatch 嵌入式指标格式添加自定义令牌指标。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement AWS X-Ray. Enable CloudWatch Logs Insights. Set up AWS CloudTrail and create dashboards in Amazon QuickSight.
choices.textZh: 实施 AWS X-Ray。启用 CloudWatch Logs Insights。设置 AWS CloudTrail 并在 Amazon QuickSight 中创建控制面板。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights. Create custom metrics for recommendation quality, token usage, and response latency using the CloudWatch embedded metric format with dimensions for request types and user segments. Configure CloudWatch anomaly detection on model metrics. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights for pattern analysis.
choices.textZh: 启用 Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights。使用 CloudWatch 嵌入式指标格式以及请求类型和用户细分的维度，创建推荐质量、令牌使用情况和响应延迟的自定义指标。针对模型指标配置 CloudWatch 异常检测。使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 进行模式分析。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service with the Observability plugin. Ingest metrics and logs through Amazon Kinesis and analyze behavior with custom queries.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon OpenSearch Service 与 Observability 插件结合使用。通过 Amazon Kinesis 提取指标和日志并使用自定义查询分析行为。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司有一个在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的推荐系统。这些应用程序对 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 进行 API 调用，以分析客户行为并生成个性化产品推荐。系统会遇到间歇性问题，其中某些建议与客户偏好不匹配。该公司需要一个可观察性解决方案来监控运营指标并检测与既定基线相比的性能下降模式。当 FM 行为偏离预期模式时，解决方案必须在 10 分钟内生成带有相关数据的警报。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company has a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses Amazon Bedrock to provide real-time responses to customer queries. The company has noticed intermittent failures with API calls to foundation models (FMs) during peak traffic periods. The company needs a solution to handle transient errors and provide detailed observability into FM performance. The solution must prevent cascading failures during throttling events and provide distributed tracing across service boundaries to identify latency contributors. The solution must also enable correlation of performance issues with specific FM characteristics. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Implement a custom retry mechanism with a fixed delay of 1 second between retries. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor the application’s error rates and latency metrics.
choices.textZh: 实现自定义重试机制，重试之间的固定延迟为 1 秒。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以监控应用程序的错误率和延迟指标。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure the AWS SDK with standard retry mode and exponential backoff with jitter. Use AWS X- Ray tracing with annotations to identify and filter service components.
choices.textZh: 使用标准重试模式和带抖动的指数退避配置 AWS 开发工具包。使用带有注释的 AWS X-Ray 跟踪来识别和筛选服务组件。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Implement client-side caching of all FM responses. Add custom logging statements in the application code to record API call durations.
choices.textZh: 对所有 FM 响应实施客户端缓存。在应用程序代码中添加自定义日志记录语句以记录 API 调用时长。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure the AWS SDK with adaptive retry mode. Use AWS CloudTrail distributed tracing to monitor throttling events.
choices.textZh: 使用自适应重试模式配置 AWS 开发工具包。使用 AWS CloudTrail 分布式跟踪来监控限制事件。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司拥有一个生成式 AI (GenAI) 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 对客户查询提供实时响应。该公司注意到在高峰流量期间对基础模型 (FM) 的 API 调用会出现间歇性故障。该公司需要一种解决方案来处理瞬态错误并提供 FM 性能的详细可观察性。该解决方案必须防止限制事件期间发生级联故障，并提供跨服务边界的分布式跟踪，以识别延迟贡献者。该解决方案还必须能够将性能问题与特定的 FM 特性关联起来。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A financial services company wants to use Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs) to analyze call center recordings. When calls end, the call center stores recordings as MP3 files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to generate summaries and sentiment analysis for the recordings in a structured format as soon as new files are created. The recordings average 20 MB in size. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a workflow to process the recordings. Configure steps to invoke Amazon Transcribe to convert audio to text, validate job completion, and to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the text by using Amazon Bedrock FMs to generate structured analysis output.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Step Functions 编排工作流程来处理录制内容。配置调用 Amazon Transcribe 将音频转换为文本、验证作业完成情况以及调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理文本（使用 Amazon Bedrock FM 生成结构化分析输出）的步骤。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a workflow to process the recordings. Configure steps to invoke Amazon Transcribe to convert audio to text, validate job completion, and to directly invoke Amazon Bedrock FMs to generate summaries and sentiment analysis in JSON format.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Step Functions 编排工作流程来处理录制内容。配置步骤以调用 Amazon Transcribe 将音频转换为文本、验证作业完成情况以及直接调用 Amazon Bedrock FM 以生成 JSON 格式的摘要和情绪分析。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a workflow to process the recordings. Configure steps to invoke Amazon Transcribe to convert audio to text, validate job completion, and to invoke an AWS Lambda function to create a prompt to invoke Amazon Bedrock FMs to generate structured analysis output.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Step Functions 编排工作流程来处理录制内容。配置调用 Amazon Transcribe 将音频转换为文本、验证作业完成情况以及调用 AWS Lambda 函数以创建调用 Amazon Bedrock FM 生成结构化分析输出的提示的步骤。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure the source S3 bucket to send events to Amazon EventBridge. Create an EventBridge rule to invoke the Step Functions workflow when an object is created in the bucket.
choices.textZh: 配置源 S3 bucket 将事件发送到 Amazon EventBridge。创建一个 EventBridge 规则，以便在 bucket 中创建对象时调用 Step Functions 工作流。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Configure the source S3 bucket to send notifications to the Step Functions workflow when an object is created in the bucket.
choices.textZh: 配置源 S3 bucket 在 bucket 中创建对象时向 Step Functions 工作流发送通知。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司希望使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 来分析呼叫中心录音。当呼叫结束时，呼叫中心将录音作为 MP3 文件存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。创建新文件后，公司需要立即以结构化格式生成录音摘要和情绪分析。录音的平均大小为 20 MB。哪种解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

prompt: A company has a customer service application that uses Amazon Bedrock to generate personalized responses to customer inquiries. The company needs to establish a quality assurance process to evaluate prompt effectiveness and model configurations across updates. The process must automatically compare outputs from multiple prompt templates, detect response quality issues, provide quantitative metrics, and allow human reviewers to give feedback on responses. The process must prevent configurations that do not meet a predefined quality threshold from being deployed. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create an AWS Lambda function that sends sample customer inquiries to multiple Amazon Bedrock model configurations and stores responses in Amazon S3. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize response patterns. Manually review outputs daily. Use AWS CodePipeline to deploy configurations that meet the quality threshold.
choices.textZh: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将示例客户查询发送到多个 Amazon Bedrock 模型配置并将响应存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon QuickSight 可视化响应模式。每天手动检查输出。使用 AWS CodePipeline 部署满足质量阈值的配置。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock evaluation jobs to compare model outputs by using custom prompt datasets. Configure AWS CodePipeline to run the evaluation jobs when prompt templates change. Configure CodePipeline to deploy only configurations that exceed the predefined quality threshold.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 评估作业通过自定义提示数据集来比较模型输出。配置 AWS CodePipeline 以在提示模板更改时运行评估作业。配置 CodePipeline 以仅部署超出预定义质量阈值的配置。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor response latency and error rates from Amazon Bedrock. Use Amazon EventBridge rules to notify teams when thresholds are exceeded. Configure a manual approval workflow in AWS Systems Manager.
choices.textZh: 设置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以监控 Amazon Bedrock 的响应延迟和错误率。使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则在超过阈值时通知团队。在 AWS Systems Manager 中配置手动审批工作流程。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda functions to create an automated testing framework that samples production traffic and routes duplicate requests to the updated model version. Use Amazon Comprehend sentiment analysis to compare results. Block deployment if sentiment scores decrease.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数创建一个自动化测试框架，对生产流量进行采样并将重复请求路由到更新的模型版本。使用 Amazon Comprehend 情绪分析来比较结果。如果情绪分数下降，则阻止部署。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家公司有一个客户服务应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 对客户询问生成个性化响应。公司需要建立质量保证流程来评估更新的及时有效性和模型配置。该过程必须自动比较多个提示模板的输出，检测响应质量问题，提供定量指标，并允许人工审阅者对响应提供反馈。该流程必须防止部署不符合预定义质量阈值的配置。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company uses AWS Lambda functions to build an AI agent solution. A GenAI developer must set up a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that accesses user information. The GenAI developer must also configure the AI agent to use the new MCP server. The GenAI developer must ensure that only authorized users can access the MCP server. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use a Lambda function to host the MCP server. Grant the AI agent Lambda functions permission to invoke the Lambda function that hosts the MCP server. Configure the AI agent’s MCP client to invoke the MCP server asynchronously.
choices.textZh: 使用 Lambda 函数托管 MCP 服务器。授予 AI 代理 Lambda 函数调用托管 MCP 服务器的 Lambda 函数的权限。配置 AI 代理的 MCP 客户端以异步调用 MCP 服务器。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use a Lambda function to host the MCP server. Grant the AI agent Lambda functions permission to invoke the Lambda function that hosts the MCP server. Configure the AI agent to use the STDIO transport with the MCP server.
choices.textZh: 使用 Lambda 函数托管 MCP 服务器。授予 AI 代理 Lambda 函数调用托管 MCP 服务器的 Lambda 函数的权限。配置 AI 代理以使用 STDIO 传输与 MCP 服务器。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use a Lambda function to host the MCP server. Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API that proxies requests to the Lambda function. Configure the AI agent solution to use the Streamable HTTP transport to make requests through the HTTP API. Use Amazon Cognito to enforce OAuth 2.1.
choices.textZh: 使用 Lambda 函数托管 MCP 服务器。创建一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API，将请求代理到 Lambda 函数。配置 AI 代理解决方案以使用 Streamable HTTP 传输通过 HTTP API 发出请求。使用 Amazon Cognito 强制执行 OAuth 2.1。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use a Lambda layer to host the MCP server. Add the Lambda layer to the AI agent Lambda functions. Configure the agentic AI solution to use the STDIO transport to send requests to the MCP server. In the AI agent’s MCP configuration, specify the Lambda layer ARN as the command. Specify the user credentials as environment variables.
choices.textZh: 使用 Lambda 层托管 MCP 服务器。将 Lambda 层添加到 AI 代理 Lambda 函数。配置代理 AI 解决方案以使用 STDIO 传输将请求发送到 MCP 服务器。在 AI 代理的 MCP 配置中，指定 Lambda 层 ARN 作为命令。将用户凭据指定为环境变量。

categoryZh: 人工智能安全、安保和治理
promptZh: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数构建 AI 代理解决方案。 GenAI 开发人员必须设置访问用户信息的模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器。 GenAI 开发人员还必须配置 AI 代理才能使用新的 MCP 服务器。 GenAI 开发人员必须确保只有授权用户才能访问 MCP 服务器。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is developing a generative AI (GenAI)-powered customer support application that uses Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs). The application must maintain conversational context across multiple interactions with the same user. The application must run clarification workflows to handle ambiguous user queries. The company must store encrypted records of each user conversation to use for personalization. The application must be able to handle thousands of concurrent users while responding to each user quickly. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use an AWS Step Functions Express workflow to orchestrate conversation flow. Invoke AWS Lambda functions to run clarification logic. Store conversation history in Amazon RDS and use session IDs as the primary key.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Step Functions Express 工作流程来编排对话流。调用 AWS Lambda 函数来运行澄清逻辑。将对话历史记录存储在 Amazon RDS 中并使用会话 ID 作为主键。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use an AWS Step Functions Standard workflow to orchestrate clarification workflows. Include Wait for a Callback patterns to manage the workflows. Store conversation history in Amazon DynamoDB. Purchase on-demand capacity and configure server-side encryption.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Step Functions 标准工作流程来编排澄清工作流程。包括等待回调模式来管理工作流程。将对话历史记录存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。按需购买容量并配置服务器端加密。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy the application by using an Amazon API Gateway REST API to route user requests to an AWS Lambda function to update and retrieve conversation context. Store conversation history in Amazon S3 and configure server-side encryption. Save each interaction as a separate JSON file.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway REST API 部署应用程序，将用户请求路由到 AWS Lambda 函数以更新和检索对话上下文。将对话历史记录存储在 Amazon S3 中并配置服务器端加密。将每个交互保存为单独的 JSON 文件。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use AWS Lambda functions to call Amazon Bedrock inference APIs. Use Amazon SQS queues to orchestrate clarification steps. Store conversation history in an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster. Configure encryption at rest.
choices.textZh: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数调用 Amazon Bedrock 推理 API。使用 Amazon SQS 队列来编排澄清步骤。将对话历史记录存储在 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 集群中。配置静态加密。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在开发一款由生成式 AI (GenAI) 支持的客户支持应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM)。应用程序必须在与同一用户的多次交互中维护对话上下文。应用程序必须运行澄清工作流程来处理不明确的用户 查询。公司必须存储每个用户对话的加密记录，以用于个性化。应用程序必须能够处理数千个并发用户，同时快速响应每个用户。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company uses an application to process customer support tickets. The company wants to integrate AI- powered sentiment analysis and auto-response generation into the application by using Amazon Bedrock. The company wants to prioritize urgent issues and reduce initial response times by 40% compared to manual responses. The solution must process 100 concurrent webhook requests with response times under 500 ms. The solution must maintain 99.9% availability across multiple AWS Regions and authenticate all incoming requests. The company must avoid any authentication failures. The company does not want to modify the existing application infrastructure, which includes several ticketing systems that use multiple webhook authentication methods. The solution must support scaling to handle occasional spikes up to 250,000 daily tickets during peak periods. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a Regional endpoint to receive webhook requests and invoke AWS Lambda functions. Configure Lambda authorizers to validate all the webhook authentication methods. Configure the Lambda functions to call Amazon Bedrock to perform sentiment analysis and generate responses. Store results in Amazon DynamoDB global tables to provide multi- Region availability.
choices.textZh: 将 Amazon API Gateway REST API 与区域终端节点结合使用来接收 Webhook 请求并调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 授权方以验证所有 Webhook 身份验证方法。配置 Lambda 函数以调用 Amazon Bedrock 来执行情绪分析并生成响应。将结果存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 全局表中以提供多区域可用性。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create AWS Lambda function URLs for each ticketing system. Configure the function URLs with the NONE authentication type. Configure separate Lambda functions to verify webhook signatures by using Hash-based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) validation in the function code. Deploy the functions to multiple Regions and use AWS Global Accelerator to route traffic. Use Amazon Bedrock to perform sentiment analysis and generate responses. Return responses through webhook callbacks.
choices.textZh: 为每个票务系统创建 AWS Lambda 函数 URL。使用 NONE 身份验证类型配置函数 URL。配置单独的 Lambda 函数，以通过在函数代码中使用基于哈希的消息身份验证代码 (HMAC) 验证来验证 Webhook 签名。将功能部署到多个区域并使用 AWS Global Accelerator 路由流量。使用 Amazon Bedrock 执行情绪分析并生成响应。通过 webhook 回调返回响应。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Set up an Amazon SQS queue in each Region to receive webhook messages. Use the SQS queue to invoke AWS Lambda functions that call Amazon Comprehend to perform sentiment analysis and Amazon Lex to generate responses. Use Amazon EventBridge to retry message delivery to the application API.
choices.textZh: 在每个区域中设置 Amazon SQS 队列以接收 Webhook 消息。使用 SQS 队列调用 AWS Lambda 函数，这些函数调用 Amazon Comprehend 执行情绪分析，并调用 Amazon Lex 生成响应。使用 Amazon EventBridge 重试将消息传送到应用程序 API。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy an AWS AppSync GraphQL API to multiple Regions. Configure API tokens to authenticate incoming requests. Create GraphQL mutation resolvers that publish events to Amazon EventBridge. Configure EventBridge rules to invoke AWS Lambda functions that use Amazon Bedrock to perform sentiment analysis and generate responses. Use Amazon CloudFront to reduce latency.
choices.textZh: 将 AWS AppSync GraphQL API 部署到多个区域。配置 API 令牌以验证传入请求。创建将事件发布到 Amazon EventBridge 的 GraphQL 突变解析器。配置 EventBridge 规则以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，这些函数使用 Amazon Bedrock 执行情绪分析并生成响应。使用 Amazon CloudFront 减少延迟。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司使用应用程序来处理客户支持票证。该公司希望通过使用 Amazon Bedrock 将人工智能驱动的情绪分析和自动响应生成集成到应用程序中。 公司希望优先考虑紧急问题，并将初始响应时间与手动响应相比减少 40%。该解决方案必须处理 100 个并发 Webhook 请求，响应时间低于 500 毫秒。该解决方案必须在多个 AWS 区域保持 99.9% 的可用性并对所有传入请求进行身份验证。公司必须避免任何身份验证失败。该公司不想修改现有的应用程序基础设施，其中包括多个使用多种 Webhook 身份验证方法的票务系统。该解决方案必须支持扩展，以处理高峰期间偶尔出现的高达 250,000 个每日工单的峰值。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A company is using AWS Lambda and REST APIs to build a reasoning agent to automate support workflows. The system must preserve memory across interactions, share relevant agent state, and support event-driven invocation and synchronous invocation. The system must also enforce access control and session-based permissions. Which combination of steps provides the MOST scalable solution? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to manage memory and session-aware reasoning. Deploy the agent with built-in identity support, event handling, and observability.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 管理内存和会话感知推理。部署具有内置身份支持、事件处理和可观察性的代理。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Register the Lambda functions and REST APIs as actions by using Amazon API Gateway and Amazon EventBridge. Enable Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to invoke the Lambda functions and REST APIs without custom orchestration code.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 Amazon EventBridge 将 Lambda 函数和 REST API 注册为操作。使 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 能够调用 Lambda 函数和 REST API，而无需自定义编排代码。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock Agents for reasoning and conversation management. Use AWS Step Functions and Amazon SQS for orchestration. Store agent state in Amazon DynamoDB.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock Agent 进行推理和对话管理。使用 AWS Step Functions 和 Amazon SQS 进行编排。将代理状态存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy the reasoning logic as a container on Amazon ECS behind API Gateway. Use Amazon Aurora to store memory and identity data.
choices.textZh: 将推理逻辑作为容器部署到 Amazon ECS 后通过 API Gateway。使用 Amazon Aurora 存储内存和身份数据。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Build a custom RAG pipeline by using Amazon Kendra and Amazon Bedrock. Use AWS Lambda to orchestrate tool invocations. Store agent state in Amazon S3.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Kendra 和 Amazon Bedrock 构建自定义 RAG 流水线。使用 AWS Lambda 来编排工具调用。将代理状态存储在 Amazon S3 中。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Lambda 和 REST API 构建推理代理以自动化支持工作流程。系统必须在交互过程中保留内存，共享相关的代理状态，并支持事件驱动的调用和同步调用。系统还必须强制执行访问控制和基于会话的权限。 哪种步骤组合可提供最具可扩展性的解决方案？ （选择两项。）

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A large ecommerce company has deployed a foundation model (FM) to generate product descriptions. The company's engineering team monitors technical metrics such as token usage, latency, and error rates by using Amazon CloudWatch. The company's marketing team tracks business metrics such as conversion rates and revenue impact in its own systems. The company needs a unified observability solution that correlates technical performance with business outcomes. The solution must provide automatic alerts to stakeholders when operational metrics indicate degradation. The solution must provide comprehensive visibility across both technical and business metrics. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create CloudWatch dashboards that include technical metrics and imported business metrics. Configure CloudWatch composite alarms that combine technical data and business data. Use Amazon SNS to set up notifications to stakeholders.
choices.textZh: 创建包含技术指标和导入的业务指标的 CloudWatch 控制面板。配置结合技术数据和业务数据的 CloudWatch 复合警报。使用 Amazon SNS 设置给利益相关者的通知。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Managed Grafana to visualize technical metrics from CloudWatch with business metrics from external sources. Configure Amazon Managed Grafana alerts to invoke AWS Lambda functions. Configure the Lambda functions to remediate issues automatically when metrics exceed predefined thresholds.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Managed Grafana 将 CloudWatch 中的技术指标与外部来源的业务指标进行可视化。配置 Amazon Managed Grafana 警报以调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数以在指标超过预定义阈值时自动修复问题。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Stream CloudWatch metrics to Amazon S3 by using CloudWatch metric streams. Create Amazon QuickSight dashboards to visualize the combined technical metrics and business metrics. Set up Amazon EventBridge rules to send notifications to stakeholders when metrics exceed predefined thresholds.
choices.textZh: 使用 CloudWatch 指标流将 CloudWatch 指标流式传输到 Amazon S3。创建 Amazon QuickSight 仪表板以可视化组合的技术指标和业务指标。设置 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在指标超过预定义阈值时向利益相关者发送通知。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure CloudWatch custom dashboards that integrate operational metrics with imported business metrics. Set up CloudWatch composite alarms with anomaly detection. Use Amazon SNS to create alarm actions to notify stakeholders when correlated metrics indicate performance issues.
choices.textZh: 配置 CloudWatch 自定义控制面板，将运营指标与导入的业务指标集成。设置具有异常检测功能的 CloudWatch 复合警报。使用 Amazon SNS 创建警报操作，以便在相关指标指示性能问题时通知利益相关者。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家大型电子商务公司部署了基础模型 (FM) 来生成产品描述。该公司的工程团队使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控令牌使用情况、延迟和错误率等技术指标。该公司的营销团队在自己的系统中跟踪转化率和收入影响等业务指标。该公司需要一个统一的可观察性解决方案，将技术性能与业务成果关联起来。当运营指标表明性能下降时，解决方案必须向利益相关者提供自动警报。该解决方案必须提供技术和业务指标的全面可见性。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: An ecommerce company is building an internal platform to develop generative AI applications by using Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs). Developers need to select models based on evaluations that are aligned to ecommerce use cases. The platform must display accuracy metrics for text generation and summarization in dashboards. The company has custom ecommerce datasets to use as standardized evaluation inputs. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Import the datasets to an Amazon S3 bucket. Provide appropriate IAM permissions and cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) permissions to give the evaluation jobs access to the datasets.
choices.textZh: 将数据集导入 Amazon S3 存储桶。提供适当的 IAM 权限和跨源资源共享 (CORS) 权限，以便评估作业能够访问数据集。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Import the datasets to an Amazon S3 bucket. Provide appropriate IAM permissions and a VPC endpoint configuration to give the evaluation jobs access to the datasets.
choices.textZh: 将数据集导入 Amazon S3 存储桶。提供适当的 IAM 权限和 VPC 终端节点配置，以使评估作业能够访问数据集。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure an AWS Lambda function to create model evaluation jobs on a schedule in the Amazon Bedrock console. Provide the URI of the S3 bucket that contains the datasets as an input. Configure the evaluation jobs to measure the real world knowledge (RWK) score for text generation and BERTScore for summarization. Configure a second Lambda function to check the status of the jobs and publish custom logs to Amazon CloudWatch. Create a custom Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights dashboard.
choices.textZh: 配置 AWS Lambda 函数以在 Amazon Bedrock 控制台中按计划创建模型评估作业。提供包含数据集的 S3 存储桶的 URI 作为输入。配置评估作业以测量文本生成的现实世界知识 (RWK) 分数和摘要的 BERTScore。配置第二个 Lambda 函数来检查作业的状态并将自定义日志发布到 Amazon CloudWatch。创建自定义 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 控制面板。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify on a schedule to create model evaluation jobs. Use open source frameworks to create and run standardized evaluations. Publish results to Amazon CloudWatch namespaces. Use an AWS Lambda function to check the status of the jobs and publish custom logs to Amazon CloudWatch. Create a custom Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights dashboard.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Clarify 定时创建模型评估作业。使用开源框架创建和运行标准化评估。将结果发布到 Amazon CloudWatch 命名空间。使用 AWS Lambda 函数检查作业状态并向 Amazon CloudWatch 发布自定义日志。创建一个自定义的 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 仪表板。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Run an Amazon SageMaker AI notebook job on a schedule by using the fmvelos or ragas framework to run evaluations that use the datasets in the S3 bucket. Write Python code in the notebook that makes direct InvokeModel API calls to the FMs and processes their responses for evaluation. Publish job status and results to Amazon CloudWatch Logs to measure the real world knowledge (RWK) score for text generation and toxicity for summarization as metrics for accuracy. Create a custom CloudWatch Logs Insights dashboard.
choices.textZh: 通过使用 fmvelos 或 ragas 框架，按计划运行一个 Amazon SageMaker AI notebook 作业，以运行使用 S3 存储桶中数据集的评估。在 notebook 中编写 Python 代码，直接向 FMs 发出 InvokeModel API 调用并处理其响应以进行评估。将作业状态和结果发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs，以衡量文本生成的真实世界知识 (RWK) 分数和摘要的毒性作为准确性的指标。创建一个自定义的 CloudWatch Logs Insights 仪表板。

categoryZh: 测试、验证和故障排除
promptZh: 一家电子商务公司正在构建一个内部平台，以使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型 (FM) 开发生成式 AI 应用程序。开发人员需要根据与电子商务用例相符的评估来选择模型。该平台必须在仪表板中显示文本生成和摘要的准确性指标。该公司拥有自定义电子商务数据集，可用作标准化评估输入。哪种步骤组合能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: An ecommerce company is using an Anthropic Claude Sonnet model in Amazon Bedrock to generate product recommendations. An AWS Lambda function retrieves customer purchase data from Amazon DynamoDB, product reviews from Amazon S3, and customer profile information from Amazon RDS. Then the function sends the data directly to the Amazon Bedrock model through API calls. Recently, customers who have extensive purchase histories have begun to receive incomplete recommendations. Amazon CloudWatch logs for the Lambda function show execution timeouts. CloudWatch logs for Amazon Bedrock API calls show intermittent errors. The company reviews the logs and finds that some requests are failing with context-length-exceeded errors. Other requests finish but appear to ignore portions of the input data. The company wants the recommendation system to consider all customer data when the system generates recommendations. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to improve data organization and retrieval. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

choices.label: A
choices.text: Implement a chunking strategy that divides the customer data into smaller segments. Configure the model to process each segment separately. Invoke the model a final time to synthesize the individual responses into comprehensive recommendations.
choices.textZh: 实施分块策略，将客户数据拆分为较小片段。让模型分别处理每个片段，最后再调用模型汇总各片段的结果，生成完整推荐。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Modify the prompt structure to place the most critical information at the beginning and end of the context window. Implement token-counting logic to truncate less important data when the interaction approaches the model’s maximum context length.
choices.textZh: 修改提示结构，把最关键的信息放在上下文窗口的开头和结尾。接近模型最大上下文长度时，实施令牌计数逻辑并截断较不重要的数据。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Replace Claude Sonnet with a model that has a larger context-window capacity. Increase the Lambda function timeout to accommodate longer processing times for larger inputs.
choices.textZh: 将 Claude Sonnet 更换为上下文窗口更大的模型。增加 Lambda 超时时间，以容纳较大输入所需的更长处理时间。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure the recommendation system to use the Converse API. Modify the additionalModelRequestFields parameter to increase the maximum token limit beyond the model’s default context-window size.
choices.textZh: 将推荐系统改为使用 Converse API。修改 additionalModelRequestFields 参数，把最大令牌限制提高到模型默认上下文窗口大小以上。

choices.label: E
choices.text: Implement RAG by using a knowledge base to index the customer data with vector embeddings. Retrieve only the most semantically relevant information for each recommendation request based on the current customer context.
choices.textZh: 使用知识库实施 RAG，以向量嵌入索引客户数据。根据当前客户上下文，为每次推荐只检索语义最相关的信息。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家电商公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 中的 Anthropic Claude Sonnet 模型生成商品推荐。AWS Lambda 函数从 Amazon DynamoDB 获取客户购买数据、从 Amazon S3 获取商品评价、并从 Amazon RDS 获取客户画像，随后直接通过 API 将这些数据发送给 Bedrock 模型。最近，购买历史很长的客户开始收到不完整的推荐。Lambda 的 CloudWatch 日志显示执行超时，Bedrock API 日志也有间歇性错误。排查发现，部分请求因超出上下文长度而失败；另一些虽完成，却似乎忽略了部分输入。公司希望推荐时能考虑全部客户数据，并希望使用 Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 改进数据组织与检索。哪两个方案可满足要求？（选择两项）

prompt: A healthcare company is deploying an AI system that uses a foundation model (FM) to help clinicians make diagnostic decisions. The company’s ethics board requires the AI system to demonstrate fairness across patient demographic groups and comply with medical AI governance policies. During initial testing, the AI system provides recommendations without clear explanations or decision tracing. Clinicians are unable to review how the AI system produces diagnostic conclusions. The company needs to implement a solution that provides transparent reasoning for AI outputs, enables systematic fairness testing, and ensures policy compliance for responsible AI use in healthcare settings. The solution must balance comprehensive explainability with real-time performance requirements. The solution must support rapid iteration for bias testing across multiple demographic variables. The solution must integrate seamlessly with existing clinical workflows while maintaining strict data privacy controls. The solution must handle complex medical and regulatory terminology. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify to generate model explanations. Use Amazon Augmented AI (Amazon A2I) to implement human review workflows. Use AWS Config to enforce compliance policies across the AI system.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker Clarify 生成模型解释；使用 Amazon Augmented AI（Amazon A2I）实现人工审核工作流；使用 AWS Config 对整个 AI 系统强制执行合规政策。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to analyze medical terminology. Use Amazon Textract to process documents. Use AWS CloudFormation to standardize deployment configurations.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Comprehend Medical 分析医学术语；使用 Amazon Textract 处理文档；使用 AWS CloudFormation 统一部署配置。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use Amazon Bedrock agent tracing to provide reasoning traces. Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management with A/B testing to perform fairness evaluations. Use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to ensure policy compliance.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 代理追踪提供推理轨迹；使用 Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 及 A/B 测试进行公平性评估；使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 确保政策合规。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch to collect performance metrics. Use Amazon EventBridge to trigger compliance checks. Use AWS Lambda functions to generate custom explanation reports.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 收集性能指标；使用 Amazon EventBridge 触发合规检查；使用 AWS Lambda 函数生成自定义解释报告。

categoryZh: AI 安全性、安全与治理
promptZh: 一家医疗公司正在部署使用基础模型（FM）辅助临床医生做诊断决策的 AI 系统。伦理委员会要求系统能够证明其对不同患者人口统计群体的公平性，并符合医疗 AI 治理政策。初始测试中，系统给出建议却没有清晰解释或决策追踪，临床医生无法审查系统如何得出诊断结论。公司需要实现一个方案，为 AI 输出提供透明的推理依据，支持系统化的公平性测试，并确保医疗环境中负责任 AI 使用的政策合规。该方案还要在全面可解释性与实时性能间取得平衡，支持针对多个群体变量快速迭代偏差测试，无缝融入现有临床工作流并维持严格的数据隐私控制，且能处理复杂的医学和监管术语。哪种方案可满足要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A company is developing three specialized NLP models that support a customer service application. One model categorizes each customer’s specific issue. Another model extracts key information from the customer interactions. The third model generates responses. The company must ensure that the application achieves at least 95% accuracy for all tasks. The application must handle up to 500 concurrent requests and respond in less than 500 ms during daily 2-hour peak usage periods. The company must ensure that the application optimizes resource usage during periods of low demand between usage spikes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deploy all three models to a single Amazon SageMaker AI multi-model endpoint. Enable dynamic scaling on the endpoint. Use a compute optimized instance type. Configure auto scaling policies that are based on invocation metrics to handle peak loads.
choices.textZh: 将所有三个模型部署到单个 Amazon SageMaker AI 多模型终端节点。在端点上启用动态缩放。使用计算优化的实例类型。配置基于调用指标的自动扩展策略以处理峰值负载。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy each model to a separate Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint. Set provisioned concurrency to handle peak loads. Configure maximum concurrency limits and memory sizing based on each model ' s specific requirements.
choices.textZh: 将每个模型部署到单独的 Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference 终端节点。设置预配置并发来处理峰值负载。根据每个模型的具体要求配置最大并发限制和内存大小。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deploy the models by using Amazon Bedrock with provisioned throughput to handle peak loads. Configure the number of model units (MUs) based on expected token throughput needs. Implement request batching for each model.
choices.textZh: 使用具有预配置吞吐量的 Amazon Bedrock 来部署模型，以处理峰值负载。根据预期的令牌吞吐量需求配置模型单元 (MU) 的数量。为每个模型实施请求批处理。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy each model to a separate Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint. Use an asynchronous inference configuration. Store model requests and responses in Amazon S3. Use Amazon SNS to send alerts to users when the application finishes processing requests.
choices.textZh: 将每个模型部署到单独的 Amazon SageMaker AI 终端节点。使用异步推理配置。将模型请求和响应存储在 Amazon S3 中。当应用程序完成处理请求时，使用 Amazon SNS 向用户发送警报。

categoryZh: GenAI 应用的运营效率和优化
promptZh: 一家公司正在开发三个支持客户服务应用程序的专用 NLP 模型。一种模型对每个客户的具体问题进行分类。另一个模型从客户交互中提取关键信息。第三个模型生成响应。公司必须确保应用程序的所有任务准确率至少达到 95%。应用程序必须处理最多 500 个并发请求，并在每天 2 小时的高峰使用期间在 500 毫秒内做出响应。公司必须确保应用程序在使用高峰之间的低需求期间优化资源使用。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

prompt: A financial services company processes more than 10,000 customer inquiries every day through a multi-agent GenAI application that uses Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. The application agents invoke several custom tools. During peak usage periods, users report that the custom tools experience up to 40% failure rates. The tools perform inconsistently for different teams at the company. A GenAI developer must implement an observability solution that provides end-to-end visibility into agent interactions and tool behavior. The solution must use built-in Amazon Bedrock capabilities and must not require custom instrumentation. The GenAI developer needs a solution that requires minimal performance overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enable AgentCore Observability and trace collection. Use AWS X-Ray to capture distributed traces for the custom tools. Build Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize metrics for errors, throttling, and latency during peak usage periods.
choices.textZh: 启用 AgentCore Observability 和追踪收集。使用 AWS X-Ray 捕获自定义工具的分布式追踪。构建 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板，在高峰期展示错误、限流和延迟指标。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to monitor the agents. Configure an AWS Lambda function to poll the Amazon Bedrock API for tool usage metrics. Configure the function to store results in CloudWatch to generate alerts.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 监控代理。配置 AWS Lambda 函数轮询 Amazon Bedrock API 以取得工具使用指标，将结果存入 CloudWatch 并生成告警。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Build a custom ETL pipeline that uses AWS Lambda functions to process Amazon CloudWatch logs from Amazon Bedrock. Store the processed data in Amazon DynamoDB. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize cross-team performance patterns.
choices.textZh: 构建自定义 ETL 管道，使用 AWS Lambda 处理来自 Amazon Bedrock 的 CloudWatch 日志，将处理结果存入 Amazon DynamoDB，并使用 Amazon QuickSight 展示跨团队性能模式。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Enable AgentCore Observability and send trace data to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use a custom AWS Lambda function to extract tool performance metrics from the logs. Use Amazon Managed Grafana to visualize trends.
choices.textZh: 启用 AgentCore Observability 并将追踪数据发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。使用自定义 AWS Lambda 从日志提取工具性能指标，再使用 Amazon Managed Grafana 展示趋势。

categoryZh: 测试、验证与故障排除
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司每天通过使用 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 的多代理 GenAI 应用处理超过 10,000 个客户咨询。应用中的代理会调用多个自定义工具。高峰期用户报告这些工具的失败率最高达 40%，并且不同团队使用时表现不一致。GenAI 开发人员必须实现可观测性方案，端到端地查看代理交互和工具行为。方案必须使用 Amazon Bedrock 内置能力，不得需要自定义埋点，并应具有最低的性能开销。哪种方案可满足要求？

category: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications
prompt: A global financial services company hosts a fraud-alert system that uses an Amazon Bedrock foundation model (FM) to generate explanations for suspicious transactions. The company processes regulated financial data across three geographic areas. The system must maintain consistent responsiveness globally, support multi-Region failover, and provide full observability for audit and compliance teams. Load testing shows that the FM’s total inference time cannot be reduced. The company cannot increase its inference costs, change the FM, modify token counts, or provision additional compute capacity. Users report that the UI performs slowly because it waits for the complete model response before it shows any content. The company must improve perceived responsiveness during peak periods, when the system can receive 10,000–15,000 concurrent requests. The solution must maintain multi-Region resiliency and full monitoring visibility. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enable response streaming by using the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API so the frontend can display generated tokens as the tokens arrive. Collect metrics in Amazon CloudWatch and enable distributed tracing to monitor streaming latency and Regional performance.
choices.textZh: 使用 InvokeModelWithResponseStream API 启用响应流，让前端在生成令牌到达时即显示内容。收集 Amazon CloudWatch 指标并启用分布式追踪，以监控流式延迟和区域性能。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deploy Regional Amazon Bedrock inference endpoints. Set up latency-based Amazon Route 53 routing. Cache partially processed explanations in a global Amazon DynamoDB table to serve responses more quickly during peak periods.
choices.textZh: 部署区域化 Amazon Bedrock 推理端点，配置基于延迟的 Amazon Route 53 路由，并把部分处理后的解释缓存到全局 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，以在高峰时更快提供响应。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use a Lambda@Edge preprocessing layer to condense inputs during peak periods. Asynchronously call Amazon Bedrock while the system returns interim placeholder responses to customers.
choices.textZh: 使用 Lambda@Edge 预处理层在高峰期压缩输入。异步调用 Amazon Bedrock，同时向客户返回临时占位响应。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy AWS Lambda functions to handle inference requests across multiple AWS Regions. Increase Lambda concurrency limits. Scale down Amazon CloudWatch Logs retention to reduce backend load during peak periods.
choices.textZh: 在多个 AWS 区域部署 AWS Lambda 函数处理推理请求，提高 Lambda 并发限制，并缩短 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 保留期以减轻高峰期后端负载。

categoryZh: 运营效率与 GenAI 应用优化
promptZh: 一家全球金融服务公司运行欺诈告警系统，使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型（FM）为可疑交易生成解释。公司在三个地理区域处理受监管金融数据，系统必须在全球保持一致响应能力，支持多区域故障转移，并向审计与合规团队提供完整可观测性。负载测试显示 FM 的总推理时间无法缩短；公司也不能增加推理成本、更换 FM、修改令牌数量或增加计算容量。用户反映 UI 很慢，因为它要等到模型完整输出后才显示内容。系统高峰期可收到 10,000–15,000 个并发请求，公司需要改善用户感知响应速度，同时保持多区域韧性和完整监控可见性。哪种方案可满足要求？

prompt: A healthcare company is using Amazon Bedrock to develop a real-time patient care AI assistant to respond to queries for separate departments that handle clinical inquiries, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and insurance claims. The company wants to use a multi-agent architecture. The company must ensure that the AI assistant is scalable and can onboard new features for patients. The AI assistant must be able to handle thousands of parallel patient interactions. The company must ensure that patients receive appropriate domain-specific responses to queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Isolate data for each agent by using separate knowledge bases. Use IAM filtering to control access to each knowledge base. Deploy a supervisor agent to perform natural language intent classification on patient inquiries. Configure the supervisor agent to route queries to specialized collaborator agents to respond to department-specific queries. Configure each specialized collab orator agent to use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with the agent ' s department-specific knowledge base.
choices.textZh: 使用单独的知识库隔离每个代理的数据。使用 IAM 过滤来控制对每个知识库的访问。部署主管代理对患者询问进行自然语言意图分类。配置主管代理将查询路由到专门的协作代理以响应部门特定的查询。配置每个专业协作代理以将检索增强生成 (RAG) 与代理的部门特定知识库结合使用。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Create a separate supervisor agent for each department. Configure individual collaborator agents to perform natural language intent classification for each specialty domain within each department. Integrate each collaborator agent with department-specific knowledge bases only. Implement manual handoff processes between the supervisor agents.
choices.textZh: 为每个部门创建一个单独的主管代理。配置单独的协作代理以对每个部门内的每个专业领域执行自然语言意图分类。仅将每个协作代理与特定于部门的知识库集成。在主管代理之间实施手动切换流程。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Isolate data for each department in separate knowledge bases. Use IAM filtering to control access to each knowledge base. Deploy a single general-purpose agent. Configure multiple action groups within the general-purpose agent to perform specific department functions. Implement rule-based routing logic in the general-purpose agent instructions.
choices.textZh: 将每个部门的数据隔离在单独的知识库中。使用 IAM 过滤来控制对每个知识库的访问。部署单个通用代理。在通用代理内配置多个操作组以执行特定的部门功能。在通用代理指令中实现基于规则的路由逻辑。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Implement multiple independent supervisor agents that run in parallel to respond to patient inquiries for each department. Configure multiple collaborator agents for each supervisor agent. Integrate all agents with the same knowledge base. Use external routing logic to merge responses from multiple supervisor agents.
choices.textZh: 实施多个独立的主管代理，这些代理并行运行以响应每个部门的患者询问。为每个主管代理配置多个协作者代理。将所有代理与相同的知识库集成。使用外部路由逻辑合并来自多个主管代理的响应。

categoryZh: 实施和集成
promptZh: 一家医疗保健公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 开发实时患者护理 AI 助手，以响应处理临床查询、保险验证、预约安排和保险索赔的各个部门的查询。该公司希望使用多代理架构。 公司必须确保 AI 助手具有可扩展性，并且可以为患者添加新功能。人工智能助手必须能够处理数千个并行的患者交互。公司必须确保患者收到针对特定领域的查询的适当答复。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A financial services company is building a fraud detection system by using Amazon Bedrock. The system will monitor activity in multiple stock trading applications that run in the United States and Europe. The system must process 1,000 transactions every second with sub-500 ms response times. The system must also maintain high availability during connectivity disruptions. The company must ensure that data for European customers is processed only in AWS Regions that are based in Europe. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure AWS Lambda functions and Amazon EKS applications to use the InvokeModel API with a global inference profile. Deploy an automated failover system that uses Amazon Route 53 health checks. Create a dedicated European inference profile and enable geographic cross-Region inference for European applications. Use Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor utilization metrics.
choices.textZh: 配置 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon EKS 应用使用带有全局推理配置文件的 InvokeModel API。使用 Amazon Route 53 健康检查部署自动故障转移；为欧洲应用创建专用欧洲推理配置文件并启用地理跨区域推理；使用 Amazon CloudWatch 告警监控利用率。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure all applications to use the InvokeModel API with provisioned throughput for an Anthropic Claude model in each Region separately. Set up a custom Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic based on Regional capacity and response times. Implement a Regional failover mechanism that uses Amazon EventBridge rules to handle connectivity disruptions.
choices.textZh: 将所有应用配置为在每个区域分别使用针对 Anthropic Claude 模型的预置吞吐量 InvokeModel API。建立自定义 Application Load Balancer，按区域容量和响应时间分发流量；使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则实现区域故障转移。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure all applications to use the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API with on-demand throughput. Deploy an Amazon API Gateway REST API with Regional endpoints in each location where the company operates to route requests to the closest Amazon Bedrock endpoint. Create separate IAM roles for applications that run in the United States and Europe. Grant the IAM roles Regionspecific permissions.
choices.textZh: 将所有应用配置为使用按需吞吐量的 InvokeModelWithResponseStream API。部署 Amazon API Gateway REST API，并在每个运营地点使用区域端点把请求路由到最近的 Bedrock 端点。为美国和欧洲应用创建独立 IAM 角色并授予区域特定权限。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Configure applications that run in the United States to use provisioned throughput with the InvokeModel API. Configure European applications to use a Europe-specific geographic inference profile to ensure data sovereignty. Configure automatic scaling for provisioned capacity based on utilization metrics. Use Amazon EventBridge and AWS Lambda functions to implement cross-Region failover mechanisms.
choices.textZh: 将美国应用配置为使用预置吞吐量和 InvokeModel API；将欧洲应用配置为使用欧洲专属地理推理配置文件以确保数据主权；按利用率为预置容量配置自动扩缩；使用 Amazon EventBridge 与 AWS Lambda 实现跨区域故障转移机制。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一家金融服务公司正使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建欺诈检测系统，用于监控美国和欧洲运行的多个股票交易应用。系统必须每秒处理 1,000 笔交易，并在 500 毫秒以内响应；在连接中断时也必须保持高可用。公司还必须确保欧洲客户的数据只在位于欧洲的 AWS 区域中处理。哪种方案可满足要求？

prompt: A media company is building an AI-powered content moderation system by using Amazon Bedrock. The system first classifies text by using a small, low-latency model. Then the system escalates requests that have a confidence score below 0.65 to a larger, more expensive model. The system must respond in near real time for high-confidence results. The system must process lowconfidence requests asynchronously. The system must scale to meet sudden spikes in demand. The company wants to optimize costs for the system by invoking the larger model only when required. The company wants to use decoupled components to achieve high resiliency for the system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use Amazon API Gateway to invoke the small model synchronously. If the small model’s confidence score is below 0.65, synchronously call the larger model. Use provisioned concurrency to handle traffic spikes.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 同步调用小模型；若置信度低于 0.65，则同步调用大模型；使用预置并发处理流量尖峰。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use an AWS Step Functions workflow that has parallel branches to run both the small model and the large model for every request. Choose the large model result when confidence score values differ.
choices.textZh: 使用具有并行分支的 AWS Step Functions 工作流，为每个请求同时运行小模型和大模型；当置信度值不同时，选择大模型结果。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Send requests to an Amazon SQS queue. Use AWS Fargate to process messages. Invoke the small model first. If the confidence score is below 0.65, place the request in a second SQS queue to process asynchronously by using the large model.
choices.textZh: 将请求发送到 Amazon SQS 队列并使用 AWS Fargate 处理消息。先调用小模型；若置信度低于 0.65，则把请求放入第二个 SQS 队列，由大模型异步处理。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deploy both models on Amazon EC2 instances and enable auto scaling. Use a custom application heuristic to route requests to the appropriate instance based on phrase length and keyword rules.
choices.textZh: 将两个模型都部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上并启用自动扩缩。使用自定义应用启发式规则，按短语长度和关键字将请求路由到相应实例。

categoryZh: 实施与集成
promptZh: 一家媒体公司正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建 AI 驱动的内容审核系统。系统先用小型低延迟模型分类文本，再将置信度低于 0.65 的请求升级给更大、更昂贵的模型。高置信度结果必须近实时返回，低置信度请求必须异步处理。系统还要能扩展以应对突发需求，并且只在必要时调用大模型以优化成本；公司希望使用解耦组件取得高韧性。哪种方案可满足要求？

category: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
prompt: A GenAI developer is building a RAG system that uses Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. The system needs to process 50 textbooks that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The textbooks are all an average of 500 pages long. The system needs to generate a knowledge base to answer domain-specific customer questions. During initial testing on a subset of documents, the GenAI developer notices that query responses contain irrelevant information and sometimes miss critical context from the source materials. The GenAI developer must ensure that the solution provides accurate responses with low latency and no hallucinations. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Configure fixed-size chunking with a 256-token chunk size. Implement metadata filtering based on document sections. Use an Amazon Titan Embeddings model to create vector representations that are optimized for semantic search.
choices.textZh: 配置固定大小分块，块大小为 256 个令牌；按文档章节实施元数据过滤；使用 Amazon Titan Embeddings 模型创建针对语义搜索优化的向量表示。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use Amazon ElastiCache to implement semantic caching for common queries. Use Anthropic Claude Sonnet to reformulate user queries. Configure real-time model feedback loops to continuously improve response quality based on user interactions.
choices.textZh: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache 对常见查询实施语义缓存；使用 Anthropic Claude Sonnet 重述用户查询；依据用户交互配置实时模型反馈循环，以持续改善回答质量。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Apply hierarchical chunking with both 200-token chunks and 1,000-token chunks. Implement hybrid search that combines vector and keyword search. Adjust the relevance score threshold to filter out lowconfidence retrieval results.
choices.textZh: 同时使用 200-token 块和 1,000-token 块实施分层分块；实施结合向量搜索和关键字搜索的混合检索；调整相关性评分阈值以过滤低置信度检索结果。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use semantic chunking to automatically segment documents based on topic boundaries. Configure the knowledge base to use a single embedding model for all content types. Implement query expansion to reformulate user questions before retrieval.
choices.textZh: 使用语义分块按主题边界自动分割文档；将知识库配置为对所有内容类型使用单一嵌入模型；在检索前实施查询扩展以重述用户问题。

categoryZh: 基础模型集成、数据管理和合规性
promptZh: 一名 GenAI 开发人员正在构建使用 Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 的 RAG 系统。系统需处理存放在 Amazon S3 中的 50 本教材，每本平均 500 页，并建立知识库以回答特定领域的客户问题。在对部分文档初测时，开发人员发现查询回答包含无关信息，有时又遗漏源材料中的关键上下文。开发人员必须确保方案能以低延迟提供准确回答并避免幻觉。哪种方案可满足要求？
